tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mdo khams pa nang so kun dga' rin chen la gdams pa phyag chen ngo sprod/

na mo rat+na gu ru/ 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rin po che/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa can/ /phyi nang gi 'khrul pa rang sar zhig/ snying rje chen pos khyab pa'i thugs/ /gcam bu'i mdzes chos spangs nas ni//mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pas/ /lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro don mdzad/ / drin can gyi bla ma byin rlabs can/ /lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ / mgon des cung zad byin brlabs pa/ /mi ngas kyang gnas lugs tshig gsum 'di/ /bu khyod la 'di ltar snying gtam du gdams/ /nges 'byung gi dad pa so ma ste/ /chos brgyad kyi rlung gis ma khyer bar 'tshal/ /byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba mos gus la/ /gom 'dris dang log ltas ma khyer bar 'tshal/ /'dus byas skad cig gi rang bzhin la/ /rtag 'dzin gyi le lo mi 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal can 'khor ba'i gnas lugs la/ /skyid 'dod kyi zhen pa log pa zhig 'tshal/ /'gro drug drin can gyi pha ma la/ /byams pa dang snying rje sbyongs dus 'dir/ /gnod sems dang 'gran 'dod mi 'tshal lo/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /snang stong lha skur rang shar gyi/ /dag snang gi 'khor lo skor rgyu la/ /brdos bcas kyi zhen pa mi 'tshal lo/ /grags stong ngag gi rang bzhin de/ /brag ca lta bur sgom rgyu la/ /tha mal gyi long gtam sna tshogs kyis//chags sdang gi bkyed bed mi 'tshal lo/ /sems gang shar chos sku'i yo langs la/ /ngo shes byar med kyis sgom rgyu la/ /rnam g.yeng phyi lta'i rnam rtog gis/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo ma skor zhig /tha mal rlung sems kyi 'jug pa 'di/ /'khor 'das 'byed pa'i sa mtshams zhig lags/ /le lo dang bya ba la ma yengs par/ /rlung sems drag tu bcun pa zhu/ /sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod na/ /gting skyon mthon pa'i gnad ka des/ /gnyen po mang yang mi phan pas/ /rtsa bral thob phyir du 'bad pa 'tshal/ / yengs med du bsam gtan sgom dus su/

/longs spyod dang bsod nams than thun de/ /bdud kyi pho nyar yong lags pas/ /ci dgar bor la sbyin par thong*/ / bar chad dngos grub tu 'khyar ba lags/ /nam zhig sgom nyams bzang bde na/ /zang 'dzin dang dga' grong bdud du 'ong*/ /nyams len gyi rgyal po zhen med yin/ /byar med du zhog cig gegs las grol/ /sems rig pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gags pa/ /thams cad chos sku'i rtsal yin yang*/ /gang shar rtsa ba ma chad par/ /'og 'gyur 'gro ba'i nyen gdog pas/ /rtse gcig dmigs pa la sgrim par 'tshal/ /zhi gnas tsam brtan brtan 'dra na yang*/ /ma rig gti mug tu byings dogs yod/ /gang shar ngo lta'i 'ud bshad kyis/ /'khrul pa rgya 'byams su shor gyis dogs/ /stong nyams tsam shar ba'i lta skad kyis/ /las 'bras la chud zos mi 'tshal lo/ /lar kun la mos gus gnad du che/ /de dngos grub kyi rtsa bar nges lags kyang*/ /thob 'dod kyi re dogs mi 'tshal lo/ /zhen med kyi sgo nas dge sbyor kun/ kha sngo bas rgyas thebs kyang gal re che/ /yang bla ma la gsol ba 'debs na/ mdun du rtsa ba'i bla ma bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ldan pa brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam chos skyongs mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi bskor ba/ sprul pa'i pho nya mang po spro ba rang la dgyes bzhin pa byin gyis rlob rlob ltar bzhugs pa la mos gus dung ba byas te/ drin can bla ma rin po che/ /chos sku'i thugs la longs sku'i gsung*/ /sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'bar ba la/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i bka'/ / thugs ni bde gsal rgya mtsho 'dra/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /yi dam lha tshogs sprin ltar 'thibs/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ / chos skyong bsrung ma khrom ltar tshogs/ /sprul pa bu yug bzhin du 'tshubs/ /pho nya mang po glog ltar 'khyug /rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshogs kyis bskor/

/mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir byon la/ /da lta bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /gdan thog 'di ru byin gyis rlobs/ /lus la bde chen bskyed du gsol/ /ngag la nus pa bskyed du gsol/ /sems la ye shes dbab du gsol/ /dbang bzhi da lta bskur du gsol/ nyams dang rtogs pa bskyed du gsol/ /'ar ma 'ur mar byin gyis rlobs/ /ban ma bun mar byin gyis rlobs/ /chal ma chil mar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam lha tshogs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs/ /chos skyong bsrungs mas byin gyis rlobs/ kun 'dus bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rje btsun bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas bla ma'i sku las dbang bzhi blangs/ bla ma rang la thim/ rang shar ngos bzung ngo*/ /zhes pa 'di yang mdo khams pa nang so kun dka' rin chen la/ tā ra nā thas gdams pa ste/ /rje btsun lha dbang grags pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa la brten nas phyag chen ngo sprod byas pa'i rjed thor byas pa'o// //maṅgalaṃ/༈dkon mchog rin chen la gdams pa'o/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ pha bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu dkon mchog rin chen snyan gson dang*/ /mi nga la snying gtam tshig gsum yod/ /nyams len gyi rgyal po mos gus yin/ /da res bla ma dang mjal ba la/ /mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs pa zhu/ /'chi ba 'di nam yong cha med pas/ /chos dran ma thag tu lag tu long*/ /mi rtag 'phral 'phral du 'gyur lugs la/ /yid 'byung skyo shas kyis rgyud gcig bskul/ / 'dir ltas 'dod yon gyi gdung sems 'di/ /las sla mor chod pa dka' bas na/ /snying rus dang zhe bcad drag po yis/ /tshe 'di'i legs nyes ci dgar bsgyur/ /zhen med du 'phang pa gdams ngag yin/ /tshe 'di la skyab kyi mi rnams dang*/ /blo sna mang du bstun dgos na/

/bya byed mi shes chos dang 'gal/ /mi ngan dang blo sna bstun pa bas/ /dam chos dang blo sna bstun na legs/ /yongs rang shar rang gi rang ngo la/ /bzo bcos med par lhod kyis klod/ /ched du bcos pa'i grim lhod kun/ /blos byas yin pas snying po med/ /so ma'i ngang nas rgya yan 'di/ /ci byas sgom du 'gro ba lags/ /rnam rtog skyes dang ma skyes 'dra/ /dran pa ngo shes 'di gal re che/ /yo byad dge ba'i phyogs su bsgyur/ /bya byed chos kyi phyogs su bsgyur/ /rig pa'i mda' rtse nang du bsgyur/ /'khrul snang dag pa'i snang bar bsgyur/ /bsgyur ba rnam bzhi nyams su long*/ /de kun yang gzhan phan du bsgyur bar bya/ /lag tu thebs na gdams ngag yin/ /yi ge tsam la ma lus pa 'tshal//zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ stag lung thang du'o// //dge legs 'phel/ / ༈ rim gnyis lta spyod sgom pa kun ma tshang ba med pa'i gnad bsdus bzhugs/ ༈ oṃ swā sti/ gang gi ye shes 'od brgya'i do shal ni/ /smon lam shar ri'i phrag par legs bkod nas/ /'gro ba'i mun sel rje btsun 'od stong can/ khyab bdag khyod kyis ma lus 'gro 'di skyongs/ /de la dam pa'i chos rin po che rtog ge'i lam las 'das pa/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis gsal bar gyur pa'i ye shes/ dad pa'i rtsa ba nyid las mngon par grub pa/ gang gi lam/ tha snyad spros pa'i tshig la ma yin par sgrub pa snying por byed pa la gnad rnams legs par shes pa gal che/ thams cad kyi thams cad du/ bla ma dam pa lus longs spyod sgrub pa sogs thams cad kyis mnyes par byas nas/ man ngag ma nor ba dag zhal las mnos te/ mdo rgyud zab mo rnams la thos pa dpyis phyin pas sgrub pa byas na ni ches mchog go /bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i mos gus kyis rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs pa rang gnad du che bar gda'/ 1) mtha' bral du mnyam par 'jog pa la/ gsal rig tsam la rang so 'jug pa yang thabs tsam yin mod/

ngo bo rig stong du 'jog pa gnad/ 2) mang du sgoms kyang nyon mongs tha mal par 'chor na/ sgom gnad du ma song ba yin de la yid la byed pa rnams dang*/ bden med kyi 'dun pa/ bla ma'i mos gus ngo bo la cer phog tu sgom pa rnam gzer bus 'debs pa gnad/ 3) spyod lam thams cad du sgo gsum skad cig kyang chos las mi 'da' zhing*/ las 'bras kyi blang dor la rdul tsam yang mi brnyas shing*/ bslab pa la gus pas tshul bzhin bsrung ba gnad/ 4) sgrub pa byed pa kun thog mar dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las 'bras mi bslu ba bsam pa sogs blo chos su 'gro ba'i thabs 'di dag bcos min rang rgyud la skyes skyes 'bad rtsol du byed pa gnad/ 5) gsang sngags sgom 'dod kun ye stong dang rang ngo shes na snang tshad bde stong rang yin pas/ gzhan gang yang mi dgos zer ba'i 'ud bshad la klog nyan pa mi byed par/ bla ma mtshan ldan la bsten nas phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor rnams su cho ga mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dbang bskur thob par byed pa gnad/ 6) /bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor sbyang gzhi sbyong byed khyad par can gyi nyams len rang gal che ba/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gsal cha tshol ba gnad/ 7) gsal snang gi ngo bo rdul chos las 'das pa'i 'ja' tshon lta bu gnad/ 8) bzlas pa dmigs med ngang nas byed pa shin tu zab cing*/ dmigs bcas la yang dmigs pa rtse gcig pa gnad/ 9) bzlas pa'i gtso bo rdo rje'i bzlas pa yin pa don dam rdor bzlas ngag rlung gi dwangs ma mi shigs pa'i nā dar dngos su ngo sprod pa'i zab gnad phul phyin dang*/ spros bcas dmigs pa rdor bzlas sogs kyang shin tu zab pa'i gnad yod pas nan tan byed pa bzlas pa'i gnad/ 10) sems 'dzin thams cad kyi nang nas snying gi thig le sogs a ba dhū tī la gnad du bsnun pa rang gnad/ man ngag lugs kyi sbyor ba ha cang drag pas gegs byung na/

phyis thabs mkhas kyis sel ba las kyang*/ gegs chung la gting chod che ba/ tshad ldan gyi gsung bzhin ston na legs/ rlung sbyor gyi gtso bo rlung 'gog pa ste/ dbu mar thim pa yin/ de la bum can gnad du che ba las sngon du rtsa lam sbyong ba gnad/ 11) rlung dbu mar thim pas stong nyid tsam rtogs la thim pa des gtum mo 'bar bas bde ba drangs te/ bde stong zung du sbyor ba yin te/ rlung dang gtum mo'i 'bras bu drod sogs tsam la dmigs na mi rung pas/ 'di gnad du song ma song lta ba rang gi nyams myong dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gi dngos sbyor ba gnad/ 12) ye shes lhan cig skyes pa ngo sprod pa ye rgya sogs gsungs pa'i nang nas/ stong nyid la sbyong ba kho na gnad do/ 13) bstan pa rdzogs ldan dus lta bur gang zag mchog la don du 'gyur nges na/ las rgya gnang ba sogs shin tu gsang ba'i zab mo yin mod/ deng sang de la snyad nas spyod pa 'chol bar spyod pa dag dmyal ba'i rgyu yin pas/ rab byung sngags spyod pa phal cher dam chos 'dul ba rang dbang bzhag la brten dgos pa gnad/ 14) sa rdul chus sbyangs nas gser len pa ltar/ dga' bzhi skad cig so sor shar pa ngos zin pa'i sgo nas/ ngo bo rang bzhin stong pa la mnyam par 'jog pa gnad/ 15) 'dis rnam shes gsum dang rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog thams cad sbyong*/ ma dag tha mal pa'i snang ba stong par sbyangs pa las/ bag chags kyi rang gdangs lha sku 'char ba bdag med du sbyong ba chags grol gang la brten kyang bde stong sbyor ba gnad/ 16) des phyag rgya chen po lha sku mngon du 'gyur/ 'khrul snang thams cad sdud rim khyad par can gyi stong par 'dus pas bde stong ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal mngon gyur gyi ye shes te/ phyag chen dang zung 'jug yin la rang bzhin rnam dag gi rang ngo'i 'char sgo rkyang 'dod tsam ni lta ba'i nyams len yin pas lta sgom shan phyed par bya ba gnad de bcu bdun no/

/spyir btang du nyams thams cad la byung rgyal gnad/ spros bcas thams cad mi rtog pas zin pa gnad/ spros med ji lta ba mngon du gyur na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas la 'jug pa gnad/ las dang po bas thun 'jug tu bsngo ba rnam dag gis rgyas thebs pa gnad de bzhi'o//bcu bdun dang bzhi ste/ nyer gcig po 'di rnal 'byor bla med kyi rim gnyis lta spyod sgom pa kun ma tshang ba med pa'i gnad bsdus lags pas/ thugs la nges pas nyams len du mdzod/ /'di ru bdag gis gang smras pa/ /legs pa gang dag bla ma dang*/ /nyes pa gang yin bdag gis bzung*/ / log smras dus gsum mgon la bshags/ /'di'i dge bas bdag gzhan thams cad rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung gi dpal la 'byor bar gyur cig / ces pa 'di stag lung lo tsā ba shākya bzang po'i sku'i rigs dang gdan sar gyur pa gang gi ngor//phyogs bral gyi rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā thas stag lung gi chos grwar ro/ rang lo nyi shu pa la'o// //༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /rin chen gsum bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /phan bde ma lus kun gyi gter/ /chos kyi snying po yang 'di rnyed/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor don mchog la/ sbyor zhing nam 'chi cha med bsam/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nges shes nas/ /bsam pa dag pas skyabs 'gro bya/ /las 'bras yid ches blang dor bya/ /mnyam dang brje ba'i byang sems bsgom/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la bslab/ /chos spyod bcu po nyams su blang*/ /brgyad po de dang ldan gyur na/ /dam chos ma lus bsgrub pa yi/ /rnal 'byor can zhes bya ba ste/ /gzhan du bsgrub pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam/ khyad par nyes pa lnga spangs pa'i/ /zhi gnas sgom gyi rmang gzhi yin/ /ji lta'i gnas la mtha' bral tshul/ /rjes su dpag pas nges rnyed pa'i/ /shes rab gnas cha dang bsres pa/ /lhag mthong lam gyi gtso bor snang*/ /gsal zhing ngar ba'i mdangs ldan pa/

/g.yo med lhan ner gnas pa na/ /bying rgod phra zhing phra ba yang*/ /bral phyir skyon rnams spangs zhes bya/ /rdo la brdar ba'i gser ris bzhin/ /zhi lhag zung du 'jug par mdzod/ /da ltar snang ba 'di dag kun/ /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin med/ /stong bzhin du yang bya ba dang*/ /rten 'brel 'gag pa med pa yi/ /stong pa nyid la kun rung ba/ /nyid kyi thugs la sngar chud kyang*/ /da dung g.yo bar ma mdzad ces/ /bdag ni ring du sgrog par byed/ /da ni shin tu gsang ba yi/ /theg pa mchog gi man ngag ni/ /rgyud bzhi bla ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /cung zad tsam zhig zhu bgyid na/ /dbang bskur dam tshig ma nyams pas/ /bskyed rim yan lag tshang bar bsgom/ /'di la zhu bder gyur pa'i sems/ /zab gsal gnyis med bsgom pa bsngags/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /kun kyang kun 'dar nang du bsgom/ /lus gnad bum can rlung sbyor bcas/ /sor gcig yang na sor bzhi pa/ /mar me kho na rtag tu bsgom/ /nor bu snying gar 'od gsal dang*/ /gsang ba mgrin par rmi lam bzung*/ /spyi bo lte 'og sgyu ma'i lus/ /lte bar gtum mo sbar bar bya/ /de dag rtag tu bsgom pa las/ /sems dmigs bden gnyis zung 'jug sogs/ /bskyed tshul spyi dang mthun pa yin/ /skabs 'gar shin tu dpyad cing bsgom/ gzhan du rtse gcig sgrims la bzung*/ /la lar klod la ngal yang gso/ /rtag tu bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ / gegs dang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ /yon tan gong du 'phel zhes gsungs/ / rlung sbyor bcu len la sogs pa/ /lag len 'ga' zhig 'dir ma bkod/ /de dag rnams kyi rgyu mtshan sogs/ /rlung rnams bsdud dang gnas dang thim/ /thim pa'i zhu bde 'dren tshul sogs/ /sde snod 'dzin pa khyed kyi ni//thugs la sngon nas gsal ba lags/ /'on kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i//zhib cha'i khyad par 'ga' zhig ni/ /mjal dus gleng ba'i legs smon zhu/ /dge bas sangs rgyas thob par shog

/brgyud pa mi ldan dag mi 'gyur/ /de la brgyud pa 'di dag yin/ /dril bu pa dang lwa ba pa/ /zhing pa rdo rje chos myug dang*/ /ra hu la dang a ti sha /ḍeṃ gi bhi k+ṣa'i zhal snga nas/ /bya rngon pa dang dkar min sprin//ye shes bshes gnyen de bzhin du/ /grub thob shān+ti gup+ta las/ /sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po yis/ /legs gsan de la bdag gis thob/ /ces pa kun dga' snying pos smras/ /bshes gnyen chen po rgyang ro gser sdings kyi gdan sa yun ring du mdzad pa rin po che bkra shis rin chen pas/ mdo rgyud kun gyi yang snying yin pa/ tshig nyung ba'i chos 'brel zhig bskur gsung pa'i don la tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o// //༈ yang zhal gdams/ ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ pha rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal nas/ /'dir snying gtam tshig gsum smra ba ni/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba ni 'ja' tshon dang 'dra/ /'di yi rjes 'ded mi 'tshal lo/ /snang ba 'di rang sems kyi byed pa gcig lags/ /tha dad du 'dzin zhen mi 'tshal lo/ /rig pa zhen med du ma shar na/ /sgom byas tshad bzang rdzur 'gro nyer gda'/ /rang sems tshir gyis ma bzung na/ /don med kyi las la zad nyen gda'/ /rang don la hril gyis ma sgril na/ /gzhan don ltar snang gi mgo skor yong*/ /da res tsam ma gtogs mi lus ni/ /yang yang du thob pa shin tu dka'/ /ngan song gsum du skyes tsa na/ /dam chos kyi skal pa ni gcig kyang med/ /da res rdog sna gcig 'dren na ni/ /dmyal ba'i gting rdo gcig byed byed 'dra/ /phyi ma la phan pa'i dge ba dang*//nyams len byas rjes ni 'di kar gda'/ /sdig pa dang nyes ltung ni char ltar 'bab/ /don 'di ltar bsam na chos la 'bungs/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yang myur du 'ong*/ na tsha dang mi 'dod pa byung tsa na/ /sdug bsngal gyi gzir ba'i shes pa de/ /chos kyi lam du longs dka' bas/ /skyid dus nas chos la 'bungs pa zhu/ /re zhig rang cag tsho'i mi tshe la/

/rgyal khams yul phyogs kyi dar rgyud dang*/ /yar bla ma slob dpon gyi gnas lugs dang*/ /grwa rogs dang grogs mched kyi 'gyur lugs dang*/ /pha ma dang dgra gnyen gyi gnas lugs sogs/ /thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang 'tshang ston/ /'phral lo dang zla ba zhag re la/ /mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon kun/ /skyo ba skyed byed kun gam na 'dug/

nam yang tshe 'di'i bya ba kun/ /ji ltar byas kyang 'dor ba la/ /bu bya ba btang na sgrub pa 'tshal/ /lus mi rtag sha rus 'gyel 'gyel 'dra/ /gces gces mor byas pa'i lus 'di yang*/ /tha ma rus pa'i phung por gda' 'o/ /rang ser snas 'bad 'bungs bsags pa yi/ /nor kun yang sus thob dang bgo bshar byed/ /da lta zas gos kyi 'byor pa yang*/ /ro shun dang ro zas kham gcig yin/ khong kha drag dpung pa 'dzom pa yang*/ /dus nges med 'chi ba byung ba'i tshe/ /nor mnga' thang longs spyod kun bor nas/ /slar ngan song gsum du 'grim pa mthong*/ lar mi rtag 'dus byas spyi lugs yin/ /don 'di la bsams nas chos la 'bungs/ /byams snying rje phyogs med du skyong ba dang*/ /'phral gang shar la zhen med du skyong ba dang*/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ /dus gnas skabs kun tu rin po che/ /pha bla mar yid ches blos khel gyi/ /snying thag pas gsol ba 'debs par 'tshal/ /lar nam yang bslu pa med par nges/ /nges 'byung dang snying rje mos gus dang*/ /zhen med yengs med du skyong ba ste/ /don bzhi po 'di la 'bad gyur na/ /'dun ma rtse la phyin pa yin/ /zhes pa yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ dad ldan gyi slob ma nyi ma rnam rgyal la gdams pa ste/ gong dkar du'o// //༈ yang zhal gdams gcig la/ ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nyams len snying por dril ba ni/ /kun rdzob snying rje chen po dang*/ /don dam spros dang bral ba yin/ /dag snang lha sku'i lam khyer ni/ /sngags kyi snying po'i nyams len yin/ /bde sdug 'phral rkyen zhig byung yang*/ /gang byung lam du 'khyer ba las/ /zab pa'i nyams len ci zhig yod/ /rab gsal rgyal po'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /gnad 'di gzigs nas thugs kyi sras/ /byams pa'i dpal la gdams pa yin/ /bdag nyid bde zhing skyid pa na/ /mar gyur 'gro ba thams cad kyang*/ /skyid par 'dod pa kho na yin/ /bdag bde gcig pus mi phan

gyi/ /'di kun bde ba thob na snyam/ /yang yang yid la bsam par zhu/ /skyid na bde ba tshogs su bsngo/ /phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar shog /ces pa ngag tu yang yang brjod/ /gal te bde ba 'dod na ni/ /dge ba'i las la brtson dgos pas/ /dge la 'bad par bya snyam dang*/ khams gsum 'gro ba 'di kun yang*/ /dge la 'khod par gyur cig ces/ /smon sems yang yang gtong bar zhu/ /rang gzhan dge la 'jug pa'i thabs/ /nan tan sgrub pa gal re che/ /skyid pa kun rdzob lam khyer yin/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal byung ba'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal can la snying rje sgom/ /sdig pa'i las lam zlog par bya/ /skyid na byams pa'i lam 'khyer dang*/ /sdug na snying rje lam du 'khyer/ /skyid dang sdug par snang ba yang*/ /'khrul ngo tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ yang dag don la grub pa med/ /lus ni bem po ro dang 'dra/ /'dod yon ji snyed stabs gyur kyang*/ /skyid pa'i tshor ba mi 'byung zhing*/ /dum bur gtubs sam mes bsregs kyang*/ /de la sdug bsngal ci yang med/ /lus med na ni sems de yang*/ /bstan du med cing thogs med phyir/ /yul dang 'brel ba'i bde sdug med/ /lus dang sems las gzhan pa zhig /sdug bsngal myong ba med pas na/ /skyid bya skyid byed 'khrul pa ste/ /sdug bya sdug byed yod ma yin/ /med pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog /snang ngor bde sdug ma 'gags kyang*/ /de la 'dzin zhen zlog pa yin/ /'dzin zhen med na 'phral rkyen ni/ /ji tsam mang zhing bogs kyang che/ /nags kyi me la rlung byung na//me yi grogs su 'gyur ba yin/ /'dzin zhen can gyi gang zag de/ /skyid na chags zhen dbang song nas/ chos min spyod pa sna tshogs 'ong/ /sdug na nyams thag sems 'phyo zhing*/ /nyams len chos la yi chad byed/ /nyin gcig na ba tsam la yang*/ / the tshom rnam rtog brgya phrag ldang*/ /nas bre gang gi phyogs su yang*/ g.yo sgyu mgo skor sna tshogs byed/

/nyin gcig skyid pa byung ba la'ang*//chos min sna dgu sems la 'gyu/ /bde sdug phra mo tsam la yang*/ /nyams len dpyad thag yan nas mchi/ /zhen med lam 'khyer shes tsa na/ /rkyen ngan me ltar 'bar na yang*/ /nyams rtogs dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel/ /bde sdug snang ba'i sems 'di yang*/ /snang ba tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba yin/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs pa/ /ri bong rwa ltar cang med yin/ /da ltar na yang ma dmigs pas/ /'khrul ngo ma gtogs don la med/ /de ltar rig pas dpyod pa 'tshal/ /dpyad pa tsam la ma bzhag par/ /rang bzhin ngang der mnyam par zhog /rang ngo shes pas tshir gyi zung*/ /bde sdug snang ba'i sems de yang*/ /lha skur lam gyis gsal btab nas/ /'gro ba kun la snying rje dang*/ / gang snang spyan ras gzigs su sgom/ /yi ge drug pa'i gsang sngags bzla/ /stong pa lha sku snying rje gsum/ /sku gsum lam 'khyer ngo sprod yin/ /bab la 'dus pa'i gdams ngag 'di/ /nyams len mdzod cig stan gcig pa/ /zhes pa'ang stan gcig pa rab 'byams smra ba sbyin pa rin chen dang*//dpal 'byor rnam rgyal zhes pa gnyis kyi bskul nas tā ra nā thas gong dkar du smras pa'o// //dge legs 'phel/ /༈ bsod nams bu khrid la gdams pa'o// ༈ 'gro kun dga' ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /snying po'i bstan pa rgyas byed cing*/ /thar pa'i lam ston mjal gyur nas/ khyod la phan bde rab rgyas shog /dad ldan mas nges 'tshal ba/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba bzhi po 'dir 'dus/ dad pa brtan pa/ bsam pa bzang ba/ las 'bras la rtsi ba/ nga rgyal spangs pa ste bzhi yi/ dang po dad pa ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba/ mdzad spyod thams cad 'gro don du len pa/ gdung shugs drag po 'bral ba med pa rnams dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang*/ gsung rab kyi po ti dang*/ /chos pa bzhir longs pa lta ci smos/ chos pa'i gzugs tsam yod pa la yang*/

skur ba mi 'debs/ sdig mi gsog pa gcig 'tshal/ gnyis pa bsam pa bzang ba ni/ gal che gzhan la byed pa/ gzhan la phan thogs na rang la gnod kyang bzod pa/ zhor thabs su yang gzhan la gnod pa gtan mi byed/ phan ci thogs thogs su sgrub/ dgra la zhe sdang drag po dang 'khon 'dzin mi bya/ gsum pa las 'bras la rtsi ba ni/ sdig pa che chung thams cad la 'dzem/ dge ba chung ba la brnyas bcos mi byed/ chen po la blor mi shong ba med pa/ 'phral nyin re bzhin phyag 'bul/ mchod pa/ bskor ba byed/ smon lam 'debs/ zla re bzhin bsnyen gnas len/ lo dus su tsha tsha 'debs pa dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ gtsug lag khang la mchod pa byed/ bzhi pa nga rgyal spangs pa ni/ 'di tsho 'gangs chung*/ nga rang 'di tsam yin/ pho grung mo grung bya ba nga yin snyam nas gzhan la brnyas bcos byas na/ skyes bu dam pa gang na yod mi shes pas/ de 'dra la nga rgyal gyis brnyas na tshe 'di'i bsod nams nyams/ skye ba phyi ma yi dwags lba ba can du skye/ des na brnyas pa mi byed gus pa bya/ nga rgyal rang mthong che 'dod spangs na rigs mtho bar skye ba lags// //zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas gdams pa'o/ /maṅgalaṃ// dge'o//༈ oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo mtshan ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bu'i don po dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo gros dpal bzang ba la/ nyams len gnad bskul gyi rim pa cung zad bri bar bya ste/ spyir chos thams cad kyi 'jug sgo nges 'byung dang sems bskyed gnyis yin/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab gnyis yin/ mthar phyin byed rang don dang gzhan don gyi spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin/ 'bras bu chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis yin/ de ltar don brgyad kyi chos spyi'i nyams len 'bras bu dang bcas pa bsdus pa lags so/ /de yang 'khor ba mtha' dag don dam par med bzhin du snang ba yin pas zhen pa'i yul stongs/ gnas skabs kun rdzob tu yang mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin pas zhen rin yang mi chog

ci byas sdug bsngal gyi g.yos las ma 'das pas zhen pa'i rgyu med/ gal te zhen na sdug bsngal las thar dus med pa zhig yong bas nam yang zhen du mi rung*/ rgyu mtshan bzhi po 'di shes na nges 'byung snying thag pa nas skye ba yin/ kun rdzob rang bzhin med par shes pas/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje bskyed/ don dam de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams 'gro ba thams cad la khyab par mthong bas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la skye 'gro kun 'god pa'i snying stobs rgyas pa/ 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas gces pa'i sems can rnams sgrol ba'i do gal rang la bab bar shes pa'i lhag bsam dang*/ phyogs cha nye ring spangs ba'i btang snyoms chen po ste/ bzhi po de 'dzom na sems bskyed rnam dag mi yong ba'i thabs med do/ /bying rgod dang bral ba'i sems dang ba dang*/ dmigs med du ci 'dod bzhag chog pa'i dbang sgyur pa dang*/ grim lhod ran pas lus sems mi bde ba med pa dang*/ dmigs med du shes pas ting 'dzin nyid la yang ma chags pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin rnam dag tu 'gro ba la bzhi po de tshang dgos/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bslu bar shes pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi gnyis snang thams cad gdod ma nas stong par shes pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings gang du yang dmigs su med pa la sems ro gcig tu thim pa'i nyams myong dang*/ nyams myong de'i rtsal cir yang 'char thub pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug ste/ bzhi po 'di dang ldan na/ theg chen gyi lta ba rnam par dag pa'i lhag mthong de yod pa lags/ spyir byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad gzhan don yin kyang*/ zhor la rang don rgya chen po gtso bor 'grub pa'i spyod pa rnams la rang don gyi spyod pa zhes bya ste/ de yang bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du shes pa dang*/ mthar thug sems can sgrol bar 'dod pas/ gnas skabs bdag nyid byang chub la 'dun pa drag po dang*/

mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs yon tan gyi khyad par mang po sgrub pa la brtson pa dang*/ rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa dang 'brel ba ste/ bzhi po des phyin drug sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ci spyad kyang/ rang don rlabs po che yin la/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi bsam pa dang*/ yi rang dang bsngo ba'i sbyor ba dang*/ chos dang zang zing dang*/ lus dang*/ bya rtsol gyi sgo nas dngos su sems can la phan 'dogs pa dang*/ ji ltar sgom pa thams cad gzhan don du dmigs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis zhing sbyong ba dang*/ sems can smin par byed pa dang*/ brgyud nas sems can la phan 'dogs pa ste/ bzhi po 'di dang 'brel ba'i spyod pa thams cad gzhan don lags/ rang don gzhan don la ldog chas phye ba mang ngo*/ /nges 'byung dang*/ shes rab dang*/ rang don gyi spyod pa rnams kyi rang 'bras chos sku ste/ de yang spros bral mkhyen pa dang*/ rten 'brel mkhyen pa dang*/ rang bzhin dbyings dang ye shes zung 'jug dang*/ 'phrin las lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i thugs rje dmigs pa med pa'i ngo bor gnas pa ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yin no/ /sems bskyed dang ting nge 'dzin dang gzhan don gyi spyod pa'i rang 'bras ni/ gzugs sku yin te/ mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ ye shes dang smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba dang*/ gang la gang 'dul du snang bas gar yang phyin pa dang*/ yul dus thams cad du mdzad pa ma 'khrugs shing don med du mi 'gyur ba ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yin no/ /lam des 'bras bu de 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sems nyid gdod ma nas spros pa thams cad bral ba/ kun rdzob chos can 'khrul pa'i snang ba thams cad dang*/ /don dam chos nyid ma 'khrul pa'i ye shes thams cad 'char ba'i nus pa can yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'grub pa yin no/ /de rnams blo yul du nges nas/ skabs kyi don cung zad brjod pa la/ bdag nyid kyi bstan pa'i bya ba rang gzhan tshul khrims rnam dag la 'god pa dang*/

nyan bshad la brten nas gdul bya spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ blo gros kyi snang ba ci rigs pa bskyed pa rnams kyang/ bsam pa zang zing med cing byang chub sems kyis zin na gzhan don rlabs po che yin/ gzhan gzhi tshul khrims la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab dang sgom byung rnam par dag pa la 'god thub na/ gang dag gcig la stong nyid kyi lta ba rnam par dag pa skyes pas kyang thos bsam kho na can gyi sde snod 'dzin par grags pa brgya stong thon pa las gzhan don rlabs che ba yin/ ting nge 'dzin ltar snang skyes pa las ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnam par dag pa la thos bsam byung na brgya stong 'gyur gyi de rang dga'/ phugs kyi gzhan don de rang che/ brdzun kho nas bzang por 'chos pa'i sgom chen dang*/ las 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i stong nyid dang*/ blun sgom bying ba bsags pa'i zhi gnas te/ 'di gsum dam chos 'jig pa'i rgyu chen yin lags so/ /yang gnas skabs su bdag nyid la sgom byung gi mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan med bzhin du gzhan gyi bla ma ltar brdzu ba ni shin tu nyes pa che'am snyam na/ 'di la gnyis yod de/ rang gi rnyed bkur grags pa 'dod pa dang*/ rang gzhan la chags sdang gi dbang du song ba yin na/ ngan 'gro'i gting rdo yin/ gcig tu bstan pa dang dge 'dun la phan pa'i bsam pa snying thag pa nas gzhan don skyong*/ dngos su yang phan thogs nges pa rnams bya/ dad rdzas la sogs pa longs spyod par mi 'os pa rnams la ci nus kyis 'dzem zhing*/ yo byad thams cad dge bar bsgyur ba dang*/ 'phran bu mi spyod ka med rnams gzhan la phan na bdag nyid nyes par gyur kyang sla snyam pa'i bdag gzhan brje ba dang*/ 'di ni mi 'os pa'i bya ba zhig go snyam pas bshags pa dang sgrib sbyong la 'bad par byas na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa khyad par can du 'gro ba yin/ so so skye bo'i gzhan don phal cher don med du 'gro ba ma yin nam snyam na/

dngos su thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la 'god thub pa nyung ba la dgongs pa yin gyi/ de min chos kyi 'brel ba thogs phyin/ phugs don med du 'gro ba mi srid/ yang gzhan don gyi gnas skabs su rang la bzang 'dzin gyur na/ ting nge 'dzin mtho rab yod kyang phung 'gro na/ gzhan lta ci smos/ de 'joms pa la 'di ltar bsam dgos/ kun rdzob kyi dngos po thams cad med bzhin du snang ba la/ nga rgyal dang bzang 'dzin skye ba las g.yas chung ba ci yod/ rmi lam du rgyal srid thob pa la rgyal por rlom pa dang 'dra/ gal te bden par yod du chug kyang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa sogs la brtags na/ khyod kyi 'di tsam gyi cir yang mi phyin/ gzhan don yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang mi gda'/ 'phral gyi phun tshogs dang lang long ni/ mi sdig can dmyal bar 'gro kha ma 'dra la'ang gda' 'o/ /zhes rang gi rang la brda sbyor dgos/ yang nyams len dang gzhan don spyod pas ngal ba dang*/ sgyid lug par gyur na 'di ltar bsam ste/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi/ gzhan don du sku dang*/ rgyal srid sbyin par btang ba la yang grangs med/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don du zhabs ya gcig btsugs te/ lo brgyad khrir bzhugs pa sogs mdzad snang*/ khyod kyis 'khos 'dis byang chub ta ga la thob/ lto gos dang nor dang gtam gyi phyir du ci yang zhig byed nus pa la/ chos phyir dka' ba cung zad zhig kyang spyod mi nus pa 'khos 'di 'dra'am/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ ha cang skyo shas che na yi mug yin/ /des kyang mi phan spro ba skyed pa gces/ /mi lus thob cing dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ /bla mas rjes bzung 'di las skyid pa ci/ /ha cang spro na rnam g.yeng rgod bag yin/ /nges 'byung sgom pas de la gnya' gnon mdzod/ /zhum par gyur na gzengs bstod 'di ltar bsam/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs na dud 'gro'i lus kyis kyang*/ /byang chub mchog gi lam du nges 'jug na/

/bdag gis ci phyir mi nus zhes su bsam/ dregs pa skyes na rang gi gnas tshul la/ /drang por bsams pa nyid kyis zhi bar 'gyur/ /kun kyang thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bzang ngan mtho dman bde sdug yod med pas/ /spros bral dbyings la mnyam par bzhag gyur na/ /gegs dang gol sa thams cad rang grol yin/ /zhes pa 'di ni rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nye bar gdams te/ ngo mtshar can gyi dam chos 'di/ khyod kyi thugs su son pa dang*/ /shākya'i mtshan 'chang rgyal dais kyang*/ /nges par byin gyi rlobs par 'gyur/ /shar phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ /don gnyis rlabs chen 'grub pa dang*/ /myur du bla ma'i zhabs bsten nas/ /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /maṅga laṃ// //༈ oṃ swā sti/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma la/ /lus ngag yid gsum phyag 'tshal nas/ /nyams len sgrub pa'i man ngag cig /mdo tsam bdag gis gsol bar bgyid/ /de la 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal yin pas/ sems rgyud chos su song ba zhig ma byung na/ gzhan 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gang gis kyang phan med/ nam 'chi cha med mi lus rnyed dka' bas chos nyams len la phyi shol byed mi nyan/ rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa phun tshogs ci dgar bor ba ni snying stobs mchog tu gyur pa lags mod/ de nyid la dgos pa bla na med pa'i byang chub rang don/ chos kyi sku spros bral gyi dbyings rtogs pa dang*/ gzhan don 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du nam mkha'i mthas gtugs kyi 'gro ba thar par 'dren pa yin pas/ de gnyis la thugs gcig tu brnags par 'tshal/ srid pa snying po med pa la snying po'i don blang pa'i phyir/ rtse gcig tu sgrub tu yong zhes skal pa bzang*/ de yang tshe 'di phyi'i 'khor ba la zhen pa yod na chos rnam dag tu mi 'gyur/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems ma 'byongs na theg dman du gol/ phyogs 'dzin dang chags sdang gi dbang las/ rang rgyud ma dul na chos kyi dgos pa stor/

snang grags la bden par 'dzin na gnas lugs kyi don mi rtogs/ des na cis kyang dgos med kyi nges 'byung dang gcig bzod med kyi snying rje shugs drag dang gnyis/ dag snang gi 'khor lo bskor ba dang gsum/ a 'thas kyi 'khrul pa bshig pa dang bzhi/ chos bzang po 'ong mi 'ong bzhi po 'di yod med la rag las/ khyad par dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma dam pa yin/ blo rtse gnyis la byin rlabs mi 'byung bas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig kho na la gsol ba btab pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yin tshad kyi byin rlabs 'jug mos gus de yang sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor shes pa'i ltag tshan che ba/ gdung shugs drag pos ngar rno ba/ ci mdzad gzhan don du mthong ba'i ngos rgyas pa/ gang la yang dpyad pa mi byed pa'i thag chod pa ste/ bzhi po de tshang na/ rtogs pa mi skye ba'i thabs med/ rtsa ba mos gus rang la 'dus/ gzhan yang deng sang gi sgom chen pa phal cher/ bskyed rim bzlas sgom la g.yas chung ngu byed/ yang stong nyid kho na la gdeng yod dam snyam na/ bsrung pa dang 'dre 'dul sogs sngags thu thu dang*/ gdams ngag sad sud cig la ka re ste/ de gnyis 'gal ba yin/ rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud thams cad du bskyed rim gal po cher gsungs/ dag snang gi 'khor lo bskor ba la shin tu zab/ des na lus la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i don du bskyed rim/ ngag la nus pa rnyed pa'i don du bzlas brjod la nan tan du zhu/ bskyed rim rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum rang gi blo dang 'tsham par sgom pa las/ khab mig tu mdzug gu 'jug pa bzhin mi dgos/ rlung sems kyi 'jug pa ma dag na sems kyi 'khrul pa mi zhig des na rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor man ngag zhal shes dang byin rlabs kyi bka' babs su ldan pa la nan tan du sgrubs pas/ rlung sems la 'jur ba zhig dgos/ ri khrod du rdzogs rim sgom pa la/ lus sbyong kyang gegs sel dang bogs 'don du gal che ba zhig 'dug

de thams cad kyi snying po phyag rgya chen po gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa la 'gril ba yin/ 'di'i man ngag ni sems ma bcos so mar 'jog pa kho nar 'dug rang rig rang gsal rjen ne ba la gnas pa 'di zhi gnas skyon med pa yin/ de la brten te rang sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa yin la/ sems kyi gnas lugs de ni gzhi gdod ma nas cir yang ma grub kyang 'dug pa de'i rang zhal lta shes na sgom chen du sleb pa yin/ de nyid rtag tu 'khyongs na sgom lam du longs pa yin/ sgom yang ma dgos na gnas lugs lhod du gyur pa yin pas/ de srid du nan tan 'tshal/ des na da ltar thun gyi gnas skabs su bla ma'i mos gus la gzhi byas/ phyag rgya chen po la mthil du byas/ bskyed rdzogs gzhan rnams la bogs 'byin du byas nyams su bzhes pa dang*/ thun mtshams su phyag dang mchod pa smon lam klog pa sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa la yang gang 'grus su 'tshal zhing*/ dge sbyor thams cad bzang 'dzin dang zhen pas ma bcings pa'i ngang nas spyod pa zhu/ dam pa rnams kyis gcig nas gcig /'bad pas gdams pa'i snying gtam yang*/ /'di las gzhan na yod min pas/ /thugs la chongs shig skal ldan mchog/ // ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas gdams pa'o/ /maṅgalaṃ//༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /nyams len gdams pa mdo tsam zhig /bu yi don po khyod la gdams/ khyod kyi thugs dang 'phrod par smon/ /da res rten mi lus khyad par can thob pa la nyams len sgrub pa snying por byed pa gal che zhing*/ de yang gang sne zin zin nas sgom pas kyang*/ don chen po 'grub pa srin mod kyi/ 'on kyang nyams len la rkang sgril rgyu yod pa gal che/ des na re zhig rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i drod ma thob kyi bar du nyams len khrigs chags lam gyi lus tshang ba zhig nges par dgos/ drod thob pa yan chad nyams len la rkang grangs med/

khrigs chags thams cad zhig pa yin mod kyi/ grub pa'i spyod pa yin pas/ rang cag las dang po pas de mi 'chun/ 'dir lam cha tshang ba'i tshad kyang gang yin snyam na/ tshe 'di lta ci smos/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la blo gting nas log pa'i nges 'byung*/ ci byed gzhan don du 'gyur ba'i byang sems dang*/ blang dor 'gal 'khrul med pa'i spyod pa rnams lam gyi gzhi rten shin tu gal che/ lam gyi dngos gzhi dbang gis rgyud smin pa dang*/ bskyed rim lha sgom sngags bzlas kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa dang*/ rdzogs rim rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i bde gsal gyi nyams shar ba dang*/ de thams cad 'dzin zhen dang bral ba'i lta bas rgyas thebs pa ste bzhi po de rnams tshang dgos/ de kun yang chos rgyud tha dad pa sna tshogs kyi 'kho 'kho bsdus pa tsam ma yin pa/ bka' babs kyi chu bo gcig las byung ba gal che/ snying po lag len du dril ba la thun bzhir dge sbyor gang byed kyang thog mar nges 'byung dang*/ byang chub kyi sems yid 'gyur ba thon nges pa dang*/ bar bar thams cad du nges 'byung dang snying rjes bskul ma 'debs pa gal che/ thun bzhir bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len cha tshang bar sgom zhing*/ gtum mo sogs rdzogs rim la gnad du bsnun pa ste/ lam myur khyad zab cing gal che ba zhig lags na'ang*/ rang re na tshod bag tsam kyang song*/ nyams myong can gyi bla ma dang yang thag ring pas/ gegs sel bogs 'don sogs ji bzhin yong ba dka' ba'i phyir/ rdzogs rim thun ma chag tsam la chog shes bya zhing*/ bcur bcur ma yin pa'i ngos nas/ lha sgom sngags bzlas gang 'grub dang*/ thun mtshams su chos spyod dge sbyor yang ma sun pa'i ngos nas ci 'grub bya/ thun thun mtshams dge sbyor spyod lam thams cad du gang shar ngos gzung thams cad bral ba la ma bcos so ma klong yangs su skyong ba gal che/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i mnyam bzhag skyong thub na rtag 'grus su 'tshal zhing*/

khyad par bla ma'i mos gus drag po rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs pa rnam pa kun gal che/ mdo 'don pa dang*/ gtor ma gtong ba dang*/ phyag mchod sāts+tsha gdab pa sogs kyang nus na gang 'grub bya zhing*/ dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsngo bas rgyas thebs pa la gcig tu nan tan 'tshal/ tshe spel ba sogs 'dod lha 'phran bu'i bsnyen bsgrub/ bskyed rdzogs dngos gzhi tshar re song ba'i gzhug tu/ sngar gyi de kha'i rtsis zin pa'i khog nas byed pa gal che/ rang gi dge sbyor ma chags pa'i ngos nas gzhan phan cung zad 'grub na'ang 'gal ba med pas 'tshams par re mdzad par zhu/ snying po rang re'i mi tshe 'phro ci yod dam pa'i chos la chig 'gril du 'khyol pa zhig ma byung na/ cis kyang mi phan pa la blo che gtod dgos pa lags so/ khyed la gdams pa ji bzhin du/ kho bo'ang de ltar smon pa lags/ /'o skol spyod tshul gcig gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog/ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas don ldan gyi slob bu dge 'dun dpal 'phel la gdams pa'o// //bkra shis/༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ mtha' bzhi'i spros pa las grol ba/ /gnyis med ye shes bde chen dngos/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud/ /gdams ngag mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus thob dus su/ /don yod kyi thabs la 'bad par 'tshal/ /mtshan ldan rje dang mjal dus 'dir/ /mos gus rgyun chad med par 'tshal/ /gdams ngag zab mo thob dus 'dir/ /rtse gcig tu 'bad pas nyams len 'tshal/ /nges don snying po dang mjal dus 'dir/ /drang don gyi mgo bskor la ma zhen zhig /mthun rkyen 'bad med du 'dzom dus 'dir/ /'dod yon gyi g.yeng bas ma 'khyer zhig/nam 'chi cha med kyi don bsam nas/ / nges 'byung gi skyo shas bskyed mod kyi/ /chu bur chu la thim pa bzhin/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i blo brid tsam/ /yi mug gi sdug bsngal mi dgos kyi/ /chos nyid du shes pas skyo se zhog

/rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /rmi lam du na bar snang ba dang 'dra/ /thar 'dod kyi bsam pa bskyed dgos kyang*/ /bden zhen gyi 'jigs skrag mi 'tshal lo/ /dge sdig gi 'bras bu smin pa 'di/ /sgyu mas sgyu ma bskyed pa dang 'dra/ /bden med kyi cho 'phrul tsam lags mod/ /kun rdzob kyi 'khrul snang ma 'gags par/ /rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mi bslu pas/ /spang blang la phra zhib mdzad pa zhu/ /'gro drug drin can gyi pha ma rnams/ /rang ngo ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /rang sems kyis rang nyid bcings tshul la/ /bsam bzhin du snying rje 'bad med du 'char/ /byams snying rje'i rang ngo bltas pa'i tshe/ /snying rje bya rje byed dbyings su yal/ /dbyings de las snying rjer lam lam pa/ /dmigs med kyi snying rje chos kyi mchog /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad/ /gdod nas skye ba med pa la/ /blos byas kyi bcas bcos mi dgos pas/ /ci yang ma yin lta ba'i mchog /shugs 'byung gi spyod pa 'gag med la/ kun brtags kyis spang blang mi dgos pas/ /rang grol rgya 'byam gyi rnal 'byor la/ /tho cor ma song ba spyod pa'i gnad/ /gnas lugs cir yang med pa la/ /sgom med yengs med du mnyam par zhog /snang ba ci shar 'gag pa med/ /du ma ro gcig bsgom pa'i gnad/ /re dogs kyi zhags pas ma bcings bar/ /sku gsum lhun grub rang rdzogs 'di/ /rang sems las gzhan du med lags pas/ /rtsol bral byar med 'bras bu'i gnad/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma la mos gus dang*/ /dag snang phyogs med kyi bskyed rim dang*/ /rlung sems la gzhur ba'i rdzogs rim gsum/ /sgom nyams len pa la gnad du che/ /zhes pa nges med kyi rgyal khams pa/ /tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas/ /rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la gzhol ba yi/ /mdo khams pa shes rab dpal la gdams pa'o// //dge'o/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu snang ba sems la khyad par med/

/gang shar bzo bcos med par zhog /snying rje dang stong nyid 'gro ldog gcig /snying rje 'dzin par ma shor zhing*/ /stong nyid chad stong du ma lus pa'i/ /zung 'jug nyams len gal re che/ /las 'bras kyi blang dor phyin ci log /cis kyang dgos med kyi nges 'byung stor/ /gzhan phan mkha' khyab kyi sems bral pa'i/ /stong skad sbad kham gyi phyag chen dang*/ /mu stegs pa'i lugs kyi rtsa rlung la/ /blo rtse gtod pa'i sgom chen te/ /blo chung gi mgo bskor mkhas srid kyang*/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lam las gol/ /bu sangs rgyas gsung bzhin sgrubs gyur na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu yin pas/ /bzang 'dod kyi tsab tsob ma mang bar/ /lus ngag yid gsum chos dang bstun/ /lta ba mtho la yangs pa dang*/ /spyod pa zhib tig skabs su babs/ /sgom pa yengs med rgyun chad med/ /de gsum 'dzom na 'bras bu smin/ /bza' btung don gnyer gyi kha spyang can/ /rgyal khams bskor ba'i zog po la/ /sgom chen gyi dri yang mi yong bas/ /dben pa'i ri la tshugs par 'tshal/ /long gtam la chags shing zhen pa des/ /ngag gi bden tshig ga la 'grub/ /nus na gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod gyis/ /min na'ang smra ba bcad na legs/ /mthun 'jug dang mi dga'i ngos bsrungs kyis/ /sems bzhag kyang chags sdang 'phel ba'i ngang*/ /'di spangs kyang 'phongs pa dka' ba'i phyir/ /pad kyis chod la rgyangs kyi bskyur/ /nyams myong cung zad skyes skabs su/ /bzang 'dzin skyes na bdud kyis khyer/ /dpe ri la 'dzems pas g.yang la lhung*/ /mtho ru song gin sgrim pa gces/ /bla ma'i zhal lung gi gdams ngag rnams/ /chud zos med par nyams su long*/ /ham pa dang 'ud gog ma che bar/ /rtse gcig tu sgoms na 'tshed pa yin// //zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ rgyal bzang rtogs ldan rin bkras la gdams pa ste/ dar yul brag nag du'o// maṅgalaṃ//༄༅/ na mo gu ru/

pha gcig chog rgyal po bla ma la/ /dus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag bu slob kyi blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /sems mkha' khyab rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus da res mthun rkyen kun 'dzom zhing*/ /mtshan ldan rje dang mjal ba dang*/ gdams ngag zab dgu thob dus 'dir/ /don med du ma lus pa cis kyang 'tshal/ /lus sha khrag 'dus pa'i phung po la/ /rtag 'dzin gyi yid brtan mi rung bas/ /dge sbyor phyi shol ma byed par//'phral 'phral du lag len la thebs par mdzod/ /nyams su ma myong ba'i stong shob can/ /stong nyid kyi rbad gog khar khyer nas/ /nag po kha 'byams su song nyen gdog /las 'bras la zhib tig gal re che/ /mos gus gdung ba rgyun chad med/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs la nan tan mdzod/ /de la'ang bden zhen mi 'tshal te/ /bla ma'ang rang sems las logs na med/ /rang ngo ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /tshugs med kyi snying rje gal re che/ /bden med kyi 'khrul pas bslus pa yi/ /bde sdug kun rmi lam lta bur ltos/ /rang sems tha mal gyi shes pa 'di/ /bcas bcos mi dgos chos sku yin/ /rnam rtog gi 'char sgo ci shar yang*/ chu dang rlabs bzhin go bar gyis/ /spyod pa zhib rtsing ji ltar yang*/ /ngo lkog gi rdzun rib mi 'tshal te/ /de yang chos dang mthun pa gces/ /chos 'gal gyi sgom chen phaṭa tshar re/ /sgom pa 'khor yug rgyun chags te/ /byar med las med gal re che/ /de yang rtsol med kyi dran pas bzung*//mun thom du lus na the le le/ /'bras bu rang sems sangs rgyas 'di/ /gzhi thog tu zob stong lam las shing*/ /re dogs kyi g.yang sar ma lhung pa/ /thag chod kyi shes pa'i nges shes dgos/ /gang snang thams cad chos sku la/ /phyogs 'dzin gyi dbye ba med lags mod/ /gcam bu'i dag snang 'dis rang tshugs skyel/ /bla ma'i brgyud pa zin par mdzod// //ces pa 'di ni rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/

las stod spa lung gi rnal 'byor pa 'ga' la gdams pa'o// //༄༅/ /mnga' ris se ri ba phyogs su sems ma lha lha tshe ring la mya ngan bsal ba'i don du bskur ba'o// ༈ oṃ swā sti/ 'du byed ston ka'i sprin bzhin g.yo ba dang*/ /tshe srog nam mkha'i glog ltar mi brtan zhing*/ /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'gro/ /lang tsho ldan pa'i lus kyang 'jig 'gyur bas/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du phan nges pa'i/ /dge ba'i las la rtse gcig 'grus par 'tshal/ /las ni chung yang 'bras bu rgya che na/ /dge sdig chen po bsags la smos ci dgos/ /nam zhig sha khrag phung po 'gyes pa dang*/ /sems nyid skye ba gzhan du 'pho ba'i tshe/ /dam pa'i chos las skyabs gzhan ma mchis shing*/ /sdig las gzhan du dgra yang ma mchis so/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral pa chos nyid lags/ /bslang ba'i mtha' ni 'gyel bar 'gyur ba dang*/ /bsags pa'i tha ma ring por mi thogs 'dzad/ /gson mtha' 'chi ba yin zhes rgyal bas gsungs//'dren pa rdo rje'i sku yang mi brtan na/ /so so'i skye bo rnams ni smos ci 'tshal/ /ri rab gling bzhir bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di'ang*/ /thal ba tsam yang mi lus 'jig par gsungs/ /de bas rang nyid skye ba dpag med du/ /rab drag dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang*/ /lha mi'i dpal gyi bde skyid nyams pa sogs/ /sdug bsngal mya ngan 'khrug dang yid mi bde/ /grangs med tshad med myong zhing dus 'das kyang*/ /da dung sdug bsngal 'khor lo bskor ba 'di/ /chu gnyer grangs bzhin zin pa mi gda' bas/ /tshul 'di dgongs la mya ngan mi 'tshal te/ /sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ /gzhan la phan par bsam pa'i snying rje yis/ /dge ba'i las la rgya cher 'bad par 'tshal//'bras bu'i don chen mchog la som nyi med/ /lo zla mang por sdug bsngal rgyur 'gyur na/ /nyin gcig skyid pas skyid go mi chod ltar/ /tshe rabs kun tu sdug bsngal rgyur 'gyur ba'i/

/sdig pas tshe 'dir bde na'ang de dang 'dra//tshe 'di yun thung lo zla 'ga' zhig yin/ /'jig rten pha rol tshad bzung med pa'i phyir/ /skye ba gzhan du sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*/ /dge ba'i thabs su dge sdig blang dor bya/ /tshe 'di'i grogs po ji ltar bzang yang 'bral/ /dam chos sgoms na nam yang 'bral mi srid/ /'khor ba'i dpon 'di ji ltar bzang yang bslu/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la bslu ba med/ /zas nor longs spyod 'dzom yang shul du lus/ /bsags pa'i las ni nam yang 'bor mi srid/ /lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa'ang rgas pas 'joms/ /dam pa'i chos la nam yang rgas pa med/ /'jig rten bya ba 'grub kyang zin pa dkon/ /chos la 'bad na las stabs myur du zin/ /'khor ba'i bya ba legs pa'ang tha mar brlag /dam pa'i chos kyi 'bras bu nyams mi srid/ /de ltar lags pas tshul 'dis kyang*/ /nges par thugs ni rab bskul te/ /bdag nyid dge la gnas pa dang*/ /sems can bde ba'i thabs kyang 'tshal// //༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ mtshan ldan bla ma rje la 'dud/ /dad ldan mos pa'i slob ma la/ /don ldan gdams pa cung zad tsam/ /chos ldan bya ba'i ngang nas bsrings/ /nges med 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag 'di/ /rmi lam dus kyi longs spyod bzhin/ /bden bden 'dra yang snying po med/ /bden 'dzin gyi zhen pa mi 'tshal lo/ /rnyed dka' mi lus kyi rin chen la/ /dge legs kyi khye phogs ma thon na/ /dud 'gro'i 'gro ba dang khyad ma mchis/ /sgo gsum dge phyogs la 'bung ba zhu/ /mnga' thang dang longs spyod cher mchis kyang*/ /tshe phyi mar phan pa mi gdog cing*/ /'chi ba yang nam yong cha med pas/ /'phral 'phral du dkar phyogs la 'bad pa zhu/ /rang gzhan gyis gces par bzung pa yi/ /lus 'di yang nam zhig nges par 'jig /gnyen bu rta sogs lta smos ci dgos/ /tshe 'di la ma chags zab don bsgoms/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ni pha mtha' med/

/ gar skyel rang dbang ma mchis shing*/ /phyi ma'i bde sdug ni las la rag /sdig las la cis kyang 'jom par zhu/ /gzhan gang gi phyir du sdig bsags kyang*/ /ngan song la bgo bsha' byed thabs med/ /rnam smin rang nyid kyis 'khur dgos pas/ /gzhan phyir du sdig gsog mi 'tshal lo/ /snang tshad rang sems kyi snang ba yin/ /gang shar la dran pa'i so bas zung*/ /byar med kyi ngang du lhod kyi klong*/ /rang grol gyi rtogs pa nang nas 'char/ /'gro drug drin can gyi pha ma la/ /byams snying rje phyogs dus med par bsgom/ /rang 'dod kyi ngan sems shig gis bshig /phan sems bde 'byam gyi ngang la bzhag /mdza' bshes kyi phyi rjes mthar thug kyang*/ /phyi nas dge ba la 'bad pa dkon/ / gzhan byas kyi dge bas kyang mi phan pas/ /dge ba bdag nyid kyis sgrub par zhu//'phral dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang*/ /lus yi dam lha skur bsgom pa dang*/ /ngag 'khyal pas mi 'da' gzungs sngags bgrang*/ /yid phyag chen dang snying rje zung 'jug sgom/ /'phral lo dus su sbyin pa rgya chen gtong*/ /dus zla rer bsnyen gnas yang yang len/ /gzhan nyin zhag so sor phyag mchod brtson//tshe 'di phyi gnyis kar bde ba lags/ /de kun gyi rtsa ba mos gus yin//mtshan ldan bla ma rin chen la/ /blo lings kyi bkal la gsol ba thob//the tshom gyi rtog dpyod mi 'tshal lo/ /chos thams cad rang gi blos byas yin/ /mos gus kyi snang ba dang ma bral na/ /rtag tu bla ma dang 'grogs pa lags/ /nye ring gi dpyad pa mi 'tshal lo/ /thugs yid dbyer med du gsol ba btab/ /rang sems dang bla ma dbyer med pa/ /'du 'bral med par rtogs tsa na/ /mthar thug gi rtogs pa ngang gis 'char// //zhes pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ /dad ldan bde skyid dpal 'dzom la gdams pa'o// dge'o//༄༅/ /drung pa'o pa la gdams pa'o/ /༈ kho bo rje btsun bla ma yis/ /rjes su bzung la nyer brten nas/

/snyan pa'i tshig la ma ltos par/ /ma sgribs gnyug ma khong nas gsal/ khyed kyang bla ma rin chen la/ /gus pas gsol ba 'debs par zhu/ /'dod dgu thams cad char ltar 'bab/ /gegs dang gol sa bar chad gsum/ /nam gzhug chad kha'i sprin ltar dengs/ /yon tan thams cad rang shar 'byung*/ /tha snyad tshig gi brjod pa la/ /zhen med ngos nas bslab par zhu/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo byed pa la/ /tshogs la dag dang ma dag gnyis/ /rang sems rtogs pa'i khyad par gnyis/ /so so'i spang blang ma 'dres 'tshal/ /dag pa'i 'khor kyang 'dus pa dang*/ /rang nyid rtogs pa 'gyur med na/ /gnas lugs rjen par ston pa las/ /lus ngag spyod la khyad par med/ /ma dag 'khor tshogs 'dus pa'am/ /rang nyid rtogs pa mi brtan na/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo byed pa la/ /gtso bo'i chos bzhi dgos pa lags/ / 'khrul 'khor sngags dang ting 'dzin dang*/ /cho ga rnam par dag pa 'tshal/ / 'khrul 'khor spyod pa btsun pa yin/ /sngags ni smra tshod zin pa yin/ /ting 'dzin grim la bsam pa bzang*/ /cho ga 'khor tshogs skyong ba la/ /snyoms shing 'jam pos skyong ba yin//'gro don gtso bor byed pa'i tshe/ /shākya thub pa'i 'khrul 'khor dgos//nyams len gtso bor byed pa'i tshe/ /drang srong chen po'i 'khrul 'khor 'tshal/ /nyams rtogs phyogs bcur skyong ba'i tshe/ /mkha' lding chen po'i 'khrul 'khor gces/ /nges med spyod la gnas pa'i tshe/ /he ru ka'i 'khrul 'khor mdzod/ /dang po shāka thub 'khrul 'khor ni/ /btsun tshugs zin la ltag tshugs bzang*/ kha ngan 'khrug long mi byed cing*/ /spyod pa bde la khog yangs pa/ kha lag byed pa bzang po yis/ /spyi snyoms byed pa gal re che/ /rtsa ba'i blo gtad ma 'gyur bar/ /phyi nang spang blang ma 'dres 'tshal/ /drag srong chen po'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /'chi ba snying la zug pa yin/ /bde skyid gtam la ma chags par/ /dka' spyad zhe rus byed pa yin/ /mkha' lding chen po'i 'khrul 'khor

ni/ /'dab chags mkha' lding rgyal po de/ /mkha' la 'gro sdod ci byed kyang*/ / sa la mi bog rang dbang yod/ /spyod lam bya ba ci byed kyang*/ /'gyur med klongs su gyur pa na/ /ci byas rang shar rang grol yin/ /nyams rtogs longs spyod rgya cher spel/ /he ru ka'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /nges med spyod pa skyong ba yang*/ /chal chol tsam la ma song bar/ /nyams len gnas la 'chug med dgos/ /'khrul 'khor kun gyi spang bya ni/ /grags 'dod g.yo sgyu yin pas spang*/ /'khrul 'khor spyi'i chos gcig ni/ /drang po lags pas bskyang bar zhu// //༄༅/ /ngam ring su'o// ༈ bla ma rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang la bdud bzhi bcom pa'i dpal/ /zas gtsang sras kyis 'di skad ces/ / bag yod bdud rtsi'i gnas yin te/ /bag med pa ni 'chi ba'i gnas/ /dregs ldan dbang gis phyug pa yang*/ /mi rtag gdon gyis zin pa na/ /mgon med gyur pa'i gnas skabs la/ /chos las gzhan pa'i skyabs ma mchis/ /gang zhig 'byor par ldan pa la/ /nor dang dbyig gis ci zhig 'tshal/ /legs par bshad pa'i tshig gcig la'ang*/ khams gsum nor gyis char mi phod/ /chos med dbang phyug phun tshogs kyang*/ /dug can kha zas bzang po bzhin/ /'byor pa nyams pa chos ldan yang*/ /shun par bcas pa'i nor bu bzhin/ /gang la gnyis ka ldan gyur pa/ /des ni don kun 'grub par mthong*/ /kun spangs kyis ni 'byor ldan kun/ /zil gyis gnon pa rab byung yin/ /mi yi mchog gyur 'bras yod dang*/ /dpal dang ldan pa don yod phyir//sku tshe 'di dang pha rol kun/ /bde 'gyur chos la 'bad par 'tshal/ /nyi zla lhun po rgya mtsho sogs/ / nam zhig gzhan du 'gyur ba na/ /'tshe ba rlung ltar g.yo ba yi/ /mir gyur pa lta smos ci dgos/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal 'di'i/ /cha la'ang bzod par dka' ba dang*/ /mtho ris gnas kyi 'byor pa yang*/ /chu bur bzhin du g.yo bar 'gyur/ /skye rga na 'chi 'jigs dang dbul/

/sdug bsngal mang pos nye bar gces/ /srid gsum 'gro ba 'di kun ni//'du byed kyis ni rnam par 'khyams/ /nyon mongs ldan pa'i dge ba yang*//'khor bar mtho ris 'grub 'gyur bas/ /nyon mongs las dang sdug bsngal gyi/ /'khor lo 'di ni zlog par 'tshal/ /phan bde 'di ni dkon mchog mthu/ /gnas skabs yab yum sogs kyi drin/ /yab mes sogs kyi drin bsab la'ang*/ /dge ba rgya chen sgrub par 'tshal/ /bkur 'os bkur bas bdag nyid la/ /bkur bsti rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /mchod 'os mchod cing bstod 'os bstod/ /gus dang drin du bzo ba'ang mtshungs/ /kun la'ang brtse bar rigs lags na/ /rang la brten pa lta ci smos/ /bde 'dod sdug bsngal spong 'dod par/ /rang gzhan thams cad mtshungs par gzigs/ /gzhan gyi srog dang nor phrogs nas/ /gzhan dag tshim byed lugs bzang min/ /lha khang gi ni rdzas la sogs/ /gzhan la stsal ba lta ci smos/ /lha khang mchod pa dge 'dun dang*/ / dge 'dun mchod pa lha khang la/ / sgyur ba'ang nyes pa cher gsungs la/ /dkon mchog gsum la yongs dmigs pa'i/ /mar me'i 'od la 'dug pa yang*/ /srog chags phal pa bkum pa bas/ / las de sbyang dka' yin zhes gsungs/ /rang gi nongs la gzhan dag gis/ / smad kyang khro bar mi 'tshal te/ /de yang rang gi skyon lags pas/ /skyon ni 'bad pas spang bar 'tshal/ /nga rgyal mi bya rang mi bstod//tshe dang dpal dang chos 'phel na/ /dka' ba'ang dang du len par mdzod//lan 'ga' grub par ma gyur kyang*/ /don chen sgrub la thugs mi zlog/zhing pa tshong pa la sogs bzhin/ /dus gzhan zhig na lan mang dang*/ /'grub par 'gyur ba ma yin nam/ /'gal bgyid gcig kyang mangs ba'i skyon/ /phan bgyid byed pa'ang mi spang ngo*/ /bram pa'i rdo bzhin 'bad pa yis/ /bsal yang gnod byed 'phel bar 'gyur/ / rigs dang mi rigs tshar bcad dang*/ /rjes bzung nad dang zungs bzhin 'tshal/ /gzi lum spyad par mi bgyid cing*/

/gzhan gyi srog la'ang 'tshe mi bgyid/ /dri ma bkrus pa rab mdzes kyi/ /gos dag sreg pa ga la 'dzangs/ / chos don phyin ci log bzung na/ /sman ma zhu ba'i nad dang mtshungs/ /longs spyod 'ga' zhig dgra dang gnyen/ /don med don ldan rnams su dgongs/ /gal te gtam de dag la ni/ /dgyes na slar yang gsol bar bgyid/ /'on te thugs kyis bas gyur na/ /mchid 'di btang pas bde bar 'gyur// //dge'o//༄༅/ /dpon mo nam mkha' rgyal mo la chos kyi 'phrin du bskur ba'o// ༈ oṃ swā sti/ shin tu rnyed par dka' ba ni/ /mi lus shing rta la zhon nas/ /thar pa'i grong khyer 'jug 'dod pas/ /shin tu 'bad pas brtson par rigs/ /brtson 'grus dpung dang bral ba rnams/ /bar chad chom pos bcom zhing brlag/'khor ba'i zam stegs dal 'byor 'di/ /'chi bdag chu bos ma khyer ba/ /de srid 'bad pa cis mi rtsom/ /'bum phrag dpung gi rdul tshub can/ /bang mdzod stong phrag mang 'byor zhing*/ /nad med dregs ldan rgyal po yang*/ /mi bzad gshin rje'i khar chud na/ /dpa' bo'i dmag gis mi phan zhing*/ /g.yog dang nor gyis mi bzlog la/ /gzugs dang lang tshos bslu bar 'gyur/ /shin tu gces shing phangs pa dag /cis kyang ma phan 'das gyur na/ /sems ni zug rngus 'joms 'gyur gyi/ /bdag la phan pa gang yang med/ /'gro ba drug po 'di dag tu/ /byis pa so so'i skye bo 'khums/ /bum par sbrang bu 'khor ba dang*/ /mtshungs zhes nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsungs/ /nam yang 'khor ba bde med pas/ /de las nges par thar 'dod na/ /dngos por 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /yang dag don la gnas par 'tshal/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta'i bar gyi mi dge ba/ /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags sdams 'tshal/ /gzhan gyi chos ldan bya ba gang*/ /mthong thos kun la yi rang na/ /de las rang la dge ba ni/ /shin tu rgya chen thob par 'gyur/

/bdag nyid nga rgyal mi 'tshal zhing*/ /gzhan gyi phun tshogs la mi sdang*/ /ngan pa rnams la brnyas mi bgyid/ /mchod dang sbyin pa rgya cher btang*/ /slob dpon gang la mnyes 'gyur ba/ /de yis bkur bsti mchod pa bya/ /dge ba gang byas sems can dang*/ /lhan cig sangs rgyas rgyu ru bsngo/ / chos tshul mu mtha' ma mchis pas/ /mtha' dag su zhig brjod par byed/ /gang las thabs mkhas thob 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra bdag gis brjod pa lags/ /zhes pa tshig bcad bcu gnyis pa ste/ /tā ra nā thas gtam du brjod pa'o// maṅga laṃ//༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang zhig srid zhi'i phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i 'bras//dal 'byor dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtser chags pa/ /'di las 'dod dgu ci yang blang bar rigs/ /gzhan du 'di 'dra rnyed pa brgya la zhig /ha ri tsan+dan dris rgyas sum rtsen nags/ /ci 'dod dga' bas rol pa'i rtse sa yang*/ / dbang med bor te lo ma ral gri'i tshal/ /bskal par bsten pa 'di ni las kyi mthu/ /rab 'bar gser gyi spo la gnas bcas pa'i/ /rnam thos bu dang dbang po'i 'byor pa yang*/ /dus kyi dbang gis ston ka'i chu 'dzin bzhin/ /dengs par 'gyur ba 'di la su yis bzlog /rig 'dzin dga' ma'i lag pad kyis btud pa'i/ /'chi med sbrang rtsi'i dog pas mi spogs pa/ /bsam btan bdud rtsi'i dga' ston longs spyod can/ /de dag g.yung drung dpal la bde bar rol/ / 'jig rten chos brgyad sgyu ma'i skyed tshal na/ /ngur smrig spu sdug rgyas pa'i ko ki la/ /dam chos snyan sgrogs srid pa'i snye ma la/ /ci dgar chags mod dus gzhan bsam par rigs/ /tshig 'phreng 'dab shog rgyas pa'i rkang drug pa/ /rang bzo dpal 'bras smin pa'i tshogs la 'khrul/ /'dab brgya'i tshal zhes rings par rgyug byed kyi/ /zab don ro mchog nam yang thob pa med/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ri mo bkra ba 'di/ /rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rtsal/ /sa gzhi ri bcas nags tshal ji snyed gzugs/

/ci yang 'char mod rab dwangs mtsho yi ngang*/ /mtshan ldan bla mar mos gus yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu 'di las legs byas ci yang 'byung*/ /shin tu stobs ldan bya ba'i mthu las ni//mtha' dag phra mo 'grub pa dngos po'i gshis/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'i sems 'di sangs rgyas te/ /dbul po'i khyim 'og rin chen 'byung khungs ltar//thabs gzhan cis kyang mtshon par mi nus pa/ /mtshon 'di byin rlabs stobs kyi mthu dpal yin/ /de skad smra pa tā ra nā tha yis/ /blo ldan karma chos bzang zhes bya ba/ /de la dam pa'i chos las brtsams pa yi/ /bka' mchid nyung ngu tsam zhig smras pa lags// // maṅgalaṃ bistā ra ku ru/ dge'o//༄༅/ /grags pa bzang po la'o// ༈ oṃ sā sti/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde sdug chags sdang gi rnam rtog de/ /rang sems gsal stong las gzhan du med/ blo bde dang mi bde 'char sgo kun/ /gang shar la bzo bcos mi 'tshal zhing*/ /rang ngo shes kyis la mnyam par bzhag /dbyings rig dbyer med sprul pa'i sku/ /dus da lta chos sku'i yo langs yin/ /'pho na chos sku'i dbyings su 'pho/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen gyi/ /thugs yid dang rang sems bsres la zhog /bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med la/ /bzo bcos med pas ngo shes 'tshal/ /nged bla ma skye med du ngo shes 'tshal/ khyed rang sems chos skur rtogs nas 'ong*/ /mos gus 'dun pa'i rgyab rten gces/ /yar bla ma'i thugs su 'pho 'dun mdzod/ /zan lhag gi lugs kyi mi che zhing*/ /gdams ngag gi lugs kyi mi mang bas/ /tshig 'di bzhin thugs la nan tan mdzod/ /bu grags bzang gi blo la de ltar zhog/ // maṅgalaṃ//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad la btud nas/ /mdor bsdus snyan bskul bgyid par 'tshal ba la/ /shin tu rnyed dka' bsnyen par dka' ba yi/ /bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pas bsten par zhu/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs kun/ /bla ma dam pa bsten las 'byung zhes gsungs/

/'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i/ /gru chen 'di ni phyi nas thob dka' bas/ /da lta rtse gcig 'bad par ma byas na/ /'bad par bya ba'i dus ni nam zhig yin/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /dam chos ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi grol bas/ /nyin mtshan tshad med dam pa'i chos la 'bad/ /'dun ma thams cad rtse la phyin par gda'/ /sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ /dngos gzhi nyams len gnad kyi snying por bsgril/ /thun 'jug bsngo bas rgyas 'debs rgya cher spel/ /thun mtshams kun tu snying rje'i 'khor lo bskor/ /lam gyi ngo bo gnad gsum rig par bya/ /gang snang dag pa'i 'khor lor spyod pa dang*/ rang bzhin rtsa bral lhun grub mnyam bzhag dang*/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i gnad dang ldan pa'o/ /dge sbyor kun la gcig tu gal che ba/ /bla ma'i mos gus lags pas 'bad de sgoms/ /mkha' lding rgyal po'i 'dab gshog ji bzhin du/ /gang la'ang zhen pa med dang snying rje gnyis/ /brtson 'grus dag snang snying stobs brtan pa gsum/ /'jig rten gsum na rin chen gsum dang mtshungs/ /dad pa ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang*/ dge sdig blang dor gnas la gzab pa ni/ /nyams len rgyal po'i dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi/ /mi mthun dgra 'joms dpa' bo mtshungs pa med/ /drang po'i yid dad bden par smra ba'i ngag /chog shes dang ni chags med dam chos mnyan/ /lnga po 'di dag yon tan sa gzhi lags/ /mtha' bzhi las rgyal dbus su brtan par byed/ /phyogs kun bde bar skyong ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /rgyal po'i bu 'dzom pha rol phyin pa drug /rin chen bdun mtshungs 'phags pa'i nor bdun te/ /yan lag brgyad ldan 'phags pa'i lam kun las/ /gsung rab dgu yi 'khor tshogs bde bar rgyu/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyi bde bar 'tsho ba ni/ /dam chos 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal 'byor lags/ /de skad smra ba'ang tā ra nā tha yin/

/mi mchog thugs mtsho rnam par gang te 'ong*/ /thub gsung sprin las dam chos chu char 'di/ /skal ldan re ba'i zhing sar 'bab min nam/ zhes pa'ang chos rje karma bstan 'dzin la dge bar gdams pa/¿dge legs 'phel// shu bham stu sarba dzā ga taṃ// //༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ mdzu gu gtad sa med pa'i chos dbyings la/ /ci yin med pa'i bla ma bzhugs/ /ti gtad med pa'i mos gus sgoms/ /ngos gzung med pa'i byin rlabs zhu/ /nam zhig rgyun du mos gus sgoms/ /thun 'gor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ /thun gzhug tu bsngo bas rgyas 'debs sgoms/ /rtag tu bsam pa bzang po bya/ /sdig pa la shi 'dzem ro 'dzem gyis/ / yong na dge ba ci 'grub gyis/ /lha khang dang dge 'dun bla ma'i rdzas/ /dug nag po ha la ha la yin/ /'bru gcig kyang kha la ma 'khyer zhig /skud gcig kyang aṃ phrag tu ma 'jug cig /'jig rten gyi kha drag dpung 'dzom la/ /yid smon gyi re ba ma gtod cig /dgon pa sde gog gi 'go mi dang*/ /sdig can gyi dpon po'i thugs zin dang*/ /chos la sdig gsog gi btsun pa gsum//dmyal ba'i gting rdo zhig lags pas spong ba zhu/ /rang rgyud se rengs ye rengs 'di dang gcig /chos la nya dred chu dred 'di dang gnyis/ /nyon mongs me dar chu dar 'di dang gsum/ /bslab sdom kha ral sna ral 'di dang bzhi/ /'phral spyod mi rtsing dgu rtsing 'di dang lnga/ /dam tshig gar nyams 'dir nyams med dang drug /dge sbyor rgya yengs dgu yengs 'di dang bdun/ /'di bdun rang skyon lags pas mtshang nas brus/ /lar la thang med pas ca re sdod//ham pa ma che cum me gyis/ /'gro lugs wa ltar 'dzem pa cig /sdod lugs ri bong ltar bzo ba cig /lab lugs zhum bu ltar snyam pa cig/

rang sems bu chung ltar bzo mod cig /lag len rtsi ltar zhib pa cig /'di lnga lag thog la longs pa cig gyis/ /lus ngag gi spyod pa rtsing pa 'di/ /dam chos 'dul ba dang rgyab 'gal yin/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi gdug sems 'dis/ /theg chen gyi khyu nas 'bud pa lags/ /nyams len med pa'i tha mal pa/ /dag snang chung la rang 'dod che/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan bshig yin/ /'o skol chos gzugs su sgyur phyin chad/ /chos kun dang mthun pa zhig ma byung kyang*//sna gcig dang ma mthun na ci rang btub/ /'di snying gtam gyi nang nas nying khu yin/ /snying dmar por bton kyang 'di las med/ /chos gzugs kyi dkor zan bstan pa'i dgra /tshig 'di la ma mgu yang bya thabs med/ /a la la mdo rgyud thang mar brdal na yang*/ /'gag dril rgyu 'di las 'dug ri shi/ nged rtogs ldan gyi kha nas de ltar thal/ /bu sems la phan na sems la zhog/ sems tshig pa za na chu la skyur/ /bstod ra la dga' na bstod pas chog/ ces kun dga' grags pa la tā ra nā thas gdams pa'o// //༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ pha bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ khyed mos ldan gyi blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /dus da res dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /chos nyams len byed pa'i dus la bab/ /las byas kyin slar yang byed dgos mang*/ /don chung gi bya ba phyi la skyur/ /dgra btul kyin rting la 'dul dgos mang*/ /slar yang sems 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ /gnyen mgu pa las kyang 'khang ba mang*/ /'jig rten gyi gnyen kun sdug bsngal gyi rgyu/ /nor gsogs pa las kyang bsag dgos mang*/ /zhen pa gting nas log pa'i dus la bab/ / sems zin pa las kyang bzung dgos mang*/ /ngo srungs bshol ba kun blo re bde/ /chos bslabs pa las kyang slob dgos mang*/ /don nyams len byed pa khye re che/ /don spyad pa las kyang spyod dgos mang*/ /dal 'byor don med du 'chor nyen gda'/ /'jig rten gyi blo gtad mthong tsa na/

/lha chos kyi skyabs gnas bka' drin re che/ /mkhar kun zhig pa mthong tsa na/ /lus gnad kyi mkhar 'di don re che/ /gang smras mdo med 'di mthong tsa na/ /ngag bzlas brjod byed pa don re che/ /ci bsam sems kyi tsher ma la/ /'dzin med du 'jog pa gnad re zab/ /tshe 'di'i gtan grogs 'bor tsa na/ /nyams rtogs kyi grogs 'di brtan re thub/ /nam yang rgas pa 'dis mi bslu bas/ /de tshun chad chos la bsgyur na bzang*/ /nam yang sdug bsngal 'dis mi slu bas/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad na bzang*/ /nam yang na ba 'dis mi slu bas/ /na tsha lam du khyer na bzang*/ /nam yang 'chi ba 'dis mi slu bas/ /chos phyir du nongs na go yang chod/ /nam yang dam chos 'dis mi slu bas/ /blo gtad bcas na don re che/ /tshe 'di las phyi ma don che bas/ /phyi ma'i grabs shom sems la dris/ /tshig slob pa las kyang sgoms na legs/ /sgom tshul bla ma'i zhal nas dris/ /don mang ba las kyang 'dril ba bzang*/ /don snying por 'dril ba zhig cis kyang 'tshal// // zhes pa'ang kun dga' bde legs 'dzom la gdams pa tā ra nā thas so// dge'o/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /mtshan ldan rje la gus pas 'dud/ /bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la/ /da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa'i/ /'gro drug drin can pha ma la/ /byas pa shes bzhin drin bzo ba'i/ /byams dang snying rje 'bad de sgoms/ /dam chos spyod pa'i mthu ldan pa/ /rnyed dka' mi lus rin chen 'di/ /ston ka'i sprin bzhin yid brtan med/ /nam 'chi cha med bsam par 'tshal/ /shin tu 'bad pa'i longs spyod dang*/ /'bral thabs med pa'i bdog pa kun/ /dbang med du 'jog pa mthong tsa na/ /rtag 'dzin can rnams yi re mug /dam chos nyams len ma gtogs pa/ /las thabs thams cad mdo med yin/ /mtshan ldan bla ma las gzhan pa'i/ /blo gtad thams cad slu rdo yin/

/da res tshe thung 'di 'dra la/ /tshe 'di'i ched kar gtong gtong nas/ /ngan song gi sdug bsngal mi zad rgyu/ /chos min gyi bya ba byed khom mam/ /dam chos su ming btags mi chos dang*/ /gzhan don du ming btags kyi rang 'dod dang*/ /chos gzugs su byas pa'i chos med gsum/ /sems can slu ba'i brdzun khrigs yin/ /blo snying nas chos su song ba 'tshal/ /byams snying rje gting nas 'byongs pa 'tshal/ /dbyings spros med la mnyam par 'jog pa 'tshal/ /don de tsam thugs la 'jog pa zhu// //zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas tshogs bye rdzings kyi gtan gcig pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gdams pa'o// maṅgalaṃ//༈ chos rje rin po che spa lung pa la'o/ / ༈ gang snang mnyam nyid ngo bo'i rtsal/ /nam mkha' bzhin du phyogs lhung med/ /gang byung de la bcos mi 'tshal/ /lhun grub de la cham gyi bzhag /btsir thag med pa'i rang gi sems/ /gu yangs po 'di rgya re che/ /btson du bcug pa'i mi 'ga' zhig / 'bad rtsol dka' spyad chen po yi/ /btson las thar par gyur pa na/ /rtsol ba med par ngang gi bde/ /dang po 'bad rtsol dgos dus su/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang skyon dang 'dre/ /'bad rtsol med par shes tsa na/ /skyon rnams thams cad yon tan yin/ /zhes pa'ang sngar goms nyams len la/ /gsal 'debs tsam du smras pa yin// //maṅga laṃ// dge'o//༈ las stod kyi gnas skor ba 'dra la gdams pa'o/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ ngo mtshar can gyi bla ma la/ /gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ khyed rgyal khams bskor ba'i rnal 'byor kun/ /don 'di bzhin thugs la bzhag pa zhu/ /da res chos dang mjal ba dang*/ /dgos su bla ma mchog la bsten/ /lar skal pa bzang ste a la la/ /dus yun ring dge ba bsags gyur na/ /gnad mchog gyur bla ma'i byin rlabs rnyed/ /bskyed rdzogs dang bzlas brjod la sogs pa/ /rlabs chen gyi dge ba phyogs bcur spel/ /dge ba la 'dzin zhen mi 'tshal bar/

/lhug pa'i ngang nas dge rtsa bsogs/ /dmigs med kyi tshul du smon lam thob/ /zhing gnas chen rnams su 'gro ba na/ /tho co dang 'khrug long mi 'tshal zhing*/ /nyams len gyi rten 'brel sgrig pa zhu/ /gang snang lha sku'i nyams len mdzod/ /dag snang phyogs med du 'char ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod kyang ci nus 'tshal/ /ngag bden tshig 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /gang dgos kyi 'dun pa dung nge ba/ /phaṭa ces rang sar bshig las zhog/ snang ba dbang du 'du ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /rang 'dod med pa'i smon lam thob//'gro don phyogs med du 'char ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /gang snang rang sems kyi ngo bo la dran pa skyongs/ /rtogs pa mngon 'gyur gyi rten 'brel yod/ /nyon mongs gang skyes la ngo shes 'tshal/ /nyon mongs can chos la 'dzud pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor sgom/ /ma mkha' 'gros byin rlob kyi rten 'brel yod/ /gang sdod du mchod gtor la brtson pa zhu/ /bar chad bzlog pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /mos gus kyi gsol 'debs yang yang bya/ /chos brgyud 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /don de dag mtshon byed tsam yin pas/ /rten 'brel sgrig lugs shes te 'tshal/ /phyi nang gi rten 'brel sgrig shes na/ /dgos 'dod dngos grub char ltar 'bab// //ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas nye bar gdams pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ bdag lta so ldan dregs pa'i dgra/ /rgyal ba ri dwags dbang po gang*/ /dpag yas yon tan 'byor pa yis/ khengs pas seṅge'i sgra bsgrags bzhin/ /gnyis med gsung ba'i bstan pa la/ /gus pas blo ldan phyag 'tshal te/ /gdams pa'i sgron me rab sbar bas/ /snyan tshig ri mo'ang gsal bar bya/ / 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i lus/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur dkon/ /mi zad gter chen dam pa ltar/ /phun tshogs thams cad 'di las thob/

/ces pa 'di ni chos kyi dpe/ /lus 'di chu yi sbu ba 'dra/ /dbugs kyang ston ka'i na bun bzhin/ /mtho ris 'byor pa'i dpal 'di yang*/ /rmi lam ltad mo ji bzhin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni dngos po'i dpe/ /zhun mar zad pa'i sgron me 'di/ /'chi bdag gnas su chas pa yi/ /skyes bu'i srog ltar rkyen gzhan la/ /ltos pa med par 'jig pa nyid/ /ces pa 'di ni bzlog pa'i dpe/ /lang tsho dar ba'i lus 'di ni/ /mdzes kyang mi brtan 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /'ja' tshon 'di yang lus bzhin du/ /'dus byas rnams kyi ngang tshul ston/ /zhes pa 'di ni phan tshun dpe/ /'dod yon ri mo rab bkra bar/ /sems 'di rnam par g.yo ba ni/ /bung ba dug gi me tog la/ /rgyug par mtshungs kyi gzhan dang min/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges pa'i dpe/ /rtswa ltar g.yo ba'i sems pa gang*/ /glog ltar bzung du med pa ste/ 'bab chu la sogs rab g.yo ba/ /gzhan yang yod na 'di dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa 'di ni nges med dpe/ /ngan 'gro'i tshor ba mi bzad pa/ /rno ba kho nas spu gri dang*/ /mtshungs pa ma yin 'gro sems la/ /'jigs pa skyed byed kyis kyang ngo*/ /zhes pa 'di ni bsdus pa'i dpe/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba po/ / kun gyis sdug bsngal drag por shes/ /mtho ris 'byor pa sdug bsngal du/ / 'phags pas mkhyen pa 'di gnyis khyad/ /ces pa 'di ni khyad par dpe//mtho ris sgeg mo'i bzhin gyi dpal/ /yod ces pad dkar snyems mi 'tshal/ /rab 'bar shal+ma li nags kyi/ /sring mo la yang de yod phyir/ /zhes pa 'di ni rab btags dpe/ /tshangs gnas bsam gtan bde ba 'di/ /rtag brtan g.yung drung dpal 'dzin na/ /zag med bde bas mngon mtho ba'i/ /thar pa'i gnas dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /ces pa 'di ni rmad byung dpe/ /yid ni rab tu chags bral bas/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzugs sdug dang*/ /dur khrod bor ba'i rus gong ni/ khyad par 'byed la rmongs par gyur/

/zhes pa 'di ni rmongs pa'i dpe/ /ci 'di shing lo'i rtser chags pa'i/ /chu thigs rab tu g.yo ba'am/ /rab tu sred pa'i dbang gyur pa'i/ /mi lus yin zhes the tshom skyed/ /ces pa 'di ni the tshom dpe/ / 'jo sgeg tshul gyis 'gro ba dang*/ /sred ldan mgu ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /ngan skyugs phung bo ma yin gyi/ /ri dwags mig can yin par shes//zhes pa 'di ni rtogs pa'i dpe/ /rtag tu rab 'bar sems gdungs shing*/ /'khor bar spyod pa rnams kyi gnas/ /nyon mongs 'phel ba'i khyim 'di ni/ /lo ma ral gri'i tshal dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa 'di ni sbyar ba'i dpe/ /nga rgyal spangs pa'i dge sgrub dang*/ /sbyin la dga' ba'i mkhas rnams ni/ /gter gyi bdag po ji bzhin du/ / su war+ṇa yi dpal gyis phyug /ces pa 'di ni mnyam nyid dpe/ /rab tu dben pa'i bsam gtan 'di/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i bka' khrims dang*/ /dge chos spel bar mtshungs mod kyi/ /rnam g.yeng yid dang bral bas 'phags/ /zhes pa 'di ni smad pa'i dpe/ /ma lā ya yi nags klung gi /ser bu 'di yis bde bskyed pa/ /bsod nams yongs su smin gyur pas/ /chos thos pa yang de dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa 'di ni bstod pa'i dpe/ /bde ba'am sdug bsngal 'di bskyed ces/ /so sor nges par brjod mi byed/ /'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod 'di/ /spu gri'i so 'dra zhes rtog go /zhes pa 'di ni rtog pa'i dpe/ /dri med lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ /tshul khrims yon tan bzhi ldan 'di/ /dam pa'i lam du mtshungs mod kyi/ /phan tshun 'gran pa'i 'gal zla nyid/ /ces pa 'di ni 'gal ba'i dpe/ /rang bzhin spros bral ye shes gang*//yon tan ldan yang 'bad rtsol can/ /'khrul pas bslad pa'i bsod nams tshogs/ /tshe gang 'bad pas ga la 'gran/ /zhes pa 'di ni dgag pa'i dpe/ /lhun po nor bu'i 'od kyis mdzes/ /tshangs spyod dul ba'i dpal gyis phyug /gzi brjid ldan par mtshungs mod kyang*/

/ri bo de ltar lhag pa min/ /zhes 'di mdzes pa'am ngo bstod dpe/ /blo gros rnam par 'phel byed 'di/ /dbyangs can ma yin thos pa nyid/ /lus la sim pa bskyed 'di yang*/ /reg min shin tu sbyangs pa nyid/ /ces 'di de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ /gzugs mdzes sogs dang bsam gtan las/ /skyes pa'i bde ba de kun gyis/ /zhi ba'i bde la skrun tu med/ /de phyir mya ngan 'das nyid dpe/ /zhes 'di thun mong min pa'i dpe/ /srid zhi'i legs lam ma lus pa/ /byed pos gcig tu bsdus 'dra ba'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog de dag /blo ldan kun gyis brten par byed/ /ces pa 'di ni 'byung min dpe/ /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir mang thos 'ga'/ /ngur smrig 'dzin yang g.yo sgyu dang*/ /gdug sems rtag tu 'chang ba 'di/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od las tsha gdung bzhin/ /zhes pa 'di ni srid min dpe/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa de bzhin du/ /grub pa'i bcud len nor bu dang*/ /dpag bsam shing ltar dge ba ni/ /bsten pa tsam gyis 'bras rab ster/ /zhes pa 'di ni mang po'i dpe/ /dge bas 'tsho ba'i longs spyod 'di/ /yongs 'du'i tshal tu rnam rol pa'i/ /mtho ris dbang po'i 'byor pa la/ /yang yang longs spyod byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa 'di ni rnam 'gyur dpe/ /nyin byed 'od kyis mtshan mo dang*/ /sman gyi dbang pos tsha gdung dang*/ /dbang pos da nu'i bu bzhin du/ /chos kyis sdig pa 'joms par byed/ /ces pa 'di ni phreng ba'i dpe/ /chos dang 'khor ba de nas gzhan/ /skye bo sdig pa myang 'das rnams/ /bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo spre'u dang*/ /dug dang dga' tshal dag tu mtshungs/ /zhes 'di dag don gsal byed kyi/ /dpe rgyan gsal byed sgra gcig pa'o/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du srid pa dang*/ /'dzin khri bzhin du nyon mongs te/ /gru bo che bzhin chos kyi lam/ /ded dpon mkhas ltar ston pa'o//zhes 'di gsal byed du ma can/ /chu klung bye ba phrag brgya yang*/

/chu yi gter du gzhol zhing 'bab/ /theg pa sna tshogs tha dad don/ /kun kyang chos kyi dbyings su gzhol/ /zhes 'di zla bo'i dngos po'i dpe/ /byang chub sems las sangs rgyas dang*/ /sgo nga'i sbubs las byed po skrun/ /rgyal ba yang dag lam ston zhing*/ /gzhan gyis lta ba'i thibs por khrid/ /ces pa 'di ni mtshungs sbyor dpe/ /'dren pa bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam mi rtog la sems can don/ /lhun grub spyod phyir yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu rin chen mchog dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rgyu yi dpe/ /de ltar dpe rgyan so gnyis so/ /dpe rgyan gyi ni skyon rnam gsum/ /pho mo ma ning rtags 'dres dang*/ /dpe don mchog dman ches pa dang*/ /mang nyung tshig tshogs 'khrugs pa'o/ /de dag rnams la rim pa bzhin/ /mes po dran pa drang srong gtso/ /bud med g.yo sgyu 'dzin ma bzhin/ /gcam bu'i tshig gi rjes 'jug ste/ /lcags phye gser ldan ma bzhin no/ / bde sogs bdag po'i khang bzang yang*/ /me tog bkram pa'i phyugs lhas bzhin/ /mgo bregs dal bus gom pa 'god/ /'di dag bde gshegs ji bzhin no/ /grogs med rgyu ba'i rnam shes 'di/ /tshong pa rnams kyi ded dpon mtshungs/ /'du byed rnams ni bse ru ltar/ /gcig tu sdug bsngal gcig pu bskyed/ /de dag skyon med dmigs gsal dpe/ /chos bzhin spyod na bud med kyang*/ /skyes bu snying stobs mchog ldan ltar/ /nges par byang chub bgrod pa nyid/ /'di la dpyad pa yongs med do/ /g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo ltar/ /mkhas pa dge sbyong mchog tu bde/ /rims nad shin tu byang ba ltar/ /spangs pa slar yang bzlog pa med/ /ji tsam srid par gyur pa'i tshogs/ /me yi rang bzhin tsha ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal kho nar zad pa ste/ /blo ldan thar phyir 'bad par byos/ /de ltar rjes gdams cung zad tsam/ /dpe rgyan tshul gyis brjod pa ste/ /ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i tshig dang don/

/'ga' yang bdag gis brjod ma nus/ /'on kyang chos kyi tshul bzhin te/ /mi bdag khyod kyis brtag pa'i 'os/ /zhes pa tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ nor gyi sde dang 'dod pa'i sde snying pos dben par shes nas/ chos kyi sde dang thar pa'i sde kho na'i dbang du byas te snyan tshig cung zad spel ba ngam rings su'o// // bkra shis/༄༅/ /lcam kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo la gdams pa'o/ / nged bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yis/ /phyi bde sdug chags sdang mtho dman kun/ nang chos kyi dbyings su ro mnyam tsam/ /yid ngal gso'i blo gtad 'cha' ba las/ /lar g.ya' gong gangs khrod kyi dben gnas su/ /lus sems gnyis rdul du brlags brlags par/ /sems nyams len gyi 'dun pa yod mod kyi/ /sngar phan chad g.yeng ba'i bdud kyis khyer/ /sngon bsags pa'i las kyi rang gzugs las/ /tshe phyi ma blos btang gi 'go dpon bab/ /'phral chags sdang zur mgo su bas rags/ /las sdig dang 'dres pa'i 'chol bar shor/ /da sngar byas kyi las la khag mi gtong*/ /mi dad ldan kun g.yang la mi 'bor ba/ /tshe sgrub pa snyoms pa'i nyams len zhig

/dus myur du 'grub par smon pa lags/ /rang kha bshad lag len 'dzol pa yi/ /mi gzhan la zhal ta ji ltar 'jug /khyed lhag bsam shin tu dag pas na/ /gtam nang ma'i tshul du gleng ba ni/ /gnas pha yul spangs pa'i ri khrod dang*/ /zas dkor dang ma 'dres longs spyod dang*/ /chos sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i nyams len gsum/ /lar shin tu dkon te da res 'dzom/ /spang dka' ba'i 'jig rten khyim so dang*/ /brgal dka' ba'i nor rdzas yul phyogs dang*/ /bcad dka' ba'i dgra gnyen 'brel ba gsum/ /dbyings thar pa'i lam 'gegs kyi chu bo lags/ /de rang sar grol pa dkon mchog dang*/ /pha bla ma'i thugs rje ma lags sam/ /da bsams na gtan gyi bde ba'i phul/ /'go tshugs pa 'dun ma'i yang rtse yin/ /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /nyin de ring yan chad nor bsags sam/ /dgra btul zhing gnyen skyong la 'bad kyang*/ /rang ngal ba tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ /las byas pa thams cad mdo don stor/ /mi dgra gnyen mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron/ /don gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yad yud la/ /las chags sdang gi 'khor lo skor bas ci/ /gnas yid 'ong bsam gtan khang bu ru/ /lus g.yo med dal ba'i bde skyid dang*/ /yid sems khral med pa'i ngal gso 'di/ khong brgya byin la yang yod re kan/ /yongs 'jig rten 'gro ba'i snang tshul 'di/ /mar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ /gnas mtho ris 'byor rgud 'gyur lugs la/ / dus cung zad bde ba'i go skabs med/ khong dbang chen du btags pa'i nga rgyal can/ /nyin mtshan med las kyis brel ba la/ /sems bde skabs med cing gzhan gyis 'phya/ /de 'dun ma legs snyam 'khrul tshabs la/ /sems stong nyid snying rje'i gnad sbyor dang*/ /rkyen mos gus gsol 'debs kyi nan tan dang*/ /'phral dge sbyor 'phel ba'i don can 'di/ /thugs yengs med lam du sgrub pa zhu// //bkra shis//༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma mchog dang dus gsum rgyal ba yi/
