/zhabs pad dam pa spyi bos btud byas te/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las brtsams nas/ /zab mo'i bka' mchid cung zad bgyid la spro/ /de la ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa zhig bka' stsal pa ni/ gzhan gyi tshig sna bstung ba dang*/ /pha rol zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ bdag nyid sgrog pa dang*/ rang gi phyogs yongs su spel ba'i phyir gsungs pa ma yin te/ /dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin las/ 'gro ba thams cad la mnyam par brtse bas/ de rnams rang gis brnyes pa'i byang chub dam pa de la dgod pa'i phyir gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir chos byed par 'dod pa rnams kyang rang dang gzhan bla na med pa'i byang chub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba'i thabs kho na la gtso bor dmigs pa zhig nges par dgos pa yin no/ de yang dang por chos sgrub cing nyams su blang ba'i gzhi gang la dmigs te bsgom par bya ba ni/ gnas lugs kyi de kho na nyid yin la/ de yang 'di ltar nges dgos te/ sems ma rig pa'i 'khrul pas yongs su bskyed de/ rmi lam bzhin du snang ba'i kun rdzob khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos 'di dag thams cad/ dngos po'i gnas tshul la gdod nas yod ma myong zhing*/ 'khrul pa'i sems kyi snang ba la ni/ rang rang gi rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las 'bras bu bslu ba med par 'byung ste/ kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams 'khrul snang tsam ma gtogs/ gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba yin la/ de ltar med kyang*/ ji srid 'khrul pa'i snang ba ma dag gi bar du/ 'khrul ngo nyid du rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang ma 'khrugs par 'byung ba 'di ni/ dang po nyid du yang dag pa'i lta ba bskyed pa'i dmigs pa yin te/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa la nges shes skyes nas/ spangs blang ji lta ba bzhin du spyad pas/ 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas/

ngan song gi sgo khegs/ mtho ris kyi sgo phyed par 'gyur zhing*/ snang ba 'di dag 'khrul pa tsam ma gtogs/ gdod ma nas yod ma myong par rtogs pas/ dngos por 'dzin pa dang*/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dbyings su dag ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes yang dag par skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ nyon mongs pa'i sa bon rnams kyang spong bar byed do/ /de ltar na/ kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma grub kyang*/ don dam yang dag pa'i dbyings chos nyid rang rig rang gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes 'di ni/ yang dag pa'i stong pa nyid dang*/ shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs dang*/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang*/ bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di ni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid du gdod ma nas grub cing*/ 'phags pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi nyams su myong bya yin pa'i phyir/ bden pa yin la/ 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir rtag cing brtan pa dang*/ gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid do/ /de ltar gnas lugs da ni/ bden grub dang*/ rtag brtan g.yung drung yin kyang/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yin zhing*/ tshig gis brjod du med/ blos bzung du med pa yin pas/ mnyam bzhag gi tshe/ 'di bden pa yin no rtag pa yin no zhes blos brtags nas ni mi sgom ste/ mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa gang du yang 'dzin pa med pa/ bzo bcos med pa'i tshul gyis 'jog dgos pas so/ /gzhi shes bya'i gnas lugs de ltar chos nyid yongs grub de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po sems can thams cad la gnas shing*/ de nyid sems kyis rang bzhin yin la/ de kho na dngos po'i gnas tshul la zhugs shing yod pa yin/ de las gzhan 'khor ba pa la ji ltar snang zhing*/ grags pa 'di dag thams cad dang*/ lam gyi chos thams cad dngos po'i gnas tshul la ma grub pa glo bur ba yin no/

/gzhi de ltar yin pa'i gnad kyis/ lam nyams su len pa'i tshe/ re zhig 'khrul ngo dang bstun te/ khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can mi rtag cing mi brtan la 'jig pa/ nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i yul bdag ces bya ba grub pa med pa/ chos 'di rnams la byed pos stong pa/ rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa 'phrad pa las 'byung bar shes nas/ de nyid kyi don yang yang bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad snying po med pas/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ de'i rjes su de ltar mi rtag cing sdug bsngal la snying po med pa'i 'khor ba las bdag nyid gcig pur ma zad sems can thams cad kyang 'don dgos pa'i bsam pa khyad par can bskyed nas/ byams snying rje dang 'brel bar de nyid yang yang bsgoms pas/ bsam pa byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sems can sdug bsngal myong ba la snying rje dang*/ bde ba la 'god 'dod kyi byams pa dang*/ /de lta bu'i sems can gyi don de yang bdag nyid gcig pus khur du blangs nas sgrub 'dod kyi snying stobs dang*/ gzhan don 'ba' zhig gi snying khongs su bcug nas/ sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod kyi byang chub kyi sems te/ de dag stobs dang ldan par gyur pa na/ theg chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos rgyud la skyes pa'i/ lam 'go zin pa yin no/ /de nas de lta bu'i gang du sdug bsngal myong ba'i sa phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ su zhig sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams dang*/ rgyu gang gis sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i las dang nyon mongs rnams dang*/ ji ltar sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshul skye rga na 'chi dang*/ 'gro drug so so'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin de thams cad/ so so'i sems rgyud la ma rig pa'i bag chags yod pas/ 'khrul ba'i snang bar shar ba ma gtogs/

dngos po'i gnas tshul la grub pa med pas/ rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin du shes pa na/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de yang bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ rang nyid de la mi skrag cing*/ gnas lugs la sdug bsngal med kyang*/ yod par 'khrul nas sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams la lhag par yang snying rje skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ sems can dang sdug bsngal rang bzhin med par mthong bas de dag dngos por 'dzin pa dang yang bral ba/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhes bya ba rim gyis rgyud la skyes par gyur na/ mdo sngags gang gis lam la zhugs kyang rung*/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi snying po rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ khyad par du/ spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings la rnam par mi rtog pa nyid du bzhag pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs mtha' dag rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong zhing*/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba ni nam du yang 'gyur ba med par mthong ba de'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la yid ches dam pa rnyed par 'gyur te/ de las sems can thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can du shes shing*/ de phyir sems can la mi brnyas pa dang*/ sems can bdag dang mtshungs pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can gyi rang bzhin dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin gcig par shes pas gus pa khyad par can dang*/ 'gro kun bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god thub pa shes pa'i snying stobs dang*/ sems can rnams nyid sangs rgyas rang la yod kyang de ltar ma shes pa la snying rje chen po yang lhag par 'jug cing*/ bdag gzhan 'khor 'das bde sdug sogs chos thams cad kyi snang tshul rnams la mngon par zhen pa bzlog rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog nus pa na/ mdo dang sngags kyi lam gang la zhugs pa yin kyang rung ste/ theg pa chen po'i lam khyad par can zab mo ches phul du phyin pa la reg pa yin no/

/phyi ma 'di ni/ mdo rnams las/ phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i gtam la dga' ba/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ don dam rnam par nges pa'i lam la zhugs pa dang*/ theg pa thams cad la yang dag par zhugs pa dang*/ 'khor lo tha ma'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byar gyur pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rnon po zhes bya ba'i gnas thob pa yin no/ /de dag ni lam gyi gzhi yin pas mdo sngags gnyis char la dgos shing*/ sngags kyi theg pa la brten nas/ chos nyid kyi gnas lugs myur du rtogs par 'dod na ni/ yang dag pa'i dbang gis rgyu smin par byas shing*/ dbang po rtul po dang*/ rgyud sbyang dgos pa yin na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag bcas pa la yang legs par slob dgos shing*/ dbang po rnon po la ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa kho nas kyang don 'grub pa yod la/ gnyis kas kyang shin tu rnal 'byor phyag rgya chen po nyid don gyi gtso bo'i tshul du 'bad pas sgrub dgos so/ /de ni rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa sogs te/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang*/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsung las rtogs dgos mod/ don gyi snying po ni/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad yongs su spangs te/ g.yo ba med pa'i rnal 'byor gyis lus la gnad du bsnun pa na/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal te rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du mthong ba na/ las rlung nyis khri chig stong drug brgya dbyings su thim pa'i thabs la 'bad pas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po mngon du 'gyur te/ de ltar rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dngos yin zhing*/ de yang rang bzhin gdod ma nas sems can gyi sems rgyud la gnas pa yin kyang mngon du ni ma gyur pa yin la/ thabs rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgo nas lus la gnad du bsnun pa dang*/

las rlung dgag pa'i sbyaur bas/ de dag sa 'og gi gter bton pa bzhin du mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /da ltar las dang po pa la yang*/ sems kyi gsal cha ma 'gags pa stong gzugs kyi snang ba rab 'byams su 'char ba ni/ sems nyid rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid 'khor 'das kyi khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan can du gnas pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin pas/ de ltar nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ gang gzugs brnyan snang ba'i sems de ni spros pa dang bral zhing ngos bzung du med pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi snang ba nub cing nyams bde bar gnas pa de ni sems kyi rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen por gnas pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin pas/ de ltar nges shes bskyed dgos pa yin no/ /don dam par sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rang sems kho na la lhun rdzogs su gnas pa yin zhing*/ de la sgrib g.yogs su yod pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i thabs la nan tan du 'bad pas/ myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la rang gis dbang bsgyur bar nus pa de 'byung ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ shin tu rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen rnyed/ /blang dor gnas kun gsal bar ston pa yi/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang 'phrad nas/ /don med stong log byed par cang bzod dam/ lo zla'i grangs kyis rim pas phri ba na/ /yun ring bskal pa'i dus kyang myur du 'dzad/ /rtsod dus mi yi tshe la smos ci dgos/ /phyi shol le lo'i dbang du ma gtong zhig /shin tu gces pa'i lus kyang myur du 'bor/ /yul 'khor longs spyod la sogs smos ci dgos//bstod dbyangs gtam snyan brag cha'i dbyangs dang mtshungs/ /snying po med pa de la su zhig chags/ /dge sdig las ni sems kyi rjes su 'brang*/ 'jig rten pha rol gar skye rang dbang med/ /'gro drug g.yang sar las kyis 'khrid pa'i tshe/ /chos las gzhan pa'i bya byed kun gyis bslu/

/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen bo bzhin/ /gting mtha' mi mngon rgal bar shin tu dka'/ /gcig rjes gcig zin chu yi rba rlabs bzhin/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'di la zad pa med/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya'i dngos gzhan zhig /bden grub rang dbang can du med lags te/ /sems nyid 'khrul pa'i gsal snang shar ba na/ /dngos su yod pa bzhin du sdug bsngal myong*/ /dper na mi zhig gnyid log rmi lam na/ /g.yang sar lhungs shing lus la bsnad pa rmi/ /g.yang sa med cing lhungs pa'i lus med kyang*/ /dngos su lhungs pa bzhin du sdug bsngal myong*/ bdag gzhan phyi nang snod bcud thams cad du/ /nga bdag ces bya nam yang grub pa med/ de phyir rang don sems pa 'khrul pa yin//mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad rang sems 'khrul/ /'khrul pa'i rgya mtsho skems par bya ba'i phyir/ /rang sems brtson 'grus chen po brtsams gyur na/ /'khrul pa sangs nas gdod ma'i gnas lugs la/ /rtag tu bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /ma dag snang ba gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i chos/ /yod par 'dzin rnams rtag par lta ba yin/ /don dam dbyings kyi ye shes snying po ste/ / med par 'dod na chad lta'i tha shal yin/ /gang zag la sogs 'dus byas dngos po rnams/ /mi 'jig rtag go snyam na rtag lta yin/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'gag med nam yang 'char/ /dge sdig las la skur 'debs chad lta yin//kun rdzob bden pa'ang rtag chad mtha' bral zhing*/ /don dam rtags tshul la yang mtha' gnyis spangs/ /de ltar shes na lta ba rnam dag yin/ /gzhan du rbad kham che yang dgos don stor/ /don dam rang rig bde gshegs snying po ni/ /rnam pa kun ldan rang bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /kun rdzob 'khor 'das chos kun yod ma myong*/ /rnam dag lta ba'i snying po de tsam lags/ /rtag tu lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa spangs/ /dge ba'i sems dang dge ba'i bya ba dang*/

/dge ba'i tshig dang gzhan la phan sems bskyed/ /theg pa spyi la dgos pa'i spyod pa yin/ /rig gnas kun dang dam chos kun la mkhas/ /yon tan kun thob ting 'dzin thams cad sgrub/ /nyes skyon kun spong theg pa kun la 'jug /thabs kun la brten sems can kun don byed/ /dge ba'i chos la mi sgrub gang yang med/ /bya ba thams cad sems can don du bsngo/ /gzhan gyi dge ba kun la dga' ba bsgom/ / 'di ni theg chen kun gyi spyod pa yin/ /spyod pa bzang yang bzang 'dzin med pa dang*/ /blang dor gnas la zhib tig che bzhin du/ /spyod pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshul khrims rnam dag yin/ /snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang*/ /grags tshad gsung dang sems nyid thugs rdo rje/ /lhag par mos shing mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bor bsgom/ /gsang sngags lha la mi phyed dad pa yis/ /dam tshig srog las gcer par 'dzin pa dang*/ /sngags kyi spyod pa mchog la yid gus pa//'di ni rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pa yin/ /rang spyod phra mo nas brtsams spang blang dang*//chen po rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa yi/ /rmad byung spyod la'ang dad cing blor shong la/ /gang shar de la ro snyoms zhen med mkhan/ /de ltar byas na log pa'i lam mi 'gro/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba gtan nas ma zhugs par/ /snying rje'i sems kyis gzhan phan kho na sgrub/ /'gro ba rang bzhin med kyang snying rje'i ngang*//yang dag spyod pa thams cad 'di la 'dus/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa nyams su len pa la/ /tshe 'di don chung mi rtag yad yud tsam/ khams gsum sdug bsngal me'i 'obs dang 'dra/ /'di la nges 'byung shugs drag snying nas bskyed/ /sdug bsngal can gyi 'gro la snying rje dang*/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i lhag bsam khur chen bskyed/ /gnas lugs spros bral don dam stong pa nyid/ /legs par go nas mos pa mchog bskyed de/

/zhi gnas lhag mthong rim pas rtse gcig sgoms//rnam rtog rlung gis ma g.yos zhi gnas dang*/ /sems nyid gsal stong rig pa'i lhag mthong ste/ /zhi lhag zung 'jug rnal 'byor bsgoms gyur na//nyon mongs g.yul las myur du rgyal bar 'gyur/ /sngags bzlas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa sogs/ /sna tshogs thabs kyang gzhan gyi don du sgrub/ /zab mo'i gnad la bla ma'i lung bzhin du/ /ye shes chen po'i rnal 'byor 'bad pas bsgom/ /rnam rtog thams cad sprin bzhin glo bur ba/ /sems nyid spros bral mkha' bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /dbyings rig tsam la g.yo ba med par bsgom//nyams len sgom pa'i snying po der 'dus so/ /lta sgom spyod pa ma nor nyams blangs na/ /'bras bu mchog la som nyi ga la yod/ /rgyu tshogs ma lus tshang zhing 'dzom pa la/ /'bras bu 'byung ba sus kyang bzlog tu med/ /rgyal bas sa lam rim pa mang gsungs na/ /sa lam rim pa 'gog pa gad mo'i gnas//de phyir rim pas lam rnams bgrod byas nas/ /mthar thug byang chub gnas su phyin par 'gyur/ /chos sku spros dang bral ba'i ye shes kyang*/ /snang med mun nag lta bu ma yin te/ /dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i/ /ji lta ji snyed gnas tshul gsal bar mkhyen/ /ye shes chen po'i rang snang 'gag med las/ /gzhan sems dag pa'i blo'i me long du/ /gzugs sku'i snang brnyan dpag med 'char ba yin/ /de las lhun grub 'bad rtsol med pa ru/ /dus gsum gdul bya 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las 'jug par 'gyur/ /de ltar mchog tu gdams pa zab mo 'di/ /dam pa khyed kyi thugs su byon gyur nas/ /dpag yas skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog/ // ces pa 'di yang mdo khams smad kyi rgyal khams nas dpal jo nang pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i ring lugs pa/

bla ma ka bzhi pa kun dga' lhun grub zhes bya ba'i gsung gis bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //༄༅/ /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'i gtam/ ri khrod pa nam mkha'i seng ge la 'phrin du bskur ba/ sgrub pa 'phel bar yod 'dug pa yid spro/ nged kyang chos 'phel bar yod/ skabs kyi don/ gnas lugs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gtam cung zad bshad na/ gnas lugs don gyi sangs rgyas phyi rol nas btsal ma dgos par/ rang la gdod ma nas yod pa der gda'/ rang du ma zad sems can thams cad la yod/ sems can du ma zad snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad 'di'i rang bzhin du 'dug

/bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ gdams ngag gi gnad la brten nas rang zhal lta shes na/ ye nas chos sku yod pa des yod go bcad par gda'/ de bzhin ma yin pa la yod kyang ma phan/ de rtogs pa'i thabs ni/ dang por nang 'dzin pa'i sems rang dag tu byas pas/ 'dzin byed kho rang rang grol du thongs pa zhig dgos/ de byung na phyis gzung ba rang sar dag pa yin/ de yang rang ngo shes tsam la dran 'dzin gyi bcos bslad kyang med na/ / gzhan gyi lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ /rig tsam wal le khyug ge ba ni nam du yang 'gag rgyu mi 'dug /tshig gis 'di lta bu'o zhes rang myong dang mthun pa ni ji ltar byas kyang brjod mi shes/ 'gyu byed rnam rtog gi blos 'di 'dra zhig go zhes ji ltar byas kyang des thub rgyu med/ 'di yin 'di min/ yul phyogs dang phyogs kyi cha gang gis kyang ma bsdus/ rig pa dang shes pa'i ngo bor yod snyam na'ang*/ rang rig skad cig ma'i ngo bo ni/ shes pa 'di lta bu myong*/ rig pa 'di lta bur 'dug ces bya ba'i myong bya myong byed dang*/ rig bya rig byed gang yang yod ma myong ba 'di ka tha mal shes pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs su gda' 'o/ /gsung rab kyi chos skad na mar/ sgra dang rtog pa'i yul las 'das pa zhes bya ba dang*/ brjod bral dang*/ spros bral dang*/ so sor rang gis rig pa'i ye shes dang*/ stong pa nyid dang*/ don dam pa sogs chos skad bzang bzang mo dang*/ ming snyan snyan mo dpag tu med pa zhig byung ba yin/ rang bzhin ngos bzung med pa de'i 'char sgo la/ dad pa dang snying rje sogs dge ba'i rnam rtog skyes sam 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs dug lnga shar ram/ sa rdo ri brag gi rnam rtog sogs lung ma bstan gyi 'char sgo yin yang rung ste/ gang skyes de ka skyes tsam nas ngos zin dgos/ ngos zin pa zer ba de yang skad cig dang por rnam rtog skyes pa la/

skad cig gnyis par rnam rtog skyes song snyam pa'i rjes bsnyegs te min/ dus mnyam yang rung*/ rnam rtog yin par 'dug snyam pa'i blos byas kyis kyang mi chog /rjes bsnyegs dang*/ blos byas kyi blo kho ras kho rang yang rang ngo ma shes na/ gzhan la kha rog 'dug zer nas/ rang skad chen po 'don pa dang 'dra ba zhig yong*/ ngo shes byed mkhan kho rang gis rang ngo ma shes pa la/ shes pa gzhan zhig gis ngo shes byed par rlom pa blos byas 'khrul ba'i mgo skor du gda' 'o/ /'o na rang ngo ngos zin pa rang ci la zer na/ 'char sgos rang shar tsam dus na/ skad cig ma gcig po de nyid la/ kho ras kho rang la bzo bcos med par rang so zin pa'i ming yin te/ 'gyu ba kho ras 'gyu ba kho rang shes tsa na bya lam rjes med/ 'gyu ba rang sangs/ nyon mongs rang grol yin/ 'di la yang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam rtog dang*/ yul rkyen sogs shugs drag mi drag gi khyad par gyis/ rtog pa'i 'char sgo gsal gsal 'dra la ngos gzung med pa'i yul yul po chu la gzugs brnyan shar ba 'dra ba zhig dang*/ dbyings de la mdangs gcig gis khyab pa tsam 'dra ba ma gtogs/ 'char sgo rang yang 'di yin ngos gzung du med pa zhig ste/ 'char tshul mi 'dra ba de ltar yod yang ngo bo la khyad med/ blo dang bstun pa'i 'char tshul mi 'dra ba la grangs med cing zad pa'ang med la/ brjod kyis mi lang*/ de tsam na 'char sgo thams cad kyang gdod ma'i rtsal ba 'gags par shar ba tsam las gzhan med pas/ rnam rtog rang mtshan pa btsal bas ma rnyed pa lags/ 'di byung tsa na don tshan rim pa gnyis pa phyi gzung ba'i yul dag pas/ snang ba rang sar grol ba zhes bya ba de zhor la 'ong ba yin te/ /sa rdo ri brag skye shing nags tshal/ dgra gnyen/ 'khor longs spyod/ 'grogs shes la sogs pa/ phyi nang ji ltar snang ba thams cad snang tsam de la yul gyi 'dzin pas ma bslad par snang tsam shar tsam de ka rang rig rang gsal/

shar ba'i dus/ gsal ba'i dus/ snang ba'i dus nyid na ka 'di yin 'di min ngos gzung bral ba/ de kho na snang ba rang sar grol ba zhes bya ste/ rmi lam gyi yul snang ngam me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur shes pas dngos por 'dzin pa rang sangs pa yin no/ /de ltar phyi nang gnyis rang sar dag pa de ka gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi don yin/ ma 'gags pa'i shes pa dang sang nge ba/ gsal le hrig ge ba/ 'bol le shig ge ba/ rtsol med kyi rang rig pa yid ches la smra ru mi btub pa zhig 'dug pa 'di ka gdod ma'i chos nyid zer ba'i sgra bo che de yin mod/ sgom chen pa thams cad chos nyid ma bu 'phrod skad/ ma 'phrod skad/ kha bsngags mang po zer te/ dngos gnas la gzung 'dzin dbyings su grol ba'i rang zhal lta ba gal che'o/ /yang da lta'i snang ba zang thal le ba 'di ka chos sku yin/ so so'i rgyud la rjen che re ba ma 'gags pa'i rig pa 'di ka ye shes yin zer te/ tshom 'jog la gtam 'ang 'ud re bshad/ tham thom la bzang brdzu'i rgyab skyor mkhan de kun la snying po med/ chos skad bzang la mdor te med pa zhig yong nyen yod/ dngos gnas la de ltar yin kyang*/ yin pas mi phan pa zhig kyang yong*/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i 'og gzhi chu 'ba' zhig la brten pa yin kyang*/ mya ngam gyi thang la skoms te shi ba'i mi mang po dang 'dra/ gong du bshad pa ltar gnas lugs la rdo rus thug pa zhig byung na/ 'khor 'das rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid yin pas/ snang bzang thal le ba 'di las logs su mya ngan las 'das pa btsal du med pa cis kyang yin mod/ 'char sgo ji tsam 'char ba 'di/ skye na'ang rang bzhin dbyings de las skye/ 'gag na'ang de'i ngang de kar 'gag /ma 'gag par gnas na'ang de ka'i rang bzhin las ma 'das par gda' na'ang*/ de 'dra zhig yin par 'dug snyam pa'i go bas nyams myong ma bslad rig thog tu rig pas gnad la 'byor pa gal che/ gnas lugs lta ba'i phyogs la 'di kas thag chod par 'ong*/

thabs spyod pa'i phyogs la/ spyir tshogs bsog gi rim pa rnams rnam g.yeng gi rgyu mi 'gyur ba'i ngos nas/ rang gi mos pa dang bstun pas khyab/ bla ma la mos gus dang*/ sems can la snying rje rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig med thabs med/ de yang gnas lugs kyi lta ba dang*/ thabs de nyid res 'jog tu ma song bar/ rang bzhin ngos gzung med pa'i rtsal mos gus dang snying rje 'char zhing*/ mos gus dang snying rje'i mdangs drag po de yang rang dus nas spros bral du rang ngo shes pa zhig dgos shing*/ dge sbyor ci byed sems can gyi don du bsngo bas rgyas thebs pa'ang gal che/ rten bdud rtsi ril bu dang*/ byin rlabs ril bu thum la rgya ldan/ stag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bzang po la dge/ //bkra shis//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ lag len gnad la 'byor pa yi/ /zhal gdams gnad kyi tshig gsum la/ /dgos dus phan par nges pa yi/ /chos kyi gnad kun 'dus sam snyam/ /'phral gang shar sgyu ma lta bu la/ /gdangs snang cha mos gus su shar ba dang gcig /ma 'gro drug la snying rje'i gdung shugs te/ /don zhen chags phyogs 'dzin spangs pa dang gnyis/ /sems rig pa'i rgyal po mtha' bral 'di/ /lar bzo med yengs med du skyong ba dang gsum/ /gnad gsum po gcig tu bsdus pa 'di/ /dus nam dgos su phan pa'i chos zhig lags/ /de yang bde ba dang sdug bsngal/ dga' ba dang mi dga' ba/ chags pa dang sdang ba'i rnam pa sogs/ mtho dman re dogs gang byung yang*/ med bzhin snang ba sgyu ma lta bur a 'thas bshig pa'i/ dgag sgrub blang dor bral ba'i ngang de las/ rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med kyi gdangs/ bla ma la mos gus dung re ba shar ba 'di kho nas kyang*/ bar do la sogs pa'i 'khrul pa chig chod du 'gro ba lags/ yang gnas lugs nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ snang cha sgyu ma lta bur ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams snying re rje/ zhes nye ring phyogs cha dang bral ba'i snying rje lhang nge ba te/

kho rang gi rang zhal la bltas pas/ 'dzin med zhen med kyi ngang der cham mer 'dug pa/ 'di kho na sgoms pas kyang*/ sdug bsngal yul 'bud pa zhig lags/ sems gnas sam 'gyu yang*/ kho rang gi rang dus de na gang shar de la bzo bcos med par shig ge de kha'i ngang ngam rang shar de la yengs med du bzhag pas/ gang shar thams cad dbyings de khar 'dug pa 'di sgoms na nyon mongs thams cad kyi rang mtshang rdib pa lags/ gnad gsum po de re res kyang chog na/ gsum ka gcig tu dril bas lta mos kyang ci dgos/ bzo med kyi shes pa bskyangs pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa la snying rje lhang nge/ snying rje de sgyu ma lta bur shar pas/ de ltar ston pa'i bla ma la mos gus dung ngai ba de'o/ /gnad gsum byas kyang gnad gcig yin/ /'chi bar snang ba 'khrul snang yin/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam yin/ /bar do byas kyang rnam rtog yin/ skye ba blangs kyang sgyu ma yin/ re dogs byung na phaṭa kyi thob/ /legs legs mdzes khrigs shig las thong*/ /rang shar de la cham gyis skyur/ /ma bcos ngang la 'jog dgos te/ /ji ltar byas kyang bcos mar song*/ /ma bcos pa gcig ngas ma rnyed/ /bcos ma kho ra'i rang bzhin ni/ /ma bcos pa der mi 'dug gam/ /shes na de khas chog pa la/ /thag chod yod dus mi 'dug go /de bas byar med ngang la zhog /sems la 'phrod na gdams ngag yin/ kha chol tsam la ci bya yod/ / gang shar de khas go chod na/ /man ngag gi rgyal po de na 'dug// //ces pa tshogs pa'i mkhan chen shākya ri dbang gi thugs dam gsal 'debs su/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// bkra shis/༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid kyi bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnad skul gyi gdams pa tshig gsum 'di/ /slob ma'i sems la 'phrod par shog/mi lus lan gcig thob pa 'di/ /sos dal du sdod pa cang khom mam/ rnam g.yeng la mi tshe ma skyel bar/ /rang gis rang sems 'chun pa zhig 'tshal/

/brtson 'grus kyi lcag gis ma 'khul na/ /mi gzhan gyi bskul 'debs re thag chad/ /yul mi dang dgra gnyen kun la ltos/ /dge sbyor gyi bskul 'debs gzhan mi 'tshal/ /chos gdams pa zab mo mjal dus su/ /nyams len gyi khye spogs la 'bad 'bungs mdzod/ /zong phan tshun du sgyur ba'i khye phogs te/ /sgom chen pa'i rkang chung gting nas 'dren/ /'dod yon gyi 'khri ba ma chod na/ /brgya brgya btang nas stong stong 'gugs/ /g.yo zol gyi rnam rtog la mi tshe skyel/ /bya btang gi ming btags ngo re tsha/ /tshe ngais med nam 'chi cha med yin/ /sgom sgrub la ham rgyugs mi byed par/ /grags 'dod dang lo 'dod kyi kha la rgyug /chos brgyad kyi rlung pos 'khyer nyen gda'/ /rang rgyud la phan pa'i dge sbyor te/ /mi gzhan gyis ma go yang a'u rtsi/ /'khor che dang ngo so ma 'dod ang*/ /nyams phran tshegs skyes pa rnams yal nyen gdog /nyams rtogs kyi nyi ma shar na yang*/ /nye ring dang bar ma'i mi kun gyis/ /ma go na gting nas 'tshengs pa yin/ /sgom nyams len gnad du mi 'gro ri/ /dgra gnyen sogs su la phan btags kyang*/ rgyud snying rjes brlan pa ma gtogs pa/ /ngo so skad cig kyang mi 'phyar na/ /byang chub kyi sa bon ma thebs ri/ /lar bar chad kun mngon tshan can la 'jug/ gsangs te spyod pa 'di gal re che/ / rgyal khams kyi mi la phan btags kyang*/ khong yus kyis khyer na gzhan phan min/ /mi tshe sgrub pa la bskyal srid kyang*/ /rlom sems kyis khyer na g.yang la lhung*/ /nyams myong dang yon tan shar skabs su/ /mi gzhan la ngoms na 'phral du 'grib/ /'gro don dang grags pa byung dus su/ /bdud kyis bar chad kun 'jug nyen che/ /bdud gzhan na yod pa ma yin no/ /chos spyod la g.yel ba de rang bdud/ /'grogs bshes sogs gal che su yin kyang*/ /'jig rten gyi bya ba kho rang tshos shes/ /rang tshe 'di blos btang du khas blangs nas/

/'brel can gyi 'dun byus mi 'tshal lo/ /longs spyod dang 'khor tshogs rnam g.yeng gi rgyu/ /de tshe 'gugs g.yang 'gugs mi dgos so//rang dbang ba'i yo byad 'ching ba'i gzhi/ /de ser snas shi sbar ma 'tham zhig/ 'phral zad med kyi long gtam dge sbyor gyi dgra/ /tshig mi smra ngag bcad gnad du che/ /ljongs grong kha nyul ba lang shor gyi rgyu/ /gnas lung stong du tshugs na dpa' ba yin/ /da nyams len gyi snying po gcig yin te/ /ltem 'gyang med pa'i mos gus bsgom/ /nyams len gyi rnam grangs gsum yin te/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal las 'bras soms/ /nyams len gyi rkang rtsa gnyis yin te/ /ma bcos so ma dang snying rje che/ /'chi ba mi rtag pas bskul ma btab/ /sdug bsngal du bsams na zhen chags spong*/ /las 'bras la bsams na spyod pa gtsang*/ /snying rje dang spros bral sgom gyi mthil/ / de kun gyi rtsa ba mos gus yin/ /ru nga dang 'gran sems dbyings su dag /dran 'khrul gyi gyab skor mi 'dug na/ /dge sbyor tsho gnad du song ba yin/ /lar chos zhig byed na chos bzhin gyis/ /mi tshe 'byid thabs kyi chos spyod de/ /thos bsam dang sgom sgrub ci yin rung*/ /gzhan mgo skor las lhag pa yod re kan/ / chos shes rgya tsam gyis mi phan te/ /rang rgyud tha mal par krongs se lus/ /nyams len gyi gnad dang mi ldan pa/ /blun sgom tsam gyis kyang mdo don stor/ /yid nges 'byung snying nas ma skyes pa'i//sgom chen de ri la lud bsog yin/ /las 'bras la mi rtsi ba'i bag med la/ /grub thob tu re ba dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems med pa'i/ /stong skad kyi rbad kham chad lta rang*/ /nang rlung sems ye shes su ma thim pa'i/ /rtsa rlung gi rno khyad mu stegs pa'i chos/ /gsang sngags kyi dam tshig khrom la 'khyams//kun spang gyi rnal 'byor gdol bar song*/ /yang lta spyod bzang po'i 'dzin stangs can/

/gzhan khyad gsod kyi sdig pa bsog nyen gdog /nyin mtshan sgrub pa la rtsol na yang*/ / gol sa 'di rnams la bzab par zhu/ /chos kho na la blo sna 'jur te bsgrim/ / rgyud 'jam la ltag tshugs bzang ba dang*/ /tha mal du ma lus yengs med du 'tshal/ /dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur// //zhes pa'ang bya btang kun dga' dpal ldan la tā ra nā thas gdams pa'o// bkra shis//༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru/ skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi bla ma la/ /thugs yid dbyer med kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /mnyam nyid kyi ngang du gsol ba 'debs/ /mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems la shar ba'i tshig bcad 'ga'/ /go rim dang mdzes khrigs ma mchis kyang*/ /dad ldan gyi slob mas bskul ba'i ngor/ /thol byung du shar ba 'di ltar lags/ /chos mdo rgyud thang mar brdal ba nas/ /tshogs bsags thabs ji snyed cig gsung lags kyang*/ /pha bla ma bsten tshul du kun kyang 'dus/ /thabs mkhas kyi rgyal po mos gus yin/ /ltem 'gyang med pa zhig gal re che/ /gzhan zer gyi bstod smad phra ma mkhan/ /mdzad spyod 'di bzang ngan ci yin snyam/ /sems 'khu 'khrigs za na ltem 'gyang yin/ /gdung shugs dang thag chod gal re che/ /blo rtse gnyis med na thag chod yin/ /skyi sdug dang mtho dman la ma rag cing*/ /re dogs bral ba'i mos gus 'tshal/ /dus rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa gces/ /sgom byed dam 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug byed/ /dus rtag tu bla ma brjed pa med/ /gdung shugs kyi tshad ni de la mdzod/ /gnas lugs kyi nyams myong bzang mi bzang*//mos gus bzang ngan gyi rjes su 'gro/ /mos gus mtha' med du 'phel 'dug na/ /nyams rtogs mi skye ba'i rang dbang med/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs gyur kyang*/ /don sems nyid gtan la 'bebs pa yin/ /sems gsal rig ma 'gags ngos gzung bral/ /de so mar bskyangs na rang so zin/ /dus rtag tu dran pa'i thag pas bzung*/

/rang rang nyid kyis rig na rang grol yin/ /sems bzung bas mi phan lhug par thong*/ /'gro 'ong gi rnam dbye dbyings su stor/ /dus re 'ga' bsgrim kyin gcun la zhog/spros bral kyi dbyings su phyin pa yin/ /yang re 'ga' klod la bskyur kyin zhog

/gnyug ma'i rang so zin pa yin/ /lar gnas lugs byar med kyi rnal 'byor la/ /bsgrim dgos dang klod dgos mi 'dug mod/ /bsgrim klod kyi snang ba ci shar yang*/ / gnas lugs kyi dbyings su khyer na bde/ /mthong thos kyi yul la dgag rgyu med/ /snang tshad kun gsal stong zung 'jug yin/ /'gyu byed rnam rtog gi ri mo 'di/ /rang ngo shes na rig stong du gda'/ /me long la snod bcud kyi gzugs brnyan shar/ /shar tsam nyid nas ngos gzung dang bral/ /dpe de bzhin rig pa'i 'chad sgo kun/ /sems spros bral kho ra'i rang gzugs yin/ /chos sku nyag gcig gi klong yangs la/ /blang dor gyi spros pa dgos re kan/ /spang blang gi snang cha ci shar yang*/ /rang grol du 'dug na spang blang bral/ /nga 'gro 'am 'dug gam gang byed kyang*/ /gnyid log gam sad skabs yin yang rung*/ /sems gnas sam 'gyu ba ci shar yang*/ /rang dus nas rang tsho thub pa zhig 'tshal/ / sems rang tsho thub na ngos gzung bral/ /gnyis med kyi rig pa 'di rtsal ma 'gags/ /'khor 'das kyi snang ba la mi 'char med/ /shar grol gyi rnal 'byor blo re bde/ /yengs med rnal 'byor brjid re chags/ /las med kyi rnal 'byor zhe re gtsang*/ /rgyu yan gyi rnal 'byor gu re yangs/ /gang shar la lam khyer rtsal re che/ khyed nyams len gyi snying po de la mdzod/ /gnas lugs nam mkha' ltar spros bral mod/ /spyod pa las 'bras kyi blang dor zab/ /stong nyid kyi rang mdangs snying rjer shar/ /chos lta spyod 'dzom pa sangs rgyas kyi lam//spyod pa la mtshan mar ma zhen zhing*/ /stong rkyang la kha lta mi 'thag par/ /rang rgyud la gnad du 'gro ba gces/ /spyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin dang*/ /'dus byas la rtag pa'i go skabs med/ /sgos 'chi ba nam yong cha med pas/ /gzhan cis kyang mi phan chos la 'bungs/ /ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong dus na/ /pha ma dang nye dus 'khyobs pa med/

/sngar byas kyi sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ /phyin chad mi byed pa gal re che/ /zas nor dang longs spyod kha drag kun/ /tshe brjes pa phan chad gar song med/ /las dkar po dag la 'bad gyur na/ /phyogs gang du skyes kyang bde ba yin/ /da mos gus la thabs kyi gtso bor mdzod/ /sems nyid la lta ba nyams len mthil/ /mi rtag skyo shas dran bskul gyi lcag /las 'bras kyi zhib tig spyod pa'i phul/ /don 'di bzhi chos kyi snying po lags/ /mi khyed kyi thugs la 'phrod par smon/ /dgung mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /don gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa 'char bar shog/ //ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas dpon blo gros nam mkha' la gdams pa'o//༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dam pa rtogs pa dang thugs rje can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus yin te/ dngos grub yong du re nas mos gus byas na rang 'dod phugs su bcug pa yin/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su shes pa gal che ste/ bla ma rang gis ma chog par yar la bteg nas sangs rgyas su skyel na mos gus kyi gnad 'chugamadzad pa gang shar de ka chos sku'i rnam rol sems can gang la gang 'dul du shes dgos te/ mdzad pa nyes pa zhig yod pa la rang res bzang por bsgyur nas lta dgos na snang ba ma dag pa yin/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs tshugs pa med pa 'dra ba zhig med kha med yin na'ang*/ zhen med kyi mos gus rang shar rang grol du ma song na bzang rtog phal pa yin/ des na re dogs dang bral ba'i mos gus dang gsol 'debs dgos pa lags so/ /bla ma dam pa gcig la gsol ba btab pas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa gcig dgos/ de yang gcig la thams cad stim pa la sogs pa'i dmigs pa byed pa'i srol ltar byas kyang chog ma byas kyangarung ste/ ngo bo bla ma thams cad kyang thugs nam mkha' ltar ngos gzung med pa'i gsal stong du ro gcig /de'i mdangs snying rjer shar bar yang gcig

/de'i mthu las 'phrin las sems can gyi don mdzad par yang gcig /rang gi ngos nas kyang*/ dang po klog slob pa'i slob dpon nas gzung ba'i bla ma kun gyis dge ba la bskul bar yang gcig /thabs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang*/ ston lugs dang 'khrid lugs mi 'dra ba byung yang*/ dus tshod gnas skabs dang*/ gang la gang 'dul tsam yin/ ngo bo sgrib gnyis spyod du bcug /tshogs gnyis rdzogs su bcug nas/ mthar thug sangs rgyas su 'khrid par yang gcig /rang gsol ba 'debs/ mos gus sgom pa'i skabs yin la wal wal 'char ba'i bla ma de rnams rang sems kyi 'char sgo yin pas sems gcig gi rang ngor yang ro gcig pa lags so/ /de ltar shes nas gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs so/ /oṃ snang stong dbyer med sku yi rdo rje ni/ /srid zhi'i snang ba kun la khyab par bzhugs/ /āḥgrags stong dbyer med gsung gi rdo rje ni/ / brjod rtsol bral yang ming tshig kun tu 'char/ /hūṃ bde stong dbyer med thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /'bad rtsol med kyang shes bya thams cad mkhyen/ /hoḥrnam pa kun ldan ye shes rdo rje ni/ /'gyur ba med kyang 'khor 'das kun tu snang*/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje bzhi/ /kun 'dus bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /dam chos kun 'dus khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge 'dun kun 'dus khyod kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam kun 'dus khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bstan bsrung kun 'dus khyod kyi mgon skyabs mdzod/ /mgon po khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing*/ khyod nyid dges pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par shog/ mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad la/ /byin gyis brlob phyir 'dir byon bzhugs//sku la mtshan dpe 'od du 'bar/ /sprul pa yang sprul grangs las 'das/ /mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/

/ 'od dang 'od zer 'ja' 'od 'khrug /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'brug ltar sgrog /bde chen nyams myong 'ar ma 'ur/ /da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gtan thog 'di ru byin gyi rlobs/ /thugs yid dbyer med rtogs nas kyang*/ /rje btsun khyed dang mnyam par shog /bdag lus nam mkha' mnyam gyur nas/ /sku yi 'phrin las sgrub par shog /ngag kyang shes bya kun khyab nas/ khyod gsung ma lus sgrub par shog /sems can kun yid ro gcig pas/ /thugs kyi 'phrin las kun 'grub shog /dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ khyod kyi zhabs pad bsten pa dang*/ khyod gsung ji bzhin 'dzin par shog /ji srid gnas lugs ma rtogs shing*/ /brtan pa ma thob bar du yang*/ /ci gsung gus pas sgrub pa dang*/ /mos gus ltem 'gyang med pa dang*/ brdeg brdung bka' bkyon ci mdzad kyang*/ /yid chad dad log mi skye bar/ /maus gus ches cher 'phel bar shog /khyim gyi las dang sdig spyod sogs/ /mdzad spyod ci 'dra mthong gyur kyang*/ /gang 'dul thabs mkhas 'phrin las su/ /rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ pha bla ma/ pha bla ma/ pha bla ma/ pha bla ma rang mkhyen/ rje btsun bla ma mkhyen/ /thabs mkhas 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /brjod bral chos sku khyod la gsol ba 'debs//dus gsum sangs rgyas khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu stobs nus ldan khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes mkha' khyab khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ /brtse ba'i rang bzhin khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ /'phrin las lhun grub khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgyu ma'i gar mkhan khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ / 'khor bar 'khyams pa bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /nyon mongs me ltar 'bar la thugs rjes gzigs/ /las ngan chu bos khyer la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sdug bsngal 'dam du bying la thugs rjes gzigs/ chos brgyad rlung gis khyer la thugs rjes gzigs/

/tshe 'di blos ma thongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rang rgyud shing ltar rengs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /gdengs med chod yod mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /zog po mgo skor mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgyid snyoms rnam g.yengs can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /ngo dga' mthun 'jug mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /snying nas chos ma nus la thugs rjes gzigs/ /re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ /skyabs gnas gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ /blo gtad gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ kha tsam tshig tsam min no thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang*/ /chos kun nyams su longs pa dang*/ zhe bcang snying rus rgyun mi 'chad/ /nyams rtog rtsol med 'char bar shog /bla ma kun gyi thugs rjes 'dzin pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung bzhin 'grub pa dang*//dam chos kun gyi dgongs pa longs pa dang*/ 'phags tshogs kun gyi zhabs rjes zin par shog /sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol zhing*/ nyon mongs thams cad dbyings su dag pa dang*/ /las rnams thams cad sprin bzhin dengs pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bde bar thim par shog/ drin can pha ma 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /rje btsun khyed kyi go 'phang thob par shog /de srid rgyal khyod thugs rjes gzigs pa yis/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par skyong gyur cig /ces gsol ba drag tu btab nas/ mos gus gang skyes de la bzo bcos med pa'i tshul du hrig ge bzhag /gzhan yang phyag 'bul/ bskor ba mchod pa sogs dge ba ci byas thams cad bsngo ba'i skabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpar grags pa'i bla ma rnams sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang*/ gsung gi glegs bam sogs kyi drung du yang*/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las thar pa dang*/ gnas lugs rtogs pa dang*/ mos gus tshad du phyin pa skye bar smon lam 'debs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la yang de ltar gsol ba thob/

bla ma'i mos gus tshad du phyin na mos gus gcig chog rgyal po bya ba lags so/ /da ni gdams pa gzhan yang bshad par bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro kun 'dus pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /rgyud pa kun dngos de la 'dud/ /mchog tu gus pa'i slob ma la/ /sems yid chos su sgyur ba'i phyir/ nyams len gnad bskul gdams ngag ni/ /blo dang 'tsham pa 'di ltar lags/ /chos kun snying po lag len kun bsdus na/ /dkar nag las 'bras bslu ba med pa la/ /yid ches dad pas spang blang 'dzol med dang*/ /cis kyang dgos med dran pa'i nges 'byung dang*/ /phyogs ris zhen chags med pa'i snying rje dang*/ /gang shar rang sar grol ba'i lta sgom ste/ /bzhi po 'di la ma 'dus gang yang med/ /gal po che 'di blo la nges par mdzod/ /rang nyid nyams rtogs mtho dman ci 'dra yang*/ /dge ba'i bya ba lcogs tshad byed pa gces/ /dge sbyor bzang por yod na bogs 'don yin/ /dge sbyor ngan na bsags sbyang gal re che/ /rtogs pa mthon po nyams myong brtan po dang*//phyogs rai'i bstan pa'i kha so 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /sdig pa bsog cing khyim pa'i mthun 'jug ni/ /byas kyang nyes pa med par 'dod pa mang*/ /de dag bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ /rtogs pa mthong na sdig pa byed don med/ /'khrul pa zhig na mi ngo 'dzin don med/ /bstan pa phyogs re'i zhen gyis bstan pa dkrug/ chos kyi phyir du'ang chos 'gal byed mi rung*/ /rang dang dgra gnyen nor phyi lta ci smos/ /dge sdig bya ba che chung ci byas kyang*/ /de yi 'bras bu bde sdug bslu ba med/ /sems can gzhan la phan tshad dge ba yin/ /'gro la gnod tshad sdig pa kho na yin/ /tshe 'di'i phan pa tsam la snying po med/ /phyi mar phan na phan tshabs che ba yin/ /tshe 'dir phan med gnod med yin snyam la/ /phyi mar gnod pa spongs la phan pa sgrubs/

/'di phyi kun tu phan na thams cad bya/ /'di phyi kun tu gnod na nam yang spang*/ /tshe 'dir gnod kyang phyi mar phan na ni/ /skabs su gang bab brtags la nges par sgrubs/ /rgyal srid spangs nas dka' spyad chos sgrubs na/ /'phral du sdug kyang phugs su 'tsheng ba bzhin/ /tshe 'dir skyid kyang phyi mar gnod pa ni/ /zas mchog dug gis sbags pa bzhin du spang*/ /dkon mchog mchod pa'i rdzas la longs spyod na/ /lto ba 'grangs kyang dmyal bar 'gro ba bzhin/ /rig pa rkyang 'ded byas pa kho nas chog /las 'bras cha med zer pa log lta yin/ kha skad tsam gyis lta ba mtho mtho mos/ /g.yang sar lhung ba mang gi zhe zon 'tshal/ /zhes pa ni las 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pa'i gtam ste dang po'o// //da lta'i snang ba chags sdang skye ba'i yul/ /'di dag yad yud tsam yin rtag mi thub/ /'bral bar phangs pa'i grogs ni rmi lam 'dra/ /gces pa'i khang zhing nor yang wu ba bzhin/ /mdza' ba kun yang gtan gyi mdza' ba min/ /dgra bo kun yang gtan gyi dgra bo min/ /shi nas 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /pha bos ma bos byas kyang khu stong tsam/ /ngan song 'grim dus ci yang mi phan zhing*/ /dge sbyor gcog pa'i gnyen gyis ci zhig bya/ /nam zhig nges par 'brel ba mnyam po la/ /da lta nyid nas zhen pa med na legs/ /zhen pa med na bral kyang sdug bsngal med/ /shi sbar 'thams na mya ngan drag pos 'joms//gar skyes nges med skyid sdug rang dbang med/ /gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal kho na'i dang*/ /dpal 'byor can gyi skye bo 'di rnams blun/ /'das pa'i sdug bsngal mang pos skyel ma dang*/ /ma 'ongs sdug bsngal mang pos bsu ma dang*/ da lta'i sdug bsngal dbus na 'dre zhing ldog/ sdig pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad/ /sdug bsngal ma bzod da dung sdig la 'jug /sdug la skyid por 'khrul nas nga rgyal byed/ /mi chen blo ldan rnams kyi 'dun gros yin/

/da lta'i skye bo kun gyi spyod tshul yin/ /dbang thang che yin dmyal bar sdod yun ring*/ /'byor ba che yin yi dwags 'phongs pa'i rgyu/ /blo gros che bar rlom yang phyugs nyid de//bu khyaud de 'dra'i phyogs la re smon spongs/ /sa chen dbang ba'i sde dpon stobs ldan dang*/ /srog chags phra mo grog sbur nyams chung gnyis/ /skye ba phyi ma'i gdengs la khyad par med/ /gang la'ang yid brtan thub pa ci yang med//bde ba'i go skabs ci yang ma mthong bas/ /'khor ba snying po med par shes nas ni/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan snying por mdzod/ /ces pa ni/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal las brtsams pa'i nges 'byung gi gtam ste gnyis pa'o// //nyams rtogs mthon por grags pa mang po yang*/ /snying rje med pas ngan pa'i lam du gol/ /theg chen zer yang theg pa dman par lhung*/ /rang don gzhan phan gnyis ka shor ba mang*/ /bdag pas gzhan gces snying rje'i bsam pa can/ /thabs la mkhas pa theg pa chen po'i chos/ /theg pa che chung lta bas khyad mi 'byed/ /byang chub sems dang snying rje spyod pa'i khyad/ /phrag dog che zhing kha rgod bsam pa ngan/ /chos rgyud bu rgyud bzang yang ga la phan/ /dka' spyad 'dug tshul bzang yang bslu rdo yin/ /bya btang dam bca' che yang tshig skam yin/ khyod ni gnas lugs rtogs pa yin no zhes/ /kha 'jam zhe gdug bla ma g.yo can gyis/ /bstod ra btang bas rang rgyud ma thul pa'i/ /blun po phal cher blun dad skyed du 'jug /rmongs pa phal cher rang la bstod na dga'/ /dam pa rnams ni drang por smras na mgu/ /phyaugs zhen ko long dam la bzang 'dod can//rang rgyud ma thul sgrub pa'i dgos pa stor/ /rang nyid bzang 'dod gzhan las ngan mi 'dod/ /lkog tu chos min spyod pa sna tshogs byed/ /ri khrod 'grims na grags pa che ru re/ /'du 'dzi sbangs kyin dad can 'du la re/ /bya btang byas kyin zas nor yong du re/
/pham kha blang gin phugs su rgyal 'dod cig/

gzhan la bstod na rang la byams su re/ /dag snang byas nas dbang du bsdu 'dod dang*//gzhan phyogs nub cing rang phyogs dar phyir ram/ /grags pa sgrog phyir chos rdzu byed pa ni/ /sems can thams cad bslu ba'i sdig po che/ /de phyir rdzun med phyi nang med par gces/ /snyan grags 'dod pas slob ma bslu ba dang*//rnyed bkur 'dod pas dad can bslu ba dang*/ /ma rtogs bzhin du gnas lugs rtogs so zhes/ /nga rgyal byed pa snying rje'i 'gal zla yin/ /bden pa'i ngag dang drang po'i bsam pa dang*/ /nga rgyal spangs nas 'gro kun gong du 'khur/ /gzhan skyon mi bsam rang gi skyon la rtog /byang chub sems dang snying rje rgyas par 'gyur/ /dgra gnyen tshe 'dir blo yis btags pa yin/ /nye ring med par phan sems snying rje sgoms/ /thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying rje bas/ /de rnams thar thabs rang res 'tshol bar bya/ /da lta'ang dngos su phan na gang phan dang*/ /phan sems bsam pa bzang po 'bral med dang*/ /gtso bor rang nyid chos la gang 'bad pa/ /de dag gzhan la phan pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa phyogs zhen med pa'i snying rje las brtsams pa'i gtam ste gsum pa'o// //zab mo gnas lugs myur du rtogs 'dod na/ /skyo shas snying rus 'dzom pa'i nges 'byung gis/ /dben pa'i gnas su sdod tshugs thub pa gces/ /lkog nyal le lo'i dbang du mi gtong zhing*/ /dran pas nam sleb nyams su len pa la/ /phyi bshol med par 'phral du sbyor ba dgos/ /nyams len thun sgom skabs su yid sun nas/ /nyal lam 'chag 'dod skyo sangs byed 'dod dam/ /bya ba gzhan zhig byed 'dod skyes pa'i tshe/ /dge sbyor yong dang mi yong sa mtshams ni/ /'di skabs yin snyam bya byed gzhan bor nas/ /sgom 'jug 'thud nas rnam g.yengs spong bar byos/ /skyo sangs yin kyang rnam g.yengs dbang song na/ /de la yengs nas don med yun ring 'da'/ /nad mang las nyams chung zhing khams dub na/

/ngal bso dgos mod de skabs sems klong nas/ /bzo bcos mi bya dran pas zin tsam dgos/ /rnam rtog gya gyu'i dbang du ma shor bar/ /na tsha la sogs gang shar de la ltos/ /thun dang thun mtshams dbyer med mtshungs par 'gyur/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal dran pa'i skyo shas dang*/ snying rje mkha' khyab bcos ma min pa dang*/ nam yang brjed med bla ma'i mos gus te/ /'di gsum med mi rung ba'i yan lag yin/ /sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi/ /dngos gzhi lta ba dang ni bskyed rdzogs sgom/ /yi rang bsngo dang dam bca' rjes kyi gnad/ /'di rnams mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po yin/ /'gyu byed phyi ma ma skyes snga ma 'gags/ /de gnyis bar na gang yang mi mno yang*/ /gsal rig 'gag pa med pa de ka skyong*/ /de la ngos gzung gang yang yod pa min/ /dga' dang mi dga' bde sdug chags sdang dang*/ /snying la 'bab dang zhe la 'phog pa'i gtam/ /thos sogs sems kyi 'gyu ba gang byung yang*/ /rang zhal bltas nas bzo bcos med par zhog /rang ngo ma shes sems rtsa spun po te/ /de ltar brtags na wal po rjes med cig /rang rig dmigs gtad bral ba kho na yin//rnam rtog ma spangs rang sar dag ces gags/ /'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs rnam rtog gang*/ / nyon mongs skyes na gang shar ngos gzung la/ /sgo gsum de yi dbang du mi gtong bar/ /skyon du blta ba'ang mi bya thad sor bzhag/ thog ma nyon mongs lhang nger snang tsam na'ang*/ /rig tsam brjod bral rjen ne gsal ler 'char/ /de nas nyon mongs tsam gyi snang ba de/ /rang sar log ste ye shes chen po lags/ /de rjes snying rjes zin pa gal re che/ /de bzhin dge ba'i rnam rtog sogs la'ang sbyar/ /sems nyid gnas sam yang na 'gyu yang rung*/ /spros bral gshis kyi rgya las mi 'da' 'o/ /zhes pa gang shar rang grol gyi lta sgom las brtsams pa'i gtam ste bzhi pa'o// //'du 'dzi mang sar dge sbyor skye ba dkon/

/rang dang 'tsham pa'i dben pa bsten pa legs/ /brtan pa ma thob bar du rgyal khams kun/ /yang yang 'grims na lang shor dge sbyor 'chag /ri la ma tshugs yang yang klung la 'bab/ /bzang rdzu dgos pas yang yang ri la 'gro/ /blo sna mang zhing chos khyad rlung gis 'khyer/ /de ltar mi bya blo rtse 'gyur med gces/ /smon lam bzang po'i mthu can ma gtogs pa/ /sde dpon bsten pa chos pa'i bdud du che/ khyad par bya btang spros pa spong ba dang*/ /pho brang 'grim pa 'gal ba ltag sprod yin/ /ha cang dag snang ches na bcol chung yin/ /tshod rgyag skur 'debs log lta'ang mi bya ste//rang la nga rgyal gzhan la khyad gsod spang*/ kha spyad ngos 'dzin thal ba'ang mi 'tshal lo/ /sad ser bsrung dang grong 'dre 'dul ba dang*/ /mo rtsis sngags dang sman dpyad glud gtor dang*/ /mngon shes brdzus mas gzhan mgo ma skor zhig /sgom chen rnams la 'di rnams bar chad mang*/ /don med gshags 'byed mang na mi rnams sdang*/ /lkog lab mang na ngan pa'i gral du 'gro/ /phra ma mu skyo mang na gzhan sems dkrug /de bas smra ba spangs na legs pa yin/ /mi sems khrid phyir rdzun ni dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /bden par smras na mi rnams sems khong 'khrug /long gtam dge sbyor gcog pa'i phung 'dre yin/ /chags sdang smras na ngag gi sdig par 'gro/ /nyin mtshan dge sbyor kho nar brtson dgos kyang*/ /mi mang 'dus sar gsol 'debs skad rgyang dang*/ /skye bo'i mdun du lta stangs 'dug tshul sogs/ /chos brgyad dbang gis gsang sgrogs byar mi rung*/ /mngon tshan chung la sa chod che ba dgos/ /mi nag grong pa'i skye bo pho mo rnams/ /dad pa skye phyir rang rgyud grol mdog dang*/ /bya ba btang tshul snying rje che mdog dang*/ / nyams rtogs skyes pa'i chos skad rbad kham dang*/ /rtsa rlung ngom ngom byed pa de mi rung*/ / skye bo bslus pas chos pa'i khyu nas bud/ /gsang sgrogs rtsa ltung 'byung bas dam tshig nyams/

/rang re spyod pa ngo lkog mi bya ste/ /gsus pa 'gengs phyir dmyal bar 'gro nus sam/ /tshul 'chos g.yo sgyu spong ba shin tu gces/ / 'on kyang ngo lkog med pa yin zer nas/ /rtsing chos phaṭa ral dran tshad byed pa ni/ /bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren che zhig rang yang lhung*/ /sgo gsum bya ba rnam dag kho na byed/ /ngan pas gos na 'phral du bshags pa 'bul/ /yo byad kun spangs ri la sdong tshugs shing*/ /ri pa bya btang zhes bya'i ming med par/ / gnod pa byed la lan du phan 'dogs kyang*/ /nga ni bsam sbyor bzang zhes mi ngom la/ /dam chos min pa byed rgyu med pa la/ /chos pa bzang snyam rlom sems mi byed na/ /sgom chen bzang ba'i tshad du phyin pa yin/ /yul dang bzang 'dzin che zhing yon tan ngom/ /yon tan gzhan kun 'dzom yang khong rul lags/ /bya byed thams cad phan sems kho nas bya/ /gnyid dang zas dang spyod lam gtor ma sogs/ /so so'i rnal 'byor rnams kyang rel med dang*/ gang shar dran 'dzin bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ /nges 'byung dad pa rnams dang 'bral med gces/ /lta sgom spyod pa cha lugs la sogs pa/ /gzhan rnams kun dang ha cang 'gal ba spang*/ /kun dang mthun yang rang lugs tshugs par 'tshal/ /phan sems che yang grong kha mi 'grim zhing*/ /ltag tshugs bzang yang ko long mi dam pa/ /'di dag cis kyang lag tu longs par mdzod/ /ces pa ni chos nyams len gnad du 'gro ba'i spyaud pa las brtsams pa'i gtam ste lnga pa'o// //gzhan yang rang gi dge ba rnams byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ bsngo bya dge rtsa yang sgyu ma lta bu/ bsngo byed rang nyid kyang sgyu ma lta bu/ bsngo ba'i ngo bo 'bras bu la 'dun zhing sems pa bsngo ba'i tshig dang bcas pa yang sgyu ma lta bu/ bsngo ba'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang kyang sgyu ma lta bu/ thams cad snang stong gny-is su med par shes pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i yid ches kyi smon lam 'debs pa ste/

dang por bzang spyod sogs rgyal ba'i bka' rnams kyi thog drangs nas/ rjes su 'di skad ces bya'o/ /bdag gis dad pa nges 'byung snying rje dang*/ /byang chub sems dang gnas lugs sgom pa dang*/ /phyag 'tshal mchod dang bsags pa yi rang dang*/ /lha sgoms sngags bzlas dge rtsa gang bgyis dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje lha mo dang*/ /skyes mchog bla ma dam pa'i sku gzugs rnams/ /zhig pa gsos shing gsar du bzhengs pa dang*/ /gtsug lag khang gi bya ba byas pa sogs/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba gang yod rnams/ /'gro kun dge dang sras bcas rgyal ba yi/ /rnam dkar 'phṛn las rgya mtshor zhugs pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs nas/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob pa dang*/ /de srid gegs med bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig/dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med pa yi/ /ye shes dam pa mngon du gyur nas kyang*/ /lhun gyi grub pa'i gzhan don 'byung gyur cig /nad gdon bar chad thams cad rab zhi zhing*/ /gegs dang gol sa kun las rang grol nas/ /chos dbyings sems nyid rang ngo rtogs nas kyang*/ /dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams mchid gyur cig /bdag nyid mthong thos reg dang dran pa rnams/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i sems can bgrang las kun/ /las nyon sdug bsngal ma lus myur zhi nas//bde dge phun tshogs thams cad rgyas gyur cig /bla ma chos skur mthong ba'i mos gus dang*/ /gang shar ma bcos rang sar grol pa dang*/ sgrub la bar chad rnam g.yeng med pa dang*/ /lhag bsam dag pas gzhan rgyud grol gyur cig/ bla ma mchog dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing*/ /yi dam kun gyi byin gyis brlobs pa dang*/ /bstan bsrung thams cad bran du khol ba dang*/ /'brel can thams cad don chen 'grub gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni bzo gnas legs shes shing*//sgrub la mos pa de dang grogs dag gis/ /yang yang bskul nas jo nang dpal gyi rir/ /tā ra nā tha zhes byas sbyar ba yin// //zhes pa 'di ni lha bzo ba bod mkhas pa don grub rgyal mtshan dang*/ rang gi lhan cig spyod pa gtsang ba kun dga' dpal bzang gis bskul nas smras pa'o// bkra shis//༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ dri bral mkha' la nyin byed shar ba ltar/ /sgrib bral ye shes shes bya kun khyab de/ /spros bral thugs rje'i rol par rtag shar ba/ /mtshungs bral rje btsun bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /shes bya'i mtshan nyid bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ /tha snyad brjod pa zad med dpag tu med/ /lam gyi ston tshul rnam pa mang na yang*/ /sny-ing po gnad nas bzung na 'di ltar lags//dad pa can la sdig pa'i go skabs med/ /nges 'byung can la zhen chags le lo med/ /mos gus can la dkon mchog 'du 'bral med/ /snying rje can la rang 'dod khong sran med/ /dkar nag las 'bras mi slu nges shes bskyed//tshig bshad mkhas shing kha lta mtho ba dang*/ /'dug tshugs bzang yang sdig la ma 'dzems na/ /ngan song gsum gyi gting rdo thang ma yin/ kha drag dpung 'dzom longs spyod ldan pa yang*/ /lo zla zhag 'ga' tsam gyi pho so yin/ /pha rol 'gro tshe dbang med las kyis 'khrid/ /rlom sems can la kha nyen skabs der 'bab/ /dgra gnyen nor khang g.yog 'khor la sogs pa/ /rang dbang 'byor skabs dag la sbyar na legs/ /ngais par 'bral la myur du 'ong nges pas/ / dbang med je bral de la phan yon ci/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor thob kyang tshim pa med/ /nyon mongs dug gsum rgyas pas las ngan bsog /mtho ris thob dus dmyal ba'i bre kha 'gengs/ /bde ba chung ngus sdug bsngal chen po bsgrub/ /e ma 'khor ba'i rang bzhin de 'dra la/ /legs par bsams na su zhig chags par 'gyur/ /grogs dang nye dus phan pa'i re med kyis/

/skyabs su bzang ba bla ma dkon mchog yin/ /mos gus zhan rnams rang blo'i mun pas bsgribs/ /yid ches mos gus snyems 'khrigs bral ba bsgom/ /de las phun tshogs 'bras bu kun 'byung ste/ /chos kun rang gi bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin/ /chos kyi rtsa ba bsam pa'i 'gro ldog lags/ /sgo gsum chos la 'bad par rlom na yang*/ / 'jig rten 'phral bde'i rang 'dod mun nag na/ /phyogs zhen chos kyi chags sdang 'byung po rol/ /rang sems gnas lugs ma rtogs nyon mongs 'khrugs/ / las ngan dbang gis 'gro drug srid par 'khyams/ /sgyu ma'i 'khrul bas sems can 'di rnams bslus/ /nga rgyal khengs pa mi bya snying rje sgoms/ /da ni snying po'i gnad la gdams par bya/ /rang sems spros bral bya ba logs na med/ /tha mal shes pa bzo bcos med par skyongs/ /gang shar rjen pa de la rang so tshugs/ /ched du bcos pa'i lta sgom bzang bzang po/ /blo yis bris pa'i ri mo zar zir yin/ /rang gi sdod lugs sgom du ma shar na/ /logs nas nyams len tshol ba dbul shing 'phongs/ /rang dus nyid du rang grol ma shes na/ /rjes 'ded skyel ma tsam te byed skad yin/ /'char sgo stong pa'i rtsal du ma rig na/ / rgyas 'debs tsam gyi thal g.yogs de yis ci/ /ma rtogs kha yan smyon pa'i rnam thar la/ /ma bcos so mar 'khrul na rtsa ba 'chug /ngos gzung med pa'i rang ngo ma mthong na/ /gnas pa bzang yang gti mug mun 'thoms yin//brjod bral sems kyi rang rtsal 'gag med de/ /phyir ltas ma shor rang gsal ngang la zhog / gang shar de kas chog na sgom gyi mchog /'on kyang don med lus na lung ma bstan/ /rang rig nam yang 'khrul tu ma 'jug cig/ 'khrul kyang chog na bde ba'i yang rtse yin/ /rtag tu bya byed bdag po med par zhog /byas kyang bya rgyu zad na spros bral yin/ /sgra phyir 'brangs pa'i rtog dpyod mi 'tshal te/ /byed blo rang sar grol na mtshan med yin/

/gzhag thabs rgyal po lhug pa rang dga' lags/ /dbyings nyid rtsol par rag na bzo med mchog /gnas sam 'gyu yang yengs med thabs kyi mchog /yengs pa'i rang mtshang rig na gnas pa'i mchog /dbyings las rang shar tsam gyi rnam rtog dang*/ /bya byed rtsol par shar nas rang sar thim/ /de ltar rtogs na ma bcos so ma yang*//rang sar sangs te bcos dang ma bcos med/ /bsgom bya sgom byed rang sar stong pa na/ /snang ba thams cad sgom du shar zhes grags/ /da ni de dag gnang du 'gro ba la'ang*/ / nyams len chos kyi bzo thabs legs par 'tshal/ /u tshugs 'tshong ba'i thag chod yus yus po/ /mdo med po gcig gol sa'i g.yang la lhung*/ /tha mal lus la gces 'dzin spong ba dang*/ /snang ba kun la bden 'dzin bshig pa gces/ /bden zhen a mthas je dam gong 'phel zhig /gnas lugs rtogs par 'dod pa shin tu 'khrul/ /phyogs cha zad pa'i byams dang snying rje yis/ /ci byed gzhan gyi don du sbyar bar bya/ /'gal phyogs dgra la nyes 'dod ngan sems can/ /zhe sdang lam 'khyer zer yang 'ud gog yin/ /'dod zhen nye ba'i sred pas mi 'ching bar/ /yid 'ong sems kyang rmi lam lta bur ltos/ /'di ni lha ste bdag la phan 'dogs pas/ khyed kyis skyobs zhes re ba dung dung dang*/ / 'dre 'dis bdag la nges par gnod do snyam/ /gnod sems 'jigs skrag dogs pa'i 'dam du bying*/ /de dag sems kyi snang cha mnyam po la/ /blang dor dga' sdug rang gis rang nyid bslus/ /nad dang nyams nga chags che byung gin dogs/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sangs te 'gro la re/ /chos kyi 'bras bu tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dod/ /'dod pa ma grub dkon mchog gsum la 'khang*/ /tshe 'di'i skyid sdug sngon gyi las las byung*/ /gang byung chog shes byas na zhe blo bde/ /phy-in chad chos kyi phan yon bslu ba med/ /blo sna gcig tu dril la yid ches skyed/ / rang la nyams myong yon tan cung zad tsam/

/skyes na nga rgyal 'gong po rjes su 'brang*/ /de la rang ngo shes pa'i thog rdzis dang*/ /nga rgyal yod don med pa'i rgyu mtshan bsam/ /sngon gyi sdig las zad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal byung na 'dod thog go bcad snyam/ /blos 'dis bcos pa ma gtogs sdug bsngal ni/ /dngos por ma grub rang la cher te ltos/ /don la sdug bsngal gzhi med rtsa bral yin/ /kun rdzob tu ni las snang gang shar 'di/ /bcas bcos mi bya re dogs med na bde/ /'on kyang drin can bla mar gsol ba thob/ / mdor na las 'bras chos la yid ches shing*/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /gang la'ang ma chags rang ngo rang shes rtsal/ /sgo gsum longs spyod dge ba bsog rtsi zhing*/ /rtag tu gzhan phan bsam pa bzang po 'chang/ /lnga po de la chos kyi mdo kun 'dus/ /smon lam dag pas rtag tu mtshams sbyor zhing*//re dogs spong dang skyabs gnas dam pa mchod/ /chos 'di gsum yang gnad kyi don chen yin/ /de ltar cha tsam gdams pa 'di dag kyang*/ /thugs su byon na gtan gyi 'dun gros yin/ /bas na blun po'i rang mtshang lags par dgongs/ /'di las ci ste dge bar gyur srid na/ /skye bo kun la thar pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /blo ldan dam pa khyed kyi thugs mtsho yang*/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i chu brgyas gang bar shaug/ // ces pa'ang rig sngags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ sa skyong mi dbang chen po'i bkas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel// //

༄༅/ zab don sngags kyi lam dang 'brel ba gtso che ba'i mgur ma'i skor bzhugs/ / oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ra be/ rje mtshan ldan gy-i bla ma rin po chai/ /rigs kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang*/ /thugs ye shes ngang du rnam rol yang*/ /'phral cir yang ston pa de la 'dud/ /rje rin chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje rin chen sku yis byin gyis rlobs/ /rje rin chen sku la skyabs su mchi/ /lus rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs/ /rje rin chen gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje rin chen gsung gis byin gyis rlobs/ /rje rin chen gsung la skyabs su mchi/ /ngag grag stong rdo rje'i gsung du mdzod/ /rje rin chen thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje rin chen thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /rje rin chen thugs la skyabs su mchi/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dre bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas yang dgon dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /dus de ring bkra shis ya mtshan tshes/ /ma mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i tshogs mchog 'dir/ /sprang bdag gis nyams dbyangs glu ru len/ /mi bdag la yon tan ma mchis kyang*/ khong rtsa brgyud bla ma thugs rje can/ /byin rlabs nus mthu dpag med tshos/ /byin gyis rlabs pas skyid gcig shar/ /gang snang bde ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de ring dga' ba'i glu gcig len/ /rje bla ma byin rlabs mi che ru/ /rang sems chos kyi sku dang mjal/ /nged slob bu mos gus mi che ru//sems can sangs rgyas dngos su btang*/ /sprang tha cung bdag sdug zhen mi che ru/ /rje khyod kyi bka' drin la 'khor thabs med/ /chos gdams ngag la yid ches mi skye ru/ /nyams dang myong ba 'phral du thon/ /don gnas lugs la nges shes mi skye ru/ /rang bzhin gshis la 'gyur ba med/ /bdag rgyud pa mi ngan rgyud pa bzang*/ /brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang la thug /ljongs 'phags pa'i yul na sgra che ba/ khong grub pa'i dbang phyug nyi shu gsum/

/yongs shing rta chen po bcu drug sogs/ /byin rlabs kyi bka' babs chu bo'i rgyun/ /gcig tu 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho ste/ /dus deng sang sa gzhi'i steng 'di na/ /mtshan snyan grags srid pa gsum du khyab/ khong mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan te/ /lha 'byung po kun gyis zhabs la btud/ /rje zhi ba sbas pa ma lags sam/ /mgon de yi thugs kyi sras gcig pu/ /chos man ngag ma lus thugs su chud/ /sngon las 'phro sad pas grub chen mjal/ /don nyams su bzhes pas ye shes brnyes/ /spros med spraud pas 'gro don mdzad/ /rang rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes/ /phyogs ris med pa'i 'gro ba la/ /thugs snying rjes 'gro don rgyun chad med/ /yongs sangs rgyas zer na khyod la zer/ /mtshan bud+dha nā tha ma lags sam/ /nged gdams ngag mi ngan gdams ngag zab/ /gdams ngag rgyal ba'i dgongs don yin/ /lar rgyud sde bzhi yi khong snying te/ /skal ldan la la'i bsod nams las/ /gzhan nga rgyal can gyi spyod yul min/ /phyogs 'dzin can la ga la yod/ /mi kho bo'i bsod nams las 'phro la/ /sangs rgyas shong ba'i bsod nams byung*/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dang mjal ba'i bsod nams byung*/ /da lta snang ba snang stong la/ /rang bzhin med pa'i gu yangs po/ /lha sku rang snang 'gag pa med/ /gang shar dag pa'i snang ba zhig /'di nyin mtshan kun tu gnad du che/ /skyed rim thams cad spros med kyi ngang*/ /ming la spros bcas bya ba med/ /grags stong sngags kyi bzlas pa ste/ /'char sgo dmigs pa'i 'phrul gyi gnad/ /'phrin las lhun grub ngo mtshar che/ /gzhan mtshan bcas kyi bzlas pa ya re cha/ /rje sangs rgyas dngos kyi gdams ngag las/ /mi bdag gis rlung sems dbang du 'dus/ /'phral las rlung 'khor ba'i rgyu 'di nyid/ /dbyings mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ngang du thim/ /rlung dbu mar thim pa 'di la zer/ /rags pa ma dag 'khrul snang 'di/ /phra mo rang byung dbyings su thim/

khong skye bo gzhan la 'khrul snang 'di/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi snang ba 'di/ /sngar yang 'khrul la da yang 'khrul/ /de nga la dag pa'i snang bar gda'/ /gnyis med zung 'jug snang bar gda'/ /sngon nas grol la da yang grol/ /gzhi 'gyur med dag snang lam me ba/ /gang shar rjen ne che re ba//nga rgya 'byams kyi rnal 'byor nyams re dga'/ gu yangs rnal 'byor blo re bde/ khong sdug rtsir mkhan kun yi re mug/ sems gnas kyang stong par lhan ne gda'/ /yid 'gyu yang stong par shar re gda'/ /phyogs su ma lhung rgyar ma chad/ /rmi~X la~Xm 'khrul pa'i zar zir 'di/ /mi phal pa rnams la nyid 'khrul te/ /nged gdams ngag can la dngos grub gda'/ /sngags bye ba dung 'gyur bzlas brjod kyi/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa 'dre gdon 'dul/ /'dre rang la yod pa rtsad ma chod/ /rmi lam 'khrul pa la bden par 'dzin/ /rang sems rmi lam yul yul yong*/ /gnas skabs bar chad thams cad sel/ /rgyal ba'i lha skur rang shar 'di/ /rmi lam la 'dun pa gnad du che/ /gnyid 'thug po gti mug mun pa de/ khong phal pa la sgrib pa ru che ba de/ /nged gdams ngag can la 'od gsal du gda'/ /'od gsal chos sku'i ngo bor gda'/ /chos sku dngos po'i gshis su gda'/ /gshis lugs bde ba chen por gda'/ /rlung sems dbyer med nam mkha'i ngang*/ /lte ba'i dmar cha dbu mar 'bar/ /haṃ yig byang sems chad med 'bab/ /rtsol med dga' bzhi'i nyams myong 'di/ /rang byung thig le rang 'gags gcig /'di gsang sngags sgom na gnad du che/ /tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas la med thabs med/ /spyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la gnad du che//dgos las rgya bsten na gnad du che/ khong gdams ngag med pa rdzas la re//nga phyi la sangs rgyas ga la re/ /gdams ngag med pa tsho snying re rje/ /rang che 'dod can la snying yang tshim/ /lam sgom pas nyon mongs phal par song*/ /ngan song du 'khyam dgos tshe snying re rje/

/mi bdag la thams cad bde ba'i ngang*/ /zhu bde dang rang bzhin dbyer med du 'dres/ /da gang ltar byas kyang lam du gda'/ /sems gnas lugs 'gyur ba med pa dang*/ /yid bla ma'i mos gus 'gyur med dang*/ rten rang lus thig le 'gyur med de/ /'gyur med rnam gsum gyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// //zhes pa'ang bsam gtan sdings su tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su rdo rje'i glur blangs pa ste/ rang lo nyer lngar nye ba tshes bcu bdun gyi mtshan mo'i thun dang po la ste/ maṅgalaṃ//༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rang bzhin gdod nas 'gyur med la/ /mkhyen rtogs kyi yon tan phyogs bcur rgyas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /phyos bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun/ / dbyings ye shes chen por gcig bsdus pa/ /dpal drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /chos phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ /bka' gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /don nges gsang snying por dril ba ni/ /sngags rgyu sde bzhi po gsungs so skad/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu mngon byed pa/ /bla med kyi thaig pa kho na lags/ /spyir rnal 'byor chen po rgya che zhing*/ /dgos rnal 'byor ma rgyud zab pa'i phul/ /yongs rgyal bas gsungs pa'i rgyud kun gyi/ /zab don gyi nges gsang mthar thug kun/ /gang sbas gsang med par gsal bar bstan/ /don khyad par bzhi pa'i ye shes de/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bgrod gcig lam//de ji bzhin ma 'dres gsal bar gsungs/ /mtshan rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rgyal po/ /'dus pa don dam zhes yongs su grags/ /sngon bskal pa dpag med sngon rol du/ /dbugs dbyung rnam gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bstan/ /sgrol ma'i rgyud rgyal gsungs zhes bshad/ khyad par mi mjed kyi 'dren pa mchog/mtshan shākya seng ges zab pa'i don/ /chos rdo rje theg pa 'di gsungs nas/ /slar lha klu rig 'dzin kun la gtad/

/dus phyi mar sngags kyi gdul bya rnams/ /lho 'dzam bu gling du dar ba'i tshe/ /rgyu kun gyi rgyal po 'di yang phebs/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi dbang du na/ /sngon grub thob ti li chen po nas/ /mi kho'i bla ma yan chad du/ /grub thob 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa/ /so so skye bos bar ma chod/ khyad par rtsod ldan phyi ma'i dus/ /mtha' dag 'gro ba'i 'dren pa ni/ /mtshan brjod par dka' ba zhi ba'i zhabs/ khong he ru ka dpal dngaus su bzhugs/ /rje de nyid kyi thugs kyi gsang mdzod can/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi rdo rje 'chang*/ /mtshan snyan po sangs rgyas sbas pa ste/ /mi kho bo'i bsod nams dpal du byon/ /rgyud kun gyi nyams len mdor bsdu na/ /smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lam/ /sems rang bzhin gdod ma'i sku bzhi po/ /thabs cho ga'i 'phrul gyis sgrib sbyangs te/ /mthar sku bzhi'i sa bon 'debs pa la/ /mtshan smin byed dbang bskur zhes pa yin/ /brda' rdul tshon la sogs dkyil 'khor dang*/ / don rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gang shar rgyal ba rigs lnga ngo sprod pa/ /'di bum dbang gi gnad du kho bos 'khums/ /ngag tshig gi brjod pa sna tshogs 'di/ /don brjod bral dbyings su ngo sprad nas/ /gsung rdo rje'i sa bon 'debs pa la/ /ming gsang ba'i dbang du btags pa lags/ /sems rang bzhin brjod bral mi 'gyur pa/ /gzhi gdod ma'i bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /de ji bzhin gsal bar ngo sprod pa/ /dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes lags//sems brjod bral spros pa kun spangs pa/ /yod med dang blang dor kun las grol/ /gsal stong dang bde bas ma bcings pa/ /rang grol 'di bzhi pa'i ye shes lags/ /grol byed kyi nyams len rim pa gnyis/ /ming gzhan du rnal 'byor bzhi zhes grags/ /de sngags kyi spyod pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /mthar sku gsum ye shes lnga la sbyor/ /'khrul snang phung khams skye mched 'di/

/snang stong dbyer med lha yi sku/ /dag snang gi 'khor lo bsgyur pa la/ /rnal 'byor dang po zhes su btags pa yin/ /rang bzhin brjod bral lhun grub la/ /rkyen bla ma'i man ngag thabs mchog gis/ /don rtsa bral nyid du ston pa la/ /lam rjes su rnal 'byor zhes su btags/ /rtsa g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gi rgyu ba kun/ /nang a ba dhū tīr legs bcings nas/ /rkyen las kyi phyag rgyas bde sgrub pa/ /ming shin tu rnal 'byor bya'o skad/ /dbyings mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar/ /'phral snang ba ma 'gags ye shes sku/ /don thams cad stong pa 'od gsal dang*/ / mthar zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la sbyar ba ni/ /yongs mthar thug rnal 'byor chen po ste/ /rkyen rtsa rlung thig le'i rten 'brel las/ /gzhi lus ngag yid gsum dag byed pa/ /'di gnas skabs rnal 'byor chen po yin/ /spyir gsang sngags 'dod yon lam byed dang*/ /dgos 'phral spyod chos brgyad ro snyoms pa/ /rkyen spyod pa gsum gyi rten 'brel las/ /mthar dngos grub mchog la bar med sbyar/ /lus gnas gyur gyi sprul sku dang*/ /ngag gnas gyur gyi longs sku dang*/ /rang sems gnas gyur chos kyi sku/ /dbyer med bde ba chen po'o//bka' mdo rgyud kyi gnad don ma lus pa/ /don snying por dril ba rgyud 'di yin/ /rgyud kun gyi don yang de tsam ste/ /de ltar thugs la gzhog par zhu// //bkra shis/ /༄༅/ /oṃ ya mā ri de ba maṇ+ḍa la na ma stu bh+yaṃ/ bla ma gshin rje gshed po la/ /gus pas yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog med dus nas bgegs byed pa'i/ /nga bdag 'gong po rlag par mdzod/ /dus la bab po thugs brtser mdzod/ /gti mug mun pas sgribs pas na/ /sems ni 'dod chags rgya mtshor lhung*/ /nga rgyal rba rlabs shugs kyis g.yeng*/ ser sna'i mdud pas dam du bcings/ /zhe sdang drag po me ltar 'bar/ /phrag dog rlung gis phyogs kun

khyer/ /dus dang gnas skabs 'di lta bur/ /gzhan ni su la ram mda' sbron/ /bdag cag rang nyid brtson 'grus kyis/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa thob dus na/ khyed kyi thugs rjes ci zhig 'tshal/ /las kyi shugs ni stobs ldan pa/ /rgyal bas skyob par mi 'tshal na/ /las ngan med par sdug bsngal ni/ /gang na su la'ang yod min pas/ /skyabs gnas kyis ni ci zhig bya/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig dus la bab/ /yal yol btang snyoms ma mdzad par/ /sdug bsngal sems can rnams la gzigs/ /mar gyur 'gro la gzigs su gsol/ /bskal pa'i bar du dmyal me tsha bas bsregs/ /da dung las ngan cha tsam ma zad par/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal rgyud mar myong ba yi/ /pha ma rnams la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol/ khyed kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer re res kyang*/ /sems can grangs med grol bar mdzad ces thos/ /bdag 'dzin gdon gyis rlams pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /da dung 'khor bar 'jog gam gzigs su gsol/ /lto kham tsam gyi phyir du pha ma'ang gsod/ /rang la khab tsam zug kyang mi bzod cing*/ /gzhan lus dum bur gtong ba'i phod kham can/ /gces 'dzin gdon gyis khyer rnams snying re rje/ /rang nor til 'bru tsam yang sbyin mi phod/ /gzhan nor 'phrog la dga' ba'i blo nyes po/ /bzod bsran chung la ham pa che ba yi/ /skye bo rmongs pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi nor rdzas 'phrog la dga'/ /'di phyi kun tu sdug bsngal kho na'i g.yos/ /'dun ma gting nas nyes kyang skyid por 'khrul/ /snyings dus skye bo rnams kyi 'khrul tshabs la/ /sku gzugs glegs bam bshig pa'i longs spyod kyis/ /rang gzhan bsdebs nas dmyal bar 'gro ba la/ /pho grung mo grung yin snyam 'khrul tshabs la/ /snying med bdag kyang snying rje gting nas skyes/ kha tsam mdzes mdzes snyan snyan min par skyes/ /las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal yod tshad myong*/ /sdug bsngal byung yang da dung sdig rang bsog

/spyang por rlom pa'i glen pa snying re rje/ /de ltar nyes pa thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba bdag 'dzin dam pas lan/ /gzhan la thes med bsam pa dang*/ /rang la gces 'dzin 'gong po 'di/ /da lta nyid du tshar chod cig /myur ba nyid du rlag par mdzad/ /de ring gtan gyi dgra 'di thul/ /de ring gtan gyi gdon 'di thul/ /brtson 'grus bskyed la da lta thul/ / btang snyoms ma mdzad da lta choms// //zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras/ /bdag 'dzin dgra bgegs thul bar shog/maṅgalaṃ//༄༅/ /'brel med kyi glu bzhugs so/ /༈ 'brel med kyi glu zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ chu bo rgyun mi 'chad 'bab pa/ /sems kyi chu 'di ngo mtshar che/ /bye ma'i phung po chen po ltar//reg la ma 'byar pa 'di ngo mtshar che/ /sems la 'brel ba med pa ngo mtshar che/ kha sang nga ni na'o zhes/ /rmongs pa rnams ni rtag par sgom/ /skad cig re res 'das pas na/ /sems la 'brel ba ma mthong ngo*/ /ri bo 'di yi bya ma rnams/ /chu 'gram 'di ru sleb po zhes/ /gzhan la gzhan du 'khrul pa yin/ /yang na thams cad 'brel med de/ /yang na thams can 'brel lo zhes/ / smyon pa tā ra nā tha smra/ /'di ni bdag gi bu dang pha/ /g.yog dang 'khor ni nga la yod/ /nga yi yul sar ma sdod zhes/ /gzhan la nga bdag byed pa 'khrul/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta'i bar du 'khyam pa la/ /thams cad pha yin thams cad bu/ /thams cad g.yog yin thams cad dpon/ /pha ma gsod la dpa' bor rtsi/ /nga la sems can thams cad pha/ /dgra ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /bu ru ma gyur cung zad med/ /rang gi bu ni mang po 'di/ /dgra ru bzung nas bu ngan zhig

/nga yi bu zhes pang du len de 'khrul/ /da lta rang lus bor nas 'gro ba la/ /gcig la bdag gi bu zhes blun po 'khrul/ /de la chags pas 'khor bar bskyur ba 'dis/ /'di ni gtan gyi dgra bo ma yin nam/ /mi shes 'jig rten rmongs la kun kyang dgra/ /rnal 'byor de la snang ba thams cad grogs/ /'brail med rnal 'byor nga la dgra bo med/ /sems ni 'brel ba med par shais tsam na/ /snang ba 'di yang 'brel ba med par mthong*/ /rang lus thal bar song ba la/ /gnyen dang 'brel ba ga la yod/ /sems 'di skad cig re re las/ /gzhan ni 'brel ba ma mthong bas/ /lus sems 'brel ba ga la yod/ /nga la 'di yis bsnun no zhes/ /don med zhe sdang ma byed cig /sems kyi mgron po brel ba can/ /lus kyi mgron khang hrul po na/ /yud tsam ngal bso byed pa la/ /mkhar las byed pa las ro yin/ /mgron khang gi ni phyi 'khyams la/ /nga yi skyed mos tshal yin zhes/ /smyon pa rnams ni 'o dod 'bod/ /de rang mgron po smyo ba yin/ /gzhan 'ga' bdag la khro na yang*/ /nga la ci yang gnod pa med/ /nga la 'brel ba med pas na/ /bu yis rgyal srid thob pa la'ang*/ /dga' thag chad pa ga la yod/ /bdag nyid dmyal bar song na yang*/ /sdug thag chad pa nga la med/ /sdug dang 'brel rgyu mi 'dug pas/ /dmyal ba na yang bde ba can//bde dang 'brel rgyu mi 'dug pas/ /brgya byin la yang smon rgyu med/ /yul 'khor me yis tshig na yang*/ /nga la ci yang 'tshig rgyu med/ /'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs brgya/ /rang grol nyid du shes tsa na/ /dug rnams kho na bdud rtsir song*/ /sngon nas ye shes yin pa la/ /rang gis nyon mongs bcos 'di mtshar/ /sems las 'khor ba kun byung yang*/ /'khor ba sems la 'brel ba med/ /sangs rgyas sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /sangs rgyas la yang 'brel ba med/ /'brel med mnyam po yin pa la/ /ngas ni spangs blang ma shes so/ /bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin las/

/'brel med sems kyi tshul lugs shes/ /e ma ho 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /nyes na 'di la mtshar kyi med/ /da ni zhen med glu gcig blang*/ /nye du rnams dang phrad na yang*/ /'dod pa'i gdung ba skyed par zad/ /mi mdza' rnams dang phrad na ni/ /zhe sdang me yis rang rgyud sreg /sngon ni khyim ni 'byor pa las/ /da lta shin tu rgud do zhes/ /rang gi rang sems sdug la 'dogs/ /yang na 'byor par gyur pa na/ /sa steng na ni dpa' bo nga*/ /nga min gzhan med bdag lhag zhes/ /yid kyi nga rgyal byed pa ni/ /nga rgyal byed kyin dmyal bar song*/ /rang nyid 'byor pa kun ldan yang*/ /da dung tshim pa med pas sdug /nor gyis dregs pa'i nga rgyal can/ /gcig kyang gtong ba mi phod par/ /'chi tshe mi 'dod bzhin du 'bul/ /dbang med 'khyams dgos byung gi dogs/ /nor rnams gzhan gyis phrogs kyi dogs/ /'ga' zhig rngan par sbyin snyam dang*/ /'khor g.yog skyong ngam bu smad gso/ /dpon gyi ngo 'dzin bya dgos sogs/ /nor ldan thams cad sdug bsngal yin/ /sred dang ldan na bde ba med//yid du sdug pa'i gnyen dang grogs/ /cis kyang ma phan shi ba'i tshe/ /mya ngan skyed pa ma gtogs pa/ /phan pa cung zad ma byung ngo*/ /da lta dbang phyug phun tshogs kyang*/ /gnyen gyis slus kyi dogs pa dang*/ /dgra bos bcom gyis dogs pa dang*/ /gzhan la ngan spyod ma song dogs/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal kho na yin/ /mthon po rnams la sems skyid med/ /dman pa'i lus ni sha thang bcad/ /rang la 'byor pa phun tshogs kyang*/ /gzhan la sbyin pa'i blau med par/ /dbul po 'ga' yi 'bul ba la/ /phul gang tsam zhig chung na yang*/ /rang rgyud 'khrug pa'i rgyud ngan po/ /skyid snyam mig dpangs mtho na yang*/ /tshe 'dir skyid pa'i skabs med par/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig bsgrubs nas ni/ /dmyal bar pha yul byed pa 'di/ /'dir sdug phyi mar sdug par gda'/ /mthun rkyen cung zad med kyang rung*/

/zhen med skyid pa nang nas mtshar/ /'byor pa'i dus na kun kyang gnyen/ /rgud pa'i dus na kun kyang dgra/ /dgra gnyen phyogs zhen ma che bar/ /zas gos dman mas chog shes byas/ /grong dang 'du 'dzi mi brten par/ /rang gi pha yul spangs nas kyang*/ / gcig pu ri'am nags 'dabs su//mi smra g.yo med gnas pa'am/ /yang na nges med yul rgyus la/ /grong khyer yul 'khor so ma ru/ /yang yang sprad pa bde ba yin/ /dman pa'i gos kyis chog shes na/ /gos rul kun yang lha yi gos/ / dman pa'i zas kyis chog shes na/ /ngan ngan 'dra yang bdud rtsi yin/ /phul phyed ri ba'i nor med kyang*/ /nor ldan kun pas rang sems skyid/ /skyo na thang 'khyags ri sul sogs/ /zhen med dben pa'i bde ba 'di/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la'ang*/ /smon sems skad cig mi skye'o/ /nang nas nyams len shes tsa na/ /gang snang thams cad sgom du gda'/ /ji ltar sgoms kyang spros bral yin/ /thams cad chos nyid kyi yo langs la/ ma bcos so ma'ang bzang 'dzin du gda'/ /lam la yang zhen pa da mi byed/ khyad gsod du byed na kun la sdig /gdod nas chos skur 'dug pa la/ /sangs rgyas la yang zhen rgyu med/ /de skad smra ba rnal 'byor pa/ /tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas/ /rang gi sems la shar ba'i tshul/ /'ga' zhig kha nas thal ba lags/ /'bral med kyi glu dge legs 'phel// // ༈ na mo gu ra we/ rje bka' drin can gyi rin po che/ /mtshan thos 'khor ba'i gnas las 'dren/ khyod rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can/ /pha bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /yul sa mtho rig pa dwangs pa zhig /ljongs gangs ri'i khrod kyi lte ba gcig /sngon dam pa mang po byon pa gcig /gangs dgung du nangs kyi mtho ba gcig /de ha bo gangs bzang ma lags sam/ / gnas de na rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /pha rtsa brgyud kyi bla mas byin brlabs pa/ /nang rig pa me ltar 'bar ba la/ /phyi chos brgyad kyi dbus na nyal ba

zhig /dus do nub yar gyi tshes bzang po/ /'khor rnal 'byor pho mo'i dkyil 'khor na/ /yongs mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi dbus/ /nyams dga' ba'i rgyang glu tshig gsum len/ /dus da res mi lus rin chen thob/ /'di thob par dka' ba zhig yin par gda'/ /'di thob pas kyang da res mdo don byung*/ / don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /bu chung gi dus nas chos dang mjal/ /nyin mtshan kun chos la skyel ba 'di byas/ /de tsam dus na mdo don yang byung*/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /nga chung chung ma ṇi mi shes dus kyang*/ /dkon mchog la snying nas dad pa dang*/ /thar 'don mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yod/ /rgyu des kyang 'jig rten la blo ma song*/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'//bdag spyang rig 'dzom po gcig ma lags te/ /gsung rab la go ba lhug par chags/ /bdag las bla bzang po gcig ma lags kyang/ /chos phyogs su sdug kyang theg rab byung*/ /bdag rig pa 'char po gcig ma lags kyang*//grub mtha' la cher gyi gting gcig lon/ /bdag bya byed brtson po gcig ma lags kyang*/ /sgom 'phral 'phral rgyun du nyams su blangs/ /mi chos la dgos pa kun med lags kyang*/ /lha chos la dgos pa kun phal cher tshang*/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /bdag longs spyod la sgrub 'dod med lags te/ /sngon las kyis zang zing rjes la bsnyegs/ /mi gzhan ltas zhing ma dag par rtsi/ /gnad 'dis kyang re ltos 'cha' mkhan nyung*/ /stong zob kyi dad can bslu ma dgos/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'//chos sde snod mang du bslabs lags kyang*/ / skal ldan tshe gcig la sangs rgya ba/ /rdo rje'i theg pa la snying phur btab/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /tha snyad la mi tshe ma skyel bar/ /gzhon nu nas snying po'i don la dril/ /bla ma'i man ngag la chig 'dril du byas/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/
