/sngags zhus kyi bla ma mang yod kyang*/ khong dgongs pa gtad pas don 'grub cing*/ /lhug pa rang grol gyi sangs rgyas te/ /rje grub chen rnam gnyis la gsol ba btab/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ nyams kyi rtsal ni phyogs med du shar/ /myong ba yang yang thon nas byung*/ /da ni rtogs pa 'gyur ba med/ /don 'di yang rje btsun bla ma'i drin/ /sngar yang bla ma la gsol ba btab/ /da dung yang pha rgod kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /dus bzhe ning mos gus la 'phel 'grib shor/ /der yang bla ma nyag gcig sgoms/ /yi mug byed kyin yang gsol ba btab/ /phung ngan pa'i lo de 'das phyin chad/ /mos gus sgom gyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /don 'di yang bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ /sngar yang = da dung yang = tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la yid dga' dang*/ /'khor ba'i bde skyid la yid smon dang*/ /snyan grags kyi phye mthor len pa gsum/ /rmi lam gyi dus na yang yul nas bud/ /don 'di yang bla ma'i= sngar yang = da dung yang = da 'gro 'dug spyod lam thams cad du/ /snying rje dang byang sems ma chad tsam/ /don 'di yang = sngar yang = da dung yang = bya ba ci byed thams cad kyang*/ /ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang nas byed/ /gnyis med kyi ngang du rig pa 'phyo/ /don 'di yang = sngar yang = da dung yang = nyon mongs kun ngo bo nyid kyis dag/nyes ltung gi tshogs rnams rag sar grol/ /rtsa bral ngang nas phyogs med du sbyangs/ don 'di yang = sngar yang = da dung yang = dus da tsam re dogs zhig nas gda'//gnyen po yang rang sar zhig nas gda'/ /don 'di yang = sngar yang = da dung yang = rang ltogs sam 'khyags kyi dogs pa'am/ /mis kha ngan 'cha' smod byung dogs sam/ /don ma 'grub gnod pa byung dogs sogs/ /rang sdug rang gis 'chos pa de zhig nas gda'/ /don 'di yang = sngar yang = da dung yang = gtam snyan la re dang skyid la re/ /mi gzhan las lhag pa gcig yod la re/ /rang bzang 'dod bzang 'dzin gyis khog phug pa'i/

/chos dang 'jig rten gyi legs sgrigs sogs/ /re ba phung gi dkyil 'khor de zhig nas thal/ /don 'di yang = sngar yang = da dung yang = nang rtsa yi mdud pa lhod de shig /rten thig le bde ba rang gcig 'bar/ /las rlung gi 'gro 'ong dbang du 'dus/ /'phral bogs 'don phyogs med lhug par bskyangs/ don 'di yang = sngar yang = da dung yang = 'brog bas mtha' gangs kyi mgul pa 'di/ /gnas sman ljongs nyams dga' 'gol ba la/ /'phral 'du 'dzi lang long nyung ba gcig /bdag rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor ldom bu pa'ang*/ /nang rang rig bde stong 'gyur med la/ /'phral mtshams tshig mi shes g.yas med gcig /mi bdag dang dben pa'i gangs khrod 'di/ /chos de gnyis dpe don 'dzom pa gcig gda'/ /sprang kho bo la byin rlabs med lags kyang*/ /rje bla ma thugs rje dang byin rlabs su che/ /tshig 'di la legs cha med 'dug kyang*/ /don 'di la nges pa'i gtad so yod/ /dbyangs 'di la glu rta ma mchis kyang*/ /ngag 'di la shugs 'byung gi zhang gcig gda'//glu 'di la go rim ma mchis kyang*/ /sgra 'di la byin brlabs brjid gcig chags/ /zhes pa'ang ha bo gangs bzang gi mgul/ gu ru pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ mkha' ro gangs sbug gi ri khrod du tshogs 'khor gyi gral du glur blangs pa'o// //dge'o//༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bdag phyogs ris bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dus me tog ldan pa khyu mchog lo/ /yul bkra shis 'phel pa'i g.yo ru na/ /rje bla ma'i bka' drin snying la dran/ /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /mthar da lta'i bar du 'khyams pa lags/ /lar 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa 'dir/ / sems sangs rgyas su gtong ba'i rin po che/ /'gro drug pha ma drin can yang*/ / 'khor bar bskyur rogs gcig ma lags pa/ /gtan gyi 'dun gros la sbyor mkhan med/ /snying gi 'dun gros de rjes la zhus/ /lus sha khrag 'dus pa'i phung po 'di/

/nam 'jig la nges pa cung zad med/ /shi rjes su drod pa'i gdengs med kun/ /rig pa 'di nang du 'gugs par zhu/ /nga 'chi bas 'jigs nas bla ma btsal/ /nyams len kun rdo rus thug par 'bad/ /da tsam nas shi yang blo re bde/ /blo bde tshags su chug pa gcig mi dgos sam/ /nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba 'di dang gcig /mtho dman 'byor rgud kyi ri mo 'di dang gnyis//rgyal khams yul phyogs kyi 'gyur tshabs 'di dang gsum/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'/ /byas kyang zin med kyi zhing las 'di dang gcig /bskyangs kyang drin med log sgrub kyi spyod pa dang gnyis//'thungs kyang ngoms med kyi lan tshwa'i chu dang gsum/ /las don med du ston pa'i slob dpon gcig mi gda'/ /grong khyer 'du 'dzi'i lang log 'di dang gcig /brel la don chung sbrang bu'i spyod pa 'di dang gnyis/ /sprin dkar ban bun gyi 'gyed 'khor 'di dang gsum/ /'khor ba gtad med du ston pa'i ngo sprod gcig gda'/ /snang la gzugs med kyi 'ja' tshon 'di dang gcig/ lhang lhang dmigs med kyi brag cha 'di dang gnyis/ /med kyang dga' sdug 'char ba'i rmi lam dang gsum/ /snang ba rang sems su ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'//phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor dang gcig /nang rig pa sems kyi 'char sgo dang gnyis/ /dbyings ngos gzung bral ba'i stong nyid dang gsum/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med gcig gda'/ /lar nyams myong cung zad gcig skyes tsa na/ /snang ba gang shar ci shar ngo sprod du 'dug /sgo gsum bya ba ci byas bogs 'don du gda'/ /don 'di la bsams na a la la/ /nga yang mi tshe'i lhag ma cung zad 'di/ /nyams len sgrub pa la skyel ba dang*/ /dben pa'i ri khrod zin pa dang*/ /gang shar lam du longs pa ru/ /drin can bla ma rin chen gyis/ /sngar tshad gzung med par byin brlabs mod/ /da yang byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

/ skyabs gzhan med do chos kyi rje/ /tā ra nā thas rgyal khams kyi 'gyur lugs 'dra mthong bas/ sems la ngo sprod pa ltar gyur pa'i skabs shin tu glur blangs pa'o// //bkra shis 'phel//༄༅/ /na mo mahā mu drā ya/ dbyings bde ba chen po'i nam mkha' la/ /rig pa ye shes phyogs med kyi rtsal/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gza' skar bkra/ /rje dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ /sprang gus pas khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /lar byin gyi rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /ya gi shed dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /sku mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i thugs/ khong rdo rje 'chang zhes grags pa ste/ /yongs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin no skad/ /de gzhan na yod pa ma yin te/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu lags/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis/ /mi nga yang brtan pa cung zad zin/ /gzhi ma bcos gnyug ma'i gnas lugs la/ /thag chod kyi gdeng 'di nyams su dga'/ /sems gsal la dwangs pa'i rang snang la/ /mi 'char bya ba ni gcig kyang med/ /de shar tsam nyid nas grol ba 'di/ /rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma lags sam/ /yongs rang ngo shes pa'i g.yengs med 'di/ /zhi gnas kyi sgom zhes bya ba lags/ /rang bzhin ma rnyed pa'i rtsa bral 'di/ /lhag mthong shes rab ma lags sam/ /rje rang sems dang dbyer med du shes tsa na/ /chos sku zhal mjal la dka' rgyu med/ /rang zhal mthong ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus bskyed/ /bdag dal 'byor mi lus thob pa dang*/ /spyir du chaus dang mjal ba dang*/ /sgos su gsang sngags thob pa dang*/ /yang sgos zab don rig pa 'di/ /sngon cung zad bsod nams bsags pa'i rtags/ /blo cung zad chos la song ba dang*/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mas bskyangs pa dang*/ /chos mdo rgyud la nges pa rnyed pa dang*//'phral chags sdang phyogs ris med pa 'di/ /yul gang du bsdad kyang skyid par gda'/ /tshe 'dir ltas kyi bde ba'i mgo bskor dag/gtam snyan gyi phye mthor ma blangs shing*/

/dbang thang la smon sems ma byas pas/ /dus nam yang blo sems bde mor byung*/ /phyi chos su brdzus pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ /nang khong du bzung ba'i ngag snyan dang*/ /phugs rang 'dod kha rgyal gyi gzhan don byed/ /don 'di gsum spangs pas chos su song*/ /tshul 'di yang dpal ldan bla ma'i drin/ /da dung yang gsol ba 'debs lags pas/ /byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i byin brlabs kyis/ /deng phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas yar 'brog stag lung du tshogs kyi 'khor lor nges par brjod pa'i glu dbyangs so// //maṅgalaṃ bistār ku ru//༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ sems can gyi bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /'phrin las 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*/ /thugs rnam par mi rtog thugs rje can/ /bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs bde chen ngag las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sku rlung sems tsam la mtshan dpes spras/ khong gdul bya dag pa'i 'gro don mdzad/ /rje longs spyod rdzogs skur gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyings rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngang*/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rtsal/ /gdod nas spros pa kun bral ba/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar thug pa'i bar/ /dus gsum dge ba ci yod pa/ /rje bla ma khyed la mchod par 'bul//deng dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /phyi 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs dang*/ /nang zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du sbrail/ /mchog bde stong dbyer med gsang pa'i 'phrul/ /de thams cad ma bcos ma 'gags rtsal/ /de nyid kyi mchod pa rgya cher 'bul/ /dus da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal pa la/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro/ /gdul bya'i ma rig mun pa sel/

/pha bla ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /mi kho bo'i sems kyang nyi ma dang mtshungs/ /ngo bo 'phel 'grib med pa dang*/ /snang ba ma 'gags phyogs bcur 'char/ /rang bzhin sgrib med 'od du gsal/ /lhag bsam gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ /byams brtse'i 'od dkar 'phro ba dang*/ /nyon mongs kyi tsha gdung sel bas na/ /pha bla ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /mi kho bo'i sems kyang zla ba dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa dang*//byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ /zhe sdang gi mun pa 'joms par mthong*/ /'khor 'das la yangs dog med pa dang*/ /chos kun la nye ring med par khyab/ /sprul pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /pha bla ma nam mkha'i dbyings dang 'dra/ /mi bdag gi sems kyang mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin thogs rdugs med pa dang*/ /spyir yang 'char ba kun gyi rtsal/ /snang ba thams cad 'gag med du snang*/ 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ /byams dang snying rjes brlan pa dang*/ /gdul bya'i dri ma 'khrud pa ste/ /pha bla ma chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra/ /mi bdag gi sems kyang chu rgyun dang mtshungs/ /sngon thog ma med nas tha ma'i bar/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur rgyun chad med/ /rang gi dri ma rang gis sbyong*/ / gting ye shes g.yo ba med pa la/ /'phral 'gro don rba rlabs phyogs bcur g.yo/ /gzhan phan rin chen kun gyi gnas/ /pha bla ma rgya mtsho chen por mtshungs/ /mi bdag gi sems kyang rgya mtsho dang 'dra/ /rang bzhin rnam rtog gi mi g.yo zhing*/ /nam yang rig pa'i rtsal ma 'gags/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /tshogs gnyis kyi gzhi la brten pa dang*/ /rim gnyis kyi bang rim mdzes pa dang*/ /thar 'dod kyi rten sa yin pa'i phyir/ /pha bla ma dang ri rgyal lhun po mtshungs/ /mi bdag gi sems kyang ri rab dang 'dra/ /rang bzhin gyi dag par zhabs brtan zhing*/ /nyams myong gi bang rim mdzes pa dang*/ /dngos grub gnyis kyi rten sar snang*/

/mi kho bo'i bla ma ci 'dra bar/ /'gro drug gi sems kyang de ltar lags/ /don de ltar lags pas dgongs par mdzod/ /mnyam nyid la zhog cig dam tshig can/ /dbyangs 'di yang bla ma la mchod pa 'bul/ /gnas 'dir yang bkra shis dge legs stsol// //zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas tshogs kyi 'khor lor glur blangs pa'o// bkra shis/ shu bhaṃ// ༈ na mo gu ra be/ rje mi gzugs la rdo rje 'chang chen te/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma ma lags sam/ /gdul bya gang mos 'gro don mdzad/ /de brgyud pa'i bla ma ma lags sam/ /dbyings mkha' khyab kyi sgo nas 'gro ba 'dul/ /de rdo rje 'chang chen ma lags sam/ /sprul pa sna tshogs kyis don mdzad pa/ /yi dam gyi lha tshogs ma lags sam/ /nus mthu la thogs pa med pa ste/ /chos skyong bsrung ma ma lags sam/ khyed ye shes gcig gi cho 'phrul las/ /tshul cir yang ston pa ngo mtshar che/ /bdag snying gi khong nas gsol ba 'debs/ /dus da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /deng 'dir dus kyi skal ldan pho mo kun/ /mi bdag gi tshig la snyan gson zhig /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i mi lus la/ /mdo don 'byung ba'i thabs shig 'tshal/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /cis kyang thar pa'i thabs shig 'tshal/ /chos kun gyi 'jug sgo lags pas na/ /tshe 'di blo yi btang yang 'tshal/ /dam chos kyi rtsa ba lags pas na/ /'khor ba las nges 'byung sems bskyed de/ /nyams len gyi snying po yin pas na/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems sgoms/ /chos kun gyi yang rtse yin pas na/ /mtha' bral stong nyid kyi ngang la zhog /rang bzhin ma bcos gsal bas na/ /ma bcos so ma'i ngang du zhog /'dzin pa rang sar bshig nas kyang*/ /ched 'dzin med pa'i don de sgoms/ /rnam rtog brdzun gyi mgo bskor yin/ /lhug pa bzo med ngang du skyongs/ /phyi snang ba gang shar gyi ngo bo la/ /gsal la zhen pa med par zhog/

nang rig pa sems kyi ngo bo la/ /rig stong dbyer med khrim mer sgrims/ /sems mnyam bzhag ngang du gnas pa'i tshe/ /lhun grub bzo bcos med par zhog/ rjes snang ba 'gags med shar ba'i tshe/ /gang shar rang zhal lta bar 'tshal/ /snang ba rang bzhin dag pa la/ /dag pa'i snang ba rgya cher spel/ /rang lus yi dam lha sku la/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i rtsis su zin/ /sems rang bzhin bde ba'i rang snang la/ /bogs 'don rtsas ni phyogs bcur spel/ /lus rtsa rlung thig le'i rang bzhin la/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin gnad du bsnun/ /nyams sna tshogs 'char sgo ji snyed la/ /zhen chags med pa'i skyong lugs 'tshal/ /don de ltar thugs la zhog mdzod la/ /cis kyang gnad du bsnun par mdzod/ /bdag nges med kyi rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa/ /dbyangs 'di nyid bla ma la mchod par 'bul/ / tshig 'di la legs cha mi 'dug kyang*/ /don 'di la nges pa'i gtad so gdog/ // ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas chos 'khor sdings kyi gnas su tshes bcu'i mtshan mo'i thun dang po la byin pa'i dga' ston gyi tshe glur blangs pa'o//bkra shis//༄༅/ /na mo gu ra be/ dbyings skye ba med pa'i nam mkha' la/ /mdangs 'gag pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /thugs rje'i 'od brgya 'gyed pa yi/ /pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud/ /rje de nyid kyi thugs rje'i char sprin las/ /chos gdams ngag gi char rgyun phab pa de/ /mi kho bo'i sems kyi zhing sar babs/ /'bras bu nyams rtogs kyi lo tog rgyas/ khyed skal ldan yod na 'di las long*/ /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen skad pa des/ /rgyud mtha' yas gsungs pa'i snying po lnga/ /zab dgu bsdus pa'i nye lam zhig /ming ne gu chos drug zhes bya ba/ /ma mkha' 'gro kun gyi gsang tshig de/ /nges gsang bdud rtsi'i snying po de/ /pha bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi ste/ /dus de ring rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med kyi ldum bur spyod pa zhig

/nges med kyi tshul la spyod bzhin du/ /gnas ri gong dpal gyi gzhal yas 'dir/ /don snying po rdo rje'i glu ru len/ /gnas spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo las/ /brda skye med mtshon pa a yi gda'/ /'phrul bdud rtsi 'bab pa dmigs pa'i gnad/ /nyams sdig sgrib dag pa'i nges shes can/ /ming yang dag byed stod ra zer/ /'di sngon 'gro la gnad du che ba zhig gda'/ /rten rdo rje'i lus la rtsa thig gi 'gros/ /gzhi gnad du che ba 'khor lo bzhi/ /'phral 'bar 'dzag rang lus dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /'di rgyud sde'i nges gsang gnad du che/ /rkyen thabs dang shes rab 'dzom pa las//gzhi rang sems gnyug ma ngo sprod pa/ /rten thig le dbab ldog dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /de yin ni las kyi gtum mo yin/ /zer ni gzhan lus kyi gdams pa zer/ /'dod yon lam 'khyer la gnad du che/ /mi kho bos bde stong dbyer med du bsgoms/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang bde stong dbyer med bsgrubs/ /tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod na/ /lam gzhan la med do skal ldan kun/ /bde drod rang 'bar zhig mdzad de 'tshal/ /phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i lam 'khyer te/ /lus rgyas kyang sems kyi rang snang tsam/ /rang snang lha sku rang shar la/ /sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa zhig /sgyu lus kyi gdams pa'i snying po'i don/ mi ngan kyang 'di la nyams len byas/ /chags sdang gi snang ba rang sar dag / a mthas sbrul gyi mdud pa zhig khyed 'dir 'dus kyang a mthas bshig pa zhig 'tshal/ /'phral 'dun pa sgyur pa'i gnad ka las/ /rig pa'i rang rtsal phyogs med kyi gdangs/ /dngos 'dzin gyi 'ching ba 'grol ba la//nges med du sbyong pa gnad du che/ /ming yang rmi lam gyi gdams ngag zer/ /sgyu lus pa rnams la mkho ba lags/ /gzhi gdod ma'i rang zhal lta ba dang*/ /rkyen mos gus gdung ba'i shugs drag dang*/ /gnad rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las/ /sems rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'od gsal che/

/dus nyin par rtsol ba bskyed bskyed nas/ /mtshan mo rang shar gyi gsal snang can/ /gsal tsam nyid nas stong par shar/ /gsal stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal zer/ /zhu bde dang gnyug ma 'dres pa las/ /nyams bde tsam nyid nas rang dag gcig /bde stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal yin/ /sems rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa la/ / sgrib gnyis brdzun gyi stong zob yal/ /dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal yin/ / 'od gsal lam gyi 'bras bu stai/ /rje rdo rje 'chang chen gyi spyan snga ru/ /gdams ngag rnams phu thag chod par zhus/ /zhus pa tsam la yang ma bzhag par/ /rang sems dang 'dres pa'i nyams len byas/ /ban bun nyams kyi 'char sgo dag /'gyur med rtogs pa'i gtan yul zin/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang 'od gsal rtse gcig tu bsgoms/ /ngo mtshar rlung sems 'phrul gyi gnad/ /sems rtse gcig gyen du 'phang ba dang*/ /cir snang la bar do'i 'dun pa sbyongs/ /gang shar la dag snang lam 'khyer bya/ /'pho ba dang bar do'i gdams ngag zer//las dang po pa la gnad du che/ /sems ma bcos gnyug ma'i rang ngo la/ /gang shar rjen cher gyi ngang la zhog /sgo gsum ma bcos so ma'i ngang*/ /rang babs lhug pa'i gdams pa zer/ /sal le dang sing nge'i ngang du sgoms/ /lhod de dang shigs se'i rgya yan gyi ngang*/ /sems gang shar ngo shes kyi rnal 'byor ba/ /shar tsam nyid nas rang sar grol/ /ming yang rang grol gyi gdams ngag zer/ / gsal ba dang stong pa zung 'jug gsum/ /sems gnas sam 'gyu'am ji ltar rung*/ /gdod nas rang gnas kyi ngo shes la/ /sku gsum rang shar gyi gdams ngag zer/ /'gyu ba 'gyu stong gi ngang du thim/ /mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams zhig nas thal/ /mdo rgyud kyi mkhyen rgya can mang lags shing*/ /gdams ngag gi bdag po mang mod kyang*/ /don 'di las med ces bya ba nyung*/ /rang grol phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor 'di/ /mdo rgyud kyi snying por lags par 'khums/

/mi kho bos de ltar nyams su blangs/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang de ltar nyams len mdzod/ /rang shar phyogs med kyi dag snang gcig /gang snang mos gus kyi lam 'khyer la/ /mos gus kyi rtsa ba bla mar shar/ /zla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi ngang*/ /yi dam de sgyu mar rang shar zhig /rang shar ma bcos lhug pa'i gdangs/ /yin ni dag snang phyogs med 'khrid/ /zer ni lam 'khyer rnam gsum zer/ /mi kho bos kyang dag snang phyogs med du sbyangs/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang dag snang phyogs med du sbyongs/ /thabs 'gag med kyi gnad de dag snang la gda'/ /sems gsal stong lha sku'i snang cha dang*/ /rang rig pa 'gyur med bde ba'i ngang*/ /de dang po nyid nas skye ba med/ /gang la ma skyes pa la 'gag pa med/ /sems skye 'chi med pa'i rang bzhin te/ /'phral drin can gyi bla mas ngo sprod pa/ /ming yang rang sems 'chi med zer/ /bskyed rdzogs snying por dril ba gcig na gda'/ /rlung dang rnam rtog sems gsum po/ /dbyings su bsdoms pa nyams len gyi gnad/ /'khrul 'khor gyi kha bsgyur nyams len gyi rtsal/ /gzhan lus la thogs pa med pa yi/ /thig le 'dzag med kyi rang grol las/ /dga' bzhi dbyings su ngo sprod pa/ /ming ni rang lus 'chi med zer/ /rlung sems rang dbang du chug gcig rnal 'byor pa/ /'phral 'phṛn las rnam bzhi'i bsgrub pa'i gnad/ /pha drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po gnyis/ /mtshan tha dad don la khyad par med/ /mos gus nyag gcig gi rnal 'byor las/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi klong brdol nas/ /'gro don lhun grub tu 'char ba lags/ /dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo mtshan ldan rje/ /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen nas brtsams te/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad la/ /nyams dbyangs kyi glu 'di mchod par 'bul/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyi skal ldan pho mo la/ /nges gsang gi bdud rtsi ro mchog 'di/ /dga' don gyi tshul du byin pa lags/

/bdag phyogs ris med pa'i rgyal khams pa/ /ro snyoms kyi rnal 'byor gu yangs po/ /chos brgyad kyi dgra mkhar zhig pa zhig /gnyug ma'i gtan sa zin pa zhig /dngos kun gyi rang zhal lta ba po/ /chos tha snyad tshig la ma rmongs kyang*/ /mkhas 'dod kyi bzang 'dzin dbyings su grol/ /'phral lus sems tha mal du snang ba tsam/ /drin can gyi mkhan pos gnang pa'i ming*/ /kun dga' snying po zhes bya ba yin/ /rang sems kyi rang bzhin ngo sprod pa/ /mi sangs rgyas su gtong ba'i bka' drin can/ /pha bla mas bka' drin rtsal ba ni/ / ming tā ra nā tha zhes bya ba yin/ /deng snying gtam gyi tshul du smras pa yin// //zhes pa'ang rang lo nyer lnga pa la ri gong dpal gyi mgon po'i gnas/ rang byung mgon po'i drung du tshogs kyis 'khor lo'i tshe glur blangs pa a+thi+-i// dge'o//༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ra we/ dbyings spros dang bral ba'i ngang zhig nas/ /'phral gang la gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad/ /chos tshig spyi dang don spyir ma las par/ /don snying por ston pa'i bla ma rje/ /sa 'di nas rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /yid mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /bu slob ma'i sems la byin gyis rlobs/ /lar rtsa bral rtogs par thugs rjes gzung*/ /pha byin rlabs can de'i bka' drin la/ /mi ngas kyang sems kyi gnas lugs mthong*/ /rje mkhyen pa can de'i bka' drin las/ /don nges pa'i gnas la thag chod byung*/ /yongs thugs rje can de'i bka' drin la/ /phyi dgra gnyen gyi rnam rtog zhi ba tsam/ mgon 'khrul zhig can de'i bka' drin la/ /nang 'dzin pa yal yul ngang du bud/ /nga rje la mos gus mi che ru/ /bka' drin la tshad gzung mi gda' 'o/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyi thugs la 'di ltar zhog /lar da res mi lus thob pa la/ /mdo don yod pa zhig gal re che/ /dam chos mi byed pa'i mi lus 'di/ /dud 'gro las zang ma zhig ma lags sam/

/mi rtag 'khor ba'i gnas tshul la/ /thugs nges par 'byung ba zhig cis kyang 'tshal/ /thar pa'i lam sna zin pa zhig gal re che/ /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /dus nyi ma de ring la thug gi bar/ /lus bya byed 'gro 'dug nyal dang langs/ /ngag smra brjod ngal dub rtsol ba'i lam/ /yid mno bsam 'gyu ba'i 'phrang la brdar//chos byed tshug byas kyang las su song*/ /lar sdig pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu lags shing*/ /las lung ma bstan mi tshe stong zad yin/ /thar lam du ma song ba'i dge ba de/ /'khor ba bskyed pa'i thabs su gda'/ /phyag chen gyis ma zin pa'i spros bcas de/ /yid rnam rtog 'khrug pa'i rgyu zhig gda'/ /sgoms sems dang ma 'dres pa'i go yul de/ /don mdo don thug dus bslu ba zhig gda'/ /snying rjes ma zin pa'i stong rkyang de/ /legs kyang theg dman gyi rgyu zhig lags/ /las 'bras khyad gsod kyi 'ug gog de/ /dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu zhig gda'/ /rang ngo ma shes pa'i lta ba de/ /blos byas spros pa'i ri mor gda'/ /rang so tshugs pa'i nyon mongs de/ /rtsub rtsub 'dra yang 'jam por gda'/ /rtsa bral la song ba'i 'char sgo de/ /snang snang 'dra yang yal yul du gda'/ /rtsol med ngo shes kyi rnam rtog de/ /'gyu 'gyu 'dra yang rang zhig tu gda'/ /lhag bsam gyis ma zin pa'i dge rtsa de/ /brel ba che la 'bras bu chung*/ /slong yangs su ma thengs pa'i kha ton de/ /sems tshab che la grub don chung*/ /byang sems kyis ma zin pa'i sgom bzlas de/ /bon chog dang khyad par mi gda' 'o/ /da lus gnad srang du gzhug tu 'tshal/ /ngag smra brjod spangs la lhug par zhog /sems bzo med hrig ge skyong bar zhu/ /pha bla ma chos skur mkhyen pa zhig 'tshal/ /dam tshig la zol zog med pa zhig 'tshal/ /dad gus la kha zhe med pa zhig 'tshal/ /nyon mongs gang skyes kyi ngo bo la/ /ma bcos so mar 'jog pa zhig zhu/ /sems rang bzhin so ma bskyangs tsa na/

/gang shar brjod bral du lam mer gda'/ /de gdod ma nas yod yod po zhig lags/ /yod par ma shes pa ya re cha/ /'di ma bcos lhug pa'i gdams ngag zer/ /'phral lus ngag spyod pa ci byed kyang*/ /rang so tshugs pa'i ngo bo la/ /dmigs gtad kun zhig pa'i ngang zhig nas/ /blang dor la mtshan mar ma 'dzin par/ /tho cho la bzang por ma ngom zhig/tshul 'chos kyi mdzes khrigs kyang mi 'tshal lo/ /gang shar gyi spyod pa lhug pa la/ /bcos ma ru ma song pa gnad du che/ /'di blang dor mnyam nyid kyi gdams ngag lags//sgom nyams kyi rtsi la zhen pa te/ dpe dar gyi srin bu ji bzhin du/ /rang rang gis 'ching ba'i mgo bskor lags/ /dus do nub tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dus//gnas rgyal po'i pho brang chen po na/ /ming tā ra nā tha skad pa yis/ /glu 'di ni gdams pa'i tshul du blangs/ /de mchod par 'bul lo bla ma rje// //zhes slob bu 'ga' zhig la ngo sprod kyi tshul du glur blangs pa/ nyin zhag 'ga' re 'bri ba ma byung bas/ ma brjed par dran tshod cig deng 'dus rnams kyis 'bri bar bskul nas bris pa ste/ gong dkar du'o/ /dge'o//༈ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las/ /ma gyur 'gro ba kun sgrol ba'i blo/ /skad cig tsam du ma re skyes tsa na/ /le lo'i 'khri ba tsho rtsad nas chod/ /lar byang chub sems 'di ma 'byongs na/ /de mkhas par rloms yang mdo med po/ /bzang por rdzu yang gzhan mgo bskor/ /btsun btsun 'dra yang mdzes chos su gda'/ /chos pa rnam dag yin thag chad/ khong sde byus kyi kha lo sgyur pa yi/ /bshes gnyen kun la zhe nas khrel/ /chos dang rgyab 'gal gyi mdzad spyod la/ /dge bshes su re ba ha cang 'khrul/ /dpung bu rta'i ral rol mang po dang*/ /nor longs spyod zang zing lhur len pa/ /chos ka ri ka tsam yang mi shes par/ /'khor mang po 'dren pa ya re cha/ /'jig rten pa'i dpon g.yog gyu ru ste/

/las mthun tsam 'dus pa ma gtogs pa/ /dam chos kyi dri tsam mi gda' na/ /smin grol gyi gzhan don re thag sangs/ /ma byung dus 'khor tshogs g.yang ltar 'gugs/ /byung dus grags 'dod kyis phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /bya ba thongs thongs 'dra yang mi thongs pa'i/ kha zhu ga ting 'khyags kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /stong nyid sgom pas chog dus su/ /spros bcas kyi skyabs shig tshol la rem//spros bcas ma dag cing ma tshang pa'i/ /skyon subs la stong skad gyi 'ud gog 'thag /gnyis med seng ge khyod 'dzin stangs re bzang*/ /'char ka dang gtam ngan byung gi dogs/ /rang gnod ri tsam khong du chug /ro snyoms kyi rnal 'byor gnam mtha' yar/ /skabs 'gar rang skyon yang gshong ba skad//rang ma mgu ba kun la thabs kyis smod/ /rang bzang por ngom pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ khyod smra ba mang yang gting nas khrel/ / yengs tshe 'di'i skyid sdug dang gtam/ /rlung la bskur nas ma gyur tsho/ /sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje zol med cig /byung na chos su 'gro lags pas/ /cis kyang 'bad pa'i dus la bab// //ces pa'ang rang gzhan da lta'i chos par rdzu ba mang po'i gnas tshul la yid nges par 'byung nas/ tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o/ /dge'o//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ bde chen chos sku'i rang nyams las/ /phyogs med kyi thugs rje'i 'gro don shar/ /pha rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag 'dir tshogs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gzhan don phyogs med du 'phel ba 'di/ /sems stong nyid snying rje shar ba'i rtags/ /gnas lugs kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa 'di/ /mos gus tshad du phyin pa'i rtags/ /nam yang yengs pa med pa 'di/ /rtsa bral gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags/ /rnam rtog gi skye thag chod pa 'di/ /rtog med kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags/ /bde stong gi nyams myong rgyun chad med/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum dul ba'i rtags/ spyod pa bza' gtad dang bral ba 'di/

/chos brgyad kyi rlung dmar zhi ba'i rtags/ /thob 'dod kyi re dogs zhig pa 'di/ /rang sems sangs rgyas su nges pa'i rtags/ /rtags 'di bdun tshang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sems bde zhing skyid pa'i rang so zin/ /blo mi bde mi gda' bde mor gda'/ /slar bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog/ // ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// zhus dag /bkra shis// //
